catalog.name: Inventory Operations calculations
catalog.description: Every formula, algorithm, rounding rule and worked example of the inventory operations domain, in a structured form a rebuild can test against: the conversion and comparison conventions, the available quantity of one record and of a set for a tracked and for an untracked product, the four removal-strategy orderings and the lot-first sort, the least-packages container pre-selection with its best-first search, the loose and strict gathering filters and the gathering algorithm, the reservation-quantity computation in both directions with its negative pockets, the writing routine and the oldest-arrival date rule, the three branches of the reservation and the distribution map, the creation and extension of detail lines, unreserving, the change of an open and of a completed line, the freeing of other reservations, the writing, distribution and reduction of a processed quantity, the put-away entry point with its specificity sort, its two occupancy maps, its rule walk and its three capacity tests, the whole-container test, the two container weights, the container detection, promotion, application, packing, unpacking and removal, the Location and Transfer weights and volumes and the batch load percentages, the three housekeeping passes, the move merge key, algorithm, negative absorption and merged values, the two halves of a split, the backorder moves, the completion algorithm and the four steps of the line completion, the four parts of the push rules, the Transfer backorder, the validation algorithm with its backorder decision, its re-reservation and its inter-company unpacking, over-processing, the eleven date calculations, the six counting calculations, the fourteen derived indicators, the three parts of the reception report, the six parts of the traceability tree, the seven parts of the serial-number generation, the company consistency check, the nine parts of the daily quantity series, the rules diagram, the date stamping of a detail line, the orderings that change the records produced, the ten calculations of the location scope of the product quantity figures, the three fully worked traces, the complete table of rounding decisions, the call graph with its recursions and its ordering constraints, and the four intermediate structures the algorithms exchange.

records.name: The conversion, comparison and rounding conventions of the domain
records.purpose: Fixes the three units a quantity can be expressed in and the four rounding behaviours that every other calculation of the domain refers to, so that a rebuild rounds and compares quantities in exactly the same places.

operands.name: quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the product unit, the line unit or the packaging unit
operands.source: a Stock Quantity record, a Stock Move or a Stock Move Line
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: product unit
operands.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure with a rounding step
operands.source: the unit of measure of the product; every Stock Quantity record and every reserved counter is expressed in it
operands.constraints: always present for a storable product

operands.name: line unit
operands.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure with a rounding step
operands.source: the unit chosen on the Stock Move or on the Stock Move Line; the demand and the processed quantity are expressed in it
operands.constraints: must belong to the same category as the product unit

operands.name: packaging unit
operands.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure with a rounding step
operands.source: an optional third unit carried from a sales or a purchase document
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record named `Product Unit`, the decimal precision setting for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count, independent of any unit rounding step

preconditions.condition: The line unit and the product unit belong to the same category of units of measure.
preconditions.otherwise: No conversion is possible and the operation that needed it cannot run.

preconditions.condition: The product unit has a rounding step greater than zero.
preconditions.otherwise: Every comparison against zero would be exact and the quantity comparisons of the domain would not be reproducible.

procedure: Convert a quantity between two units with the conversion owned by the units of measure and packaging domain, naming one of four methods: half away from zero at the target unit's precision, truncation towards zero at the target unit's precision, rounding up at the target unit's precision, or no rounding at all.
Compare two quantities by rounding both operands at the rounding step of a named unit and returning minus one, zero or plus one; testing a quantity for zero is comparing it against zero at that unit.
Round a bare number to a digit count by rounding half away from zero to that many decimal digits.
Use the decimal precision named `Product Unit` wherever the document says a digit count rather than a unit rounding step, and never substitute one for the other.
records.formula: converted = convert( quantity , from unit , to unit , method ) where method is one of half away from zero, down, up or none ; comparison(a , b , unit) = −1, 0 or +1 after rounding a and b at the rounding step of the unit ; is zero(a , unit) = ( comparison(a , 0 , unit) = 0 ) ; round to digits(x , n) = x rounded half away from zero to n decimal digits

rounding.what: Every converted quantity, every comparison of two quantities and every check that a written quantity is representable.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the target unit for a conversion and for a comparison; the `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, wherever a digit count is named.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, truncation towards zero, up, or none, as the calling calculation names.
rounding.step: At the conversion itself, and again at every comparison; intermediate arithmetic is exact unless a calculation says otherwise.

result.name: converted or compared quantity
result.stored_or_displayed: Passed on to the calculation that asked for it; never stored on its own.

edge_cases.case: The two units are the same unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion returns the quantity unchanged and applies no rounding.

edge_cases.case: The rounding method is none.
edge_cases.outcome: The converted figure keeps full precision; several algorithms rely on this so that a walk over detail lines does not lose a fraction at every step.

edge_cases.case: A quantity is compared at a digit count instead of a unit rounding step.
edge_cases.outcome: The comparison uses the `Product Unit` decimal precision; the document calls out each such place and an implementation must not substitute the unit's own step.

edge_cases.case: A negative quantity is converted.
edge_cases.outcome: Half away from zero rounds a negative value away from zero, so minus zero point five becomes minus one.

worked_examples.description: Converting between a unit of twelve and the product unit, and the effect of the method
worked_examples.narrative: Five dozen is exactly sixty product units, so all four methods agree; the methods only differ when the exact figure falls between two multiples of the target unit's rounding step.

worked_examples.description: Comparing a quantity against zero at a rounding step of one hundredth
worked_examples.narrative: Four thousandths rounds to zero at a step of one hundredth, so the comparison returns zero and the quantity counts as zero for every test of the domain.

records.name: Available quantity of one Stock Quantity record
records.purpose: Gives the quantity of one Stock Quantity record that nobody has promised yet; it is the figure the gathering walk consumes and the figure the reservation offers.

operands.name: record on-hand quantity
operands.source: the on-hand field of the Stock Quantity record
operands.constraints: may be negative when goods were delivered before they were received

operands.name: record reserved quantity
operands.source: the reserved field of the Stock Quantity record
operands.constraints: never negative

preconditions.condition: Both figures are expressed in the product unit.
preconditions.otherwise: The subtraction is meaningless; every Stock Quantity record is stored in the product unit by construction.

procedure: Read the on-hand quantity of the record.
Read the reserved quantity of the record.
Subtract the second from the first, exactly, applying no rounding.
records.formula: record available quantity = record on-hand quantity − record reserved quantity

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the subtraction is exact.
rounding.step: No rounding step is applied at any point of this calculation.

result.name: record available quantity
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand, not stored; displayed on the quantity screens and consumed by the gathering walk.

edge_cases.case: The on-hand quantity is negative and nothing is reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The available quantity is negative; the reservation walk skips such a record and the negative pocket mechanism makes positive records of the same characteristics absorb it.

edge_cases.case: The reserved quantity exceeds the on-hand quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The available quantity is negative; this is reachable only transiently, because the reserved counter is kept in step with the open detail lines by the cleaning pass.

edge_cases.case: Both figures are zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The available quantity is zero and the record itself becomes a candidate for the empty-record deletion.

worked_examples.description: The record of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Six on hand less two reserved leaves four available, which is exactly the quantity the reservation walk of the trace takes from that record.

worked_examples.description: A negative record
worked_examples.narrative: Minus one on hand and nothing reserved leaves minus one available; the walk skips the record because its available quantity is not strictly positive.

records.name: Available quantity of a set of records for an untracked product
records.purpose: Gives the quantity of a product that may still be promised at a Location when the product carries no lot or serial tracking; it is the ceiling the reservation clamps the wanted quantity to.

operands.name: gathered records
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering algorithm, run for the product, the Location and the optional lot, container and owner
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: on-hand quantity of each record
operands.source: the on-hand field of each gathered record
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: reserved quantity of each record
operands.source: the reserved field of each gathered record
operands.constraints: never negative

operands.name: allowance for a negative result
operands.constraints: the reservation-quantity computation asks for no negative result; the writing routine asks for one

preconditions.condition: The product's tracking mode is the stored value `none`, meaning the product carries neither lots nor serial numbers.
preconditions.otherwise: The bucketed calculation for a tracked product applies instead.

procedure: Gather the candidate records with the gathering algorithm, in the requested matching mode.
Sum the on-hand quantities of all the gathered records.
Sum the reserved quantities of all the gathered records.
Subtract the second sum from the first.
When negative results are not allowed and the difference is strictly less than zero at the product unit's rounding step, return zero; otherwise return the difference.
records.formula: available = sum( on-hand over the gathered records ) − sum( reserved over the gathered records ) ; if negative results are not allowed and comparison( available , 0 , product unit ) < 0 then available = 0

rounding.what: Only the comparison of the result against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the two sums themselves are exact.
rounding.step: After both sums have been taken and subtracted, never during the summation.

result.name: available quantity
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand; consumed by the reservation-quantity computation and by the writing routine, and displayed as the free quantity of the Location.

edge_cases.case: No record is gathered at all.
edge_cases.outcome: Both sums are zero and the available quantity is zero.

edge_cases.case: The records sum to a negative figure and negative results are not allowed.
edge_cases.outcome: Zero is returned, so nothing can be reserved.

edge_cases.case: The records sum to a negative figure and negative results are allowed.
edge_cases.outcome: The negative figure is returned; the writing routine uses it to decide whether other reservations must be freed.

worked_examples.description: The three records of the first worked trace of the document, gathered loosely at the stock Location

records.name: Q1
Q2
Q3

worked_examples.narrative: Six plus nine less one is fourteen on hand; two is reserved; the available quantity is twelve, which is exactly the figure the trace clamps its demand of twelve to.

worked_examples.description: A Location whose records sum below zero, with negative results forbidden

records.name: Q4

worked_examples.narrative: The raw difference is minus three, which is strictly below zero at the product unit's step, so zero is returned and nothing may be reserved.

records.name: Available quantity of a set of records for a tracked product
records.purpose: Gives the quantity of a lot-tracked or serial-tracked product that may still be promised at a Location, bucketed per lot, so that a negative pocket of one lot never reduces the availability offered by another lot.

operands.name: gathered records
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering algorithm, run for the product, the Location and the optional lot, container and owner
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: available quantity of each record
operands.source: the on-hand quantity less the reserved quantity of each gathered record
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: matching mode
operands.constraints: strict when the exact characteristics are already known

operands.name: requested lot
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot or Serial Number, or nothing
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: allowance for a negative result
operands.constraints: the reservation-quantity computation asks for no negative result

preconditions.condition: The product's tracking mode is the stored value `lot` or the stored value `serial`.
preconditions.otherwise: The plain summed calculation for an untracked product applies instead.

procedure: Gather the candidate records with the gathering algorithm, in the requested matching mode.
Open one bucket per distinct lot found among the gathered records, plus one bucket for the records that carry no lot.
For each gathered record: when the record has no lot and the matching mode is strict and a lot was requested, skip the record entirely.
Otherwise add the record's available quantity to the bucket of its lot, or to the lot-less bucket when it has no lot.
When negative results are allowed, return the sum of every bucket, negative ones included.
When negative results are not allowed, return the sum of only those buckets whose value is strictly greater than zero at the product unit's rounding step.
records.formula: bucket(lot) = sum over the gathered records of that lot of ( on-hand − reserved ) ; available = sum over every bucket of bucket , when negative results are allowed ; available = sum over the buckets whose value > 0 at the product unit's step of bucket , when they are not

rounding.what: Only the test of each bucket against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the bucket sums themselves are exact.
rounding.step: Once per bucket, after the whole bucket has been accumulated.

result.name: available quantity
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand; consumed by the reservation-quantity computation and displayed as the free quantity of the Location for the tracked product.

edge_cases.case: One lot is negative while another is positive and negative results are not allowed.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the positive bucket is counted; the asymmetry is deliberate so that a negative pocket of one lot does not reduce what another lot offers.

edge_cases.case: A lot-less record is gathered in strict mode while a lot was requested.
edge_cases.outcome: The record is skipped entirely and contributes to no bucket.

edge_cases.case: A lot-less record is gathered in loose mode.
edge_cases.outcome: Its available quantity goes into the untracked bucket, which is treated exactly like a lot bucket for the positivity test.

edge_cases.case: Every bucket is zero or negative and negative results are not allowed.
edge_cases.outcome: Zero is returned.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document: a product tracked by lot in one Location
worked_examples.narrative: The buckets are six for lot A, three for lot B and minus two for the untracked pocket. Allowing negative results gives six plus three less two, that is seven. Forbidding them counts only the strictly positive buckets, giving six plus three, that is nine.

records.name: Selecting the removal strategy for a product at a Location
records.purpose: Decides in which order the stock at a Location is offered to a demand, which determines which physical goods leave and therefore which cost the valuation domain later consumes.

operands.name: product
operands.source: the move or the calling calculation
operands.constraints: must be given

operands.name: removal strategy of the product's category
operands.source: the product category of the product
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: Location
operands.source: the move's source Location or the calling calculation
operands.constraints: must be given

operands.name: removal strategy of each Location of the parent chain
operands.source: the Location itself and each of its ancestors in turn
operands.constraints: optional at every level

preconditions.condition: The reading of the product category and of the parent Locations is performed with elevated rights.
preconditions.otherwise: A user who may not read the category or the parent Locations would obtain a different ordering from the same data, which would make the choice of goods depend on who is looking.

procedure: When the product's category names a removal strategy, return that strategy's method key and stop.
Otherwise start at the Location itself and walk upwards through its ancestors: at each step, when that Location names a removal strategy, return its method key and stop, then move to its parent.
When no Location of the chain names one, return the stored value `fifo`, the first in first out strategy.
records.formula: strategy = category strategy , when the product's category names one = the strategy of the nearest ancestor Location that names one , otherwise = `fifo` (first in first out) , when none does

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is a method key, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: removal strategy method key
result.unit_or_currency: one of the stored values `fifo`, `lifo`, `closest` and `least_packages`
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and consumed by the gathering algorithm; not stored on the move.

edge_cases.case: Both the category and the Location name a strategy.
edge_cases.outcome: The category wins; the Location chain is not consulted at all.

edge_cases.case: An ancestor Location names a strategy and a nearer one does not.
edge_cases.outcome: The nearest ancestor that names one wins, so a shelf inherits the strategy of its aisle unless it sets its own.

edge_cases.case: The resolved key is not one of the implemented strategies.
edge_cases.outcome: The ordering step fails with the message that the named removal strategy is not implemented.

worked_examples.description: The first worked trace of the document, where nothing names a strategy

inputs.location: the stock Location of the warehouse

worked_examples.narrative: Neither the category nor any Location of the chain names a strategy, so the default first in first out applies, and the gathering orders the records by incoming date ascending.

worked_examples.description: A shelf that names last in first out under a category that names nothing

inputs.location: a shelf whose own strategy is `lifo`
inputs.location_chain_strategies: the shelf names `lifo`, its parent names nothing

worked_examples.narrative: The walk starts at the shelf itself, finds a strategy there and stops immediately, so the parent chain is never consulted.

related_rules: business-rules.md permission check on elevated-rights operations

records.name: Ordering the gathered records under first in first out
records.purpose: Fixes the exact order in which the stock of a Location is offered to a demand when the strategy is first in first out, so that two implementations consume the same physical goods.

operands.name: candidate Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering filter for the product, the Location and the optional characteristics
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: incoming date of each record
operands.source: the incoming-date field of the record, which carries the oldest arrival date of the goods it holds
operands.constraints: always set

operands.name: identifier of each record
operands.constraints: unique and increasing with creation order

preconditions.condition: The resolved removal strategy is the stored value `fifo`, first in first out.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other three orderings applies.

procedure: Order the candidate records by incoming date ascending.
Break ties by record identifier ascending.
Apply no further ordering in memory.
Apply the final stable sort that puts records carrying a lot before records carrying none.
records.formula: order = incoming date ascending , then record identifier ascending , then records with a lot before records without a lot (stable)

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is an order, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step; the dates are compared at their stored precision.

result.name: ordered list of Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed from the front by the reservation-quantity computation; not stored.

edge_cases.case: Two records share the same incoming date.
edge_cases.outcome: The lower identifier comes first, so the record created earlier is consumed first.

edge_cases.case: Some records carry a lot and others do not.
edge_cases.outcome: The final stable sort moves the lot-bearing records in front while preserving the date order inside each of the two groups.

edge_cases.case: Quantities merge onto one record.
edge_cases.outcome: The writing routine stamps the oldest of the arrival dates on the surviving record, which is what keeps first in first out stable across merges.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document across two arrival batches

records.name: Q1
Q2

worked_examples.narrative: The order is the third of March before the tenth of March, so the demand of fifty takes all forty from the first record and the remaining ten from the second.

records.name: Ordering the gathered records under last in first out
records.purpose: Fixes the exact order in which the stock of a Location is offered to a demand when the strategy is last in first out, which sends the most recently arrived goods out first.

operands.name: candidate Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering filter for the product, the Location and the optional characteristics
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: incoming date of each record
operands.source: the incoming-date field of the record
operands.constraints: always set

operands.name: identifier of each record
operands.constraints: unique

preconditions.condition: The resolved removal strategy is the stored value `lifo`, last in first out.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other three orderings applies.

procedure: Order the candidate records by incoming date descending.
Break ties by record identifier descending.
Apply no further ordering in memory.
Apply the final stable sort that puts records carrying a lot before records carrying none.
records.formula: order = incoming date descending , then record identifier descending , then records with a lot before records without a lot (stable)

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is an order, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: ordered list of Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed from the front by the reservation-quantity computation; not stored.

edge_cases.case: Two records share the same incoming date.
edge_cases.outcome: The higher identifier comes first, the mirror of the first in first out tie-break.

edge_cases.case: Some records carry a lot and others do not.
edge_cases.outcome: The final stable sort moves the lot-bearing records in front while preserving the descending date order inside each group.

worked_examples.description: The same two arrival batches as the first in first out example of the document, read under last in first out

records.name: Q1
Q2

worked_examples.narrative: The order is the tenth of March before the third of March, so the same demand of fifty takes all twenty-five from the later record and twenty-five from the earlier one.

records.name: Ordering the gathered records under closest location
records.purpose: Fixes the exact order in which the stock is offered when the strategy is closest location, which walks the Locations in the textual order of their full names.

operands.name: candidate Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering filter for the product, the Location and the optional characteristics
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: full name of each record's Location
operands.source: the Location of the record, whose full name is its parent's full name, a slash and its own name
operands.constraints: always set

operands.name: identifier of each record
operands.constraints: unique

preconditions.condition: The resolved removal strategy is the stored value `closest`, closest location.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other three orderings applies.

procedure: Apply no ordering in the query itself.
Sort the result in memory by the full name of the record's Location, ascending, comparing the names as text and not as numbers.
Break ties by record identifier descending.
Apply the final stable sort that puts records carrying a lot before records carrying none.
records.formula: order = full location name ascending compared as text , then record identifier descending , then records with a lot before records without a lot (stable)

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is an order, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: ordered list of Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed from the front by the reservation-quantity computation; not stored.

edge_cases.case: Two Locations whose names end in numbers of different lengths.
edge_cases.outcome: The comparison is textual, so a shelf numbered ten sorts before a shelf numbered two.

edge_cases.case: Two records in the same Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The higher identifier comes first.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document with two shelves under the same stock Location
worked_examples.narrative: The shelf named one sorts before the shelf named ten because the comparison is textual and not numeric; within one Location the higher record identifier would come first.

records.name: Ordering the gathered records under least packages
records.purpose: Fixes the order in which the stock is offered when the strategy is least packages, where the choice of goods has already been narrowed by the container pre-selection and the remaining order is the arrival order.

operands.name: candidate Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering filter, already narrowed by the container pre-selection when a requested quantity was supplied
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: incoming date of each record
operands.source: the incoming-date field of the record
operands.constraints: always set

operands.name: identifier of each record
operands.constraints: unique

preconditions.condition: The resolved removal strategy is the stored value `least_packages`, least packages.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other three orderings applies.

preconditions.condition: A requested quantity strictly greater than zero was supplied, so that the container pre-selection could run.
preconditions.otherwise: The pre-selection is abandoned and the plain ordering is applied to the unrestricted filter.

procedure: Let the container pre-selection narrow the filter to the chosen containers and the chosen loose records.
Order the narrowed candidates by incoming date ascending.
Break ties by record identifier ascending.
Apply no further ordering in memory, because the pre-selection has already chosen the set.
Apply the final stable sort that puts records carrying a lot before records carrying none.
records.formula: order = incoming date ascending , then record identifier ascending , applied to the set the container pre-selection returned , then records with a lot before records without a lot (stable)

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is an order, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: ordered list of Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed from the front by the reservation-quantity computation; not stored.

edge_cases.case: No real container was found among the candidates.
edge_cases.outcome: The pre-selection is abandoned and the unmodified filter is ordered by incoming date ascending, which makes the result identical to first in first out.

edge_cases.case: The pre-selection search exhausts memory.
edge_cases.outcome: The event is logged and the unmodified filter is used.

edge_cases.case: No requested quantity was supplied.
edge_cases.outcome: The pre-selection does not run at all and the plain arrival ordering applies.

worked_examples.description: A demand of thirteen over three containers and three loose units

expected_outputs.ordering_applied: incoming date ascending, then identifier ascending

worked_examples.narrative: The pre-selection returns the exact cover of the first container and one loose unit; the records of that narrowed set are then walked in arrival order, so the goods of the chosen container leave before the loose unit when the container arrived first.

records.name: The final sort that puts lot-bearing records first
records.purpose: Guarantees that tracked stock is consumed before untracked pockets of the same product, whichever removal strategy chose the order, so that a lot-less negative pocket is not preferred over real lots.

operands.name: records already ordered by the removal strategy
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the ordering of the resolved removal strategy
operands.constraints: the order inside each group must be preserved

operands.name: lot of each record
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot or Serial Number, or nothing
operands.source: the lot field of the record
operands.constraints: may be empty

preconditions.condition: The strategy ordering has already been applied.
preconditions.otherwise: The sort would be applied to an arbitrary order and the result would not be reproducible.

procedure: Split the ordered list conceptually into the records that carry a lot and the records that carry none.
Place every record that carries a lot before every record that carries none.
Preserve the strategy ordering inside each of the two groups, because the sort is stable.
records.formula: final order = ( records with a lot , in strategy order ) followed by ( records without a lot , in strategy order )

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is an order, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: ordered list of Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed from the front by the reservation-quantity computation; not stored.

edge_cases.case: No record carries a lot.
edge_cases.outcome: The sort changes nothing and the strategy order stands.

edge_cases.case: Every record carries a lot.
edge_cases.outcome: The sort changes nothing and the strategy order stands.

edge_cases.case: A lot-less record holds a negative quantity beside lot-bearing positive records.
edge_cases.outcome: The lot-bearing records are offered first; the negative pocket is absorbed by the pocket mechanism of the reservation-quantity computation rather than by the ordering.

worked_examples.description: Three records ordered by first in first out, two of which carry a lot
worked_examples.narrative: The two lot-bearing records move in front in their own arrival order, the fifth of March before the seventh, and the lot-less record of the second of March falls to the end even though it arrived first.

records.name: The free quantity of a container
records.purpose: Gives, per container, the quantity that the least-packages search may draw from it, so that the search can choose the smallest number of containers that covers a demand.

operands.name: records of the container
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the records of the candidate set of the gathering filter whose container is that container
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: on-hand quantity of each record
operands.source: the on-hand field of the record
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: reserved quantity of each record
operands.source: the reserved field of the record
operands.constraints: never negative

preconditions.condition: The candidate set has already been restricted by the gathering filter.
preconditions.otherwise: Containers outside the requested product, Location or characteristics would be offered to the search.

procedure: Group the records of the candidate set by container.
For each container, sum the on-hand quantity less the reserved quantity over its records.
Keep only the containers whose free quantity is strictly positive.
Order the surviving containers by free quantity descending.
records.formula: container free quantity = sum over the container's records of ( on-hand − reserved )

rounding.what: Only the test of the free quantity against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the sum itself is exact.
rounding.step: Once per container, after the sum has been taken.

result.name: free quantity per container
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and consumed by the least-packages search; not stored.

edge_cases.outcome: The container is dropped and never offered to the search.

edge_cases.case: A record belongs to no container.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not a container entry; it is expanded into single-unit entries by the next step of the pre-selection.

edge_cases.outcome: The pre-selection is abandoned and the unmodified gathering filter is returned.

records.name: The estimate of a node in the least-packages search
records.purpose: Gives the priority with which a partial selection of containers is explored, so that the best-first search always expands the selection that promises the fewest containers.

operands.name: number of taken entries
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: remaining quantity
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative when the node over-selects

operands.name: free quantity of the entry at the next index
operands.source: the ordered entry list of the pre-selection
operands.constraints: strictly positive when the index is inside the list

preconditions.condition: The entry list has been built and ordered by free quantity descending, with the single-unit entries appended after the container entries.
preconditions.otherwise: The estimate would not be comparable between nodes and the search order would not be reproducible.

procedure: When the node's next index is inside the entry list, divide the node's remaining quantity by the free quantity of the entry at that index and add the number of entries the node has already taken.
When the next index has reached the end of the list, take the number of taken entries alone.
Use the resulting figure as the node's priority in the queue, lowest first.
records.formula: estimate(node) = number of taken entries + remaining quantity ÷ free quantity of the entry at the next index , when the next index is inside the list ; estimate(node) = number of taken entries , when it is not

rounding.what: Nothing; the estimate is used only as a comparison key.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the division is carried at full precision.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step of the estimate.

result.name: node estimate
result.unit_or_currency: a count of entries, carried as a fractional number
result.stored_or_displayed: Used only as the priority of the search queue; never stored or displayed.

edge_cases.case: The remaining quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The estimate equals the number of taken entries, which is the lowest estimate any completion of that node can reach.

edge_cases.case: The next index is past the end of the list.
edge_cases.outcome: The division is not performed and the estimate is the number of taken entries alone.

edge_cases.case: The remaining quantity is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: Such a node over-selects and is never enqueued; it competes only for the place of best leaf.

records.name: The least-packages container pre-selection
records.purpose: Narrows the gathering filter to the smallest number of containers whose combined free quantity covers the requested quantity, so that a delivery breaks open as few containers as possible.

operands.name: requested quantity
operands.constraints: must be strictly greater than zero for the pre-selection to run

operands.name: free quantity per container
operands.source: the free quantity of each container of the candidate set
operands.constraints: strictly positive; ordered descending

operands.name: free quantity of the container-less records
operands.source: the records of the candidate set that belong to no container
operands.constraints: expanded into as many single-unit entries as its integer part

operands.name: gathering filter
operands.source: the gathering filter built for the requested matching mode
operands.constraints: the returned filter is always at least as restrictive

preconditions.condition: The resolved removal strategy is the stored value `least_packages` and a requested quantity greater than zero was supplied.
preconditions.otherwise: The pre-selection does not run and the unmodified gathering filter is used.

preconditions.condition: At least one real container is found among the entries.
preconditions.otherwise: The pre-selection is abandoned and the unmodified gathering filter is returned.

procedure: Read the free quantity per container over the candidate set, keep only the strictly positive ones and order them by free quantity descending.
Expand the entries that belong to no container into as many entries of exactly one unit as the integer part of their free quantity, each carrying no container.
Keep the container entries whose free quantity is non-zero as they are, and append the single-unit entries after them; call the resulting ordered list the entries and its length the size.
When no real container was found in the expansion, abandon the pre-selection and return the unmodified gathering filter.
Define a search node as a remaining quantity, a tuple of taken entries and a next index, and score it with the node estimate.
Put the initial node, carrying the requested quantity, an empty tuple and index zero, into a priority queue with priority zero, and set the best leaf to that same node.
While the queue is not empty, pop the node with the lowest estimate and call it the current node.
When the current node's remaining quantity is less than or equal to zero, build the filter from it and stop.

Otherwise walk the entry list from the current node's next index to the end, tracking the free quantity of the previously examined entry and skipping any entry whose free quantity equals it, so that only one branch is opened per distinct free quantity.

For each examined entry at a position, use the position after it as the child's next index and compute the child's remaining quantity as the current node's remaining quantity minus that entry's free quantity.

When the child's remaining quantity is negative the child over-selects: replace the best leaf by the child when the best leaf still has a positive remaining quantity, or when the child takes strictly fewer entries, or when it takes the same number of entries and leaves a larger, that is a less negative, remaining quantity; do not enqueue the child.

Otherwise, when the child's next index has reached the end of the list and its remaining quantity is still non-zero, the child cannot be completed: replace the best leaf by the child when the child's remaining quantity is smaller than the best leaf's; do not enqueue the child.
Otherwise enqueue the child with its estimate as its priority.

Build the filter from a node as the records whose container is one of the node's container entries, or whose identifier is one of the identifiers drawn for the node's single-unit entries, drawn by listing the container-less records matching the gathering filter and popping one identifier per single-unit entry, intersected with the original gathering filter.
When the queue empties without an exact cover, build the filter from the best leaf.
When the search runs out of memory, log the event and return the unmodified gathering filter.
records.formula: child remaining quantity = current remaining quantity − free quantity of the examined entry ; estimate(node) = number of taken entries + remaining quantity ÷ free quantity of the entry at the next index ; returned filter = original gathering filter ∩ ( records of the chosen containers ∪ records drawn for the chosen single-unit entries )

rounding.what: The expansion of a container-less free quantity into single-unit entries.
rounding.precision: Whole units of the product unit.
rounding.method: Truncation towards zero: the integer part of the free quantity gives the number of single-unit entries.
rounding.step: Once, when the entry list is built; the search arithmetic itself is exact.

result.name: narrowed gathering filter
result.unit_or_currency: a set of conditions on Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the gathering algorithm for that one call; never stored.

edge_cases.case: The requested quantity exceeds the sum of every free quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: No exact cover exists; the queue empties and the filter is built from the best leaf, which is the selection that leaves the smallest shortfall.

edge_cases.case: Two entries have exactly the same free quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: Only one branch is opened for that value, which keeps the search from exploring interchangeable selections twice.

edge_cases.case: A selection overshoots the requested quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not enqueued but may become the best leaf, preferring fewer entries first and, at equal count, the smaller overshoot.

edge_cases.case: The search exhausts memory.
edge_cases.outcome: The event is logged and the unrestricted filter is used, so the operation still completes.

edge_cases.case: No container is found.
edge_cases.outcome: The pre-selection is abandoned and the plain arrival ordering applies to the whole candidate set.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Taking the first container alone leaves one; taking it with the second container overshoots by seven with two entries; taking it with the third overshoots by four with two entries; taking it with one loose unit reaches exactly zero with two entries, so the exact cover of the first container and one loose unit is returned and the filter is narrowed to those records.

records.name: The gathering filter in loose matching
records.purpose: Defines which Stock Quantity records a move may draw from when it has not yet chosen its goods, so that a reservation can pick up stock of any lot, container or owner that was not asked for.

operands.name: product
operands.constraints: always required

operands.name: Location
operands.constraints: always required

operands.name: requested lot
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot or Serial Number, or nothing
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: requested container
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: requested owner
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: expiration cut-off date
operands.source: the calling context when the expiration behaviour is active
operands.constraints: optional

preconditions.condition: The calling calculation asked for loose matching.
preconditions.otherwise: The strict filter applies instead and descendants are excluded.

procedure: Require that the record's product equals the requested product.
When a lot was requested, require that the record's lot is either that lot or empty.
When a container was requested, require that the record's container equals it.
When an owner was requested, require that the record's owner equals it.
Require that the record's Location is the requested Location or any of its descendants.
Impose no condition at all for a characteristic that was not requested, so that a loose gathering without a lot returns records that carry lots.
When the expiration behaviour is active, additionally require that the record's removal date is on or after the supplied cut-off date, or is empty.
records.formula: loose filter = ( product = requested product ) and ( lot = requested lot or lot is empty , when a lot was requested ) and ( container = requested container , when one was requested ) and ( owner = requested owner , when one was requested ) and ( Location is the requested Location or a descendant of it ) and ( removal date ≥ cut-off or removal date is empty , when the expiration behaviour is active )

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is a set of conditions, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: loose gathering filter
result.unit_or_currency: a set of conditions on Stock Quantity records
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the gathering algorithm for one call; never stored.

edge_cases.outcome: Records carrying any lot are returned, which is what lets a move reserve whichever lot the strategy offers first.

edge_cases.case: A lot is requested.
edge_cases.outcome: Records of that lot and lot-less records both match, so an untracked pocket can still serve a lot-specific demand.

edge_cases.case: The requested Location is a view Location with internal children.
edge_cases.outcome: Every internal descendant is included, because the condition is on the Location or any of its descendants.

records.purpose: Defines which Stock Quantity records are addressed when the exact characteristics are already known, so that a chained reservation and a completion touch exactly the record they mean and no other.

operands.name: product
operands.constraints: always required

operands.name: Location
operands.constraints: always required

operands.name: requested lot

operands.constraints: may be deliberately empty

preconditions.condition: The calling calculation asked for strict matching.
preconditions.otherwise: The loose filter applies instead and descendants are included.

procedure: Require that the record's product equals the requested product.
Require that the record's lot is either empty or exactly the requested lot, and empty only when no lot was requested.
Require that the record's container equals the requested container exactly, an empty container included.
Require that the record's owner equals the requested owner exactly, an empty owner included.

records.formula: strict filter = ( product = requested product ) and ( lot is empty or lot = requested lot , and empty only when no lot was requested ) and ( container = requested container exactly ) and ( owner = requested owner exactly ) and ( Location = requested Location exactly , descendants excluded ) and ( removal date ≥ cut-off or removal date is empty , when the expiration behaviour is active )

rounding.what: Nothing.

result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the gathering algorithm for one call; never stored.

records.name: The gathering algorithm
records.purpose: Turns a request for a product at a Location into the ordered list of Stock Quantity records the removal strategy says should leave first; every reservation and every completion consumes that list from the front.

operands.name: product
operands.constraints: always required

operands.name: Location
operands.constraints: always required

operands.name: requested quantity
operands.constraints: optional; required for the least-packages pre-selection to run

operands.name: matching mode
operands.constraints: always given

operands.name: pre-loaded record cache
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from the five-part key to records
operands.source: the calling context of a reservation pass or of a completion
operands.constraints: optional

preconditions.condition: The product and the Location are known.
preconditions.otherwise: No filter can be built and the calling calculation cannot run.

procedure: Determine the removal strategy for the product and the Location.
Build the filter for the requested matching mode.
When the strategy is the stored value `least_packages` and a requested quantity was supplied, narrow the filter with the container pre-selection.
Determine the ordering of the strategy.

When a pre-loaded record cache is available in the calling context, the matching mode is strict and the strategy is not least packages, take the records from the cache instead of querying: first the cache entry for the product, Location, lot, container and owner when a lot was requested, then always the cache entry for the product, Location, no lot, container and owner; otherwise query with the filter and the ordering.
When the strategy is closest location, re-sort the result in memory by full location name ascending, then by record identifier descending.
Sort the result so that records carrying a lot come before records carrying none, preserving the previous order inside each group.
Return the ordered list.
records.formula: gathered records = order( filter( records , matching mode ) , strategy ordering ) then lot-bearing records first (stable) ; the filter is narrowed by the container pre-selection when the strategy is `least_packages` and a requested quantity was supplied

rounding.what: Nothing in the gathering itself; the container pre-selection truncates a container-less free quantity to whole units.
rounding.precision: Whole units of the product unit, inside the pre-selection only.
rounding.method: Truncation towards zero, inside the pre-selection only.
rounding.step: Only while the pre-selection builds its entry list.

records.name: Reducing a reservable quantity to whole packaging units
records.purpose: Guarantees that only whole packagings are reserved when the product's category asks for full-packaging reservation, so that a pallet is never broken open to satisfy part of a demand.

operands.name: wanted quantity
operands.source: the calling reservation, as the quantity still missing
operands.constraints: strictly positive at this step

operands.name: available quantity
operands.source: the available quantity over the gathered records, computed with negative results forbidden
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: packaging unit
operands.source: the calling context, carried from a sales or a purchase document
operands.constraints: must be present for the reduction to apply

operands.name: full-packaging reservation setting
operands.constraints: must be set for the reduction to apply

preconditions.condition: The calling context carries a packaging unit and the product's category asks for full-packaging reservation.
preconditions.otherwise: The reduction is skipped entirely and the available quantity stands as computed.

procedure: Take the smaller of the wanted quantity and the available quantity.
Convert that figure from the product unit into the packaging unit, rounding down, so that only whole packagings remain.
Convert the whole number of packagings back into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Use the result as the new available quantity.
records.formula: available = convert( convert( minimum( wanted , available ) , product unit , packaging unit , down ) , packaging unit , product unit , half away from zero )

rounding.what: The quantity expressed in packaging units, and then the figure converted back into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the packaging unit on the way out, and the rounding step of the product unit on the way back.
rounding.method: Truncation towards zero on the way out, half away from zero on the way back.
rounding.step: Immediately after the smaller of the wanted and the available quantity has been taken, and before the wanted quantity is clamped.

result.name: available quantity in whole packaging units
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the reservation-quantity computation as the new ceiling; never stored.

edge_cases.case: Less than one whole packaging is available.
edge_cases.outcome: The truncation gives zero packagings, the conversion back gives zero, and nothing is reserved at all.

edge_cases.case: The wanted quantity is smaller than the available quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The wanted quantity is the figure that is truncated, so a demand smaller than one packaging reserves nothing.

edge_cases.case: The category does not ask for full-packaging reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: The step is skipped and partial packagings may be reserved.

worked_examples.narrative: Sixteen product units are two whole packagings and four spare units; truncating to two packagings and converting back gives twelve product units, so only two whole packagings are offered to the reservation.

records.purpose: Keeps a loose reservation representable in the unit the document uses, so that a demand expressed in a coarser unit is never reserved as a fraction that the document could not display.

operands.name: wanted quantity
operands.source: the reservation-quantity computation, after it has been clamped to the available quantity
operands.constraints: may be positive or negative

operands.name: line unit

operands.constraints: must differ from the product unit for the step to apply

operands.constraints: always present

preconditions.condition: The matching mode is loose, a line unit was supplied and it differs from the product unit.
preconditions.otherwise: The step is skipped; in strict mode the caller has already fixed the unit.

procedure: Convert the wanted quantity from the product unit into the line unit, rounding down, so that only quantities the line unit can express survive.
Convert the result back from the line unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Use that figure as the new wanted quantity.
records.formula: wanted = convert( convert( wanted , product unit , line unit , down ) , line unit , product unit , half away from zero )

rounding.what: The wanted quantity expressed in the line unit, and then the figure converted back into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit on the way out, and the rounding step of the product unit on the way back.
rounding.method: Truncation towards zero on the way out, half away from zero on the way back.
rounding.step: After the wanted quantity has been clamped to the available quantity and before the serial-number check.

result.name: wanted quantity representable in the line unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the reservation-quantity computation; never stored.

edge_cases.outcome: The step is skipped entirely and the wanted quantity is unchanged.

records.name: The reservation-quantity computation when goods are taken
records.purpose: Decides how much of a demand may be promised and from which Stock Quantity records, which is the single routine that turns a shortage into a partial availability and that makes positive records absorb the negative pockets sharing their characteristics.

operands.name: wanted quantity
operands.source: the calling reservation or the distribution of a processed quantity
operands.constraints: strictly positive for this direction

operands.name: gathered records
operands.unit_or_currency: an ordered list of Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the gathering algorithm, passed the wanted quantity so that the least-packages pre-selection can run
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: available quantity over the gathered records
operands.source: the available quantity of the set, computed with negative results forbidden
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: on-hand and reserved quantity of each gathered record
operands.constraints: the on-hand quantity may be negative

operands.name: line unit
operands.source: the calling move, when one was supplied
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: matching mode
operands.constraints: always given

preconditions.condition: The wanted quantity is strictly greater than zero at the product unit's rounding step.
preconditions.otherwise: A wanted quantity of exactly zero returns an empty result, and a negative one is handled by the giving-back direction.

preconditions.condition: The product is not tracked by serial number, or the wanted quantity equals its own integer part at the product unit's step.
preconditions.otherwise: The wanted quantity is set to zero and nothing is reserved, because a fractional serial-tracked quantity can never be reserved.

procedure: Gather the candidate records, passing the wanted quantity so that the least-packages pre-selection can run.
Compute the available quantity over those records with negative results forbidden.
When the calling context carries a packaging unit and the product's category asks for full-packaging reservation, reduce the available quantity to whole packaging units.
Set the wanted quantity to the smaller of itself and the available quantity.
When the matching mode is loose, a line unit was supplied and it differs from the product unit, re-express the wanted quantity so that it is representable in the line unit.
When the product is tracked by serial number and the wanted quantity differs from its own integer part at the product unit's step, set the wanted quantity to zero.

Recompute the available quantity as the sum of the on-hand quantities of only those gathered records whose on-hand quantity is strictly positive, less the sum of the reserved quantities of every gathered record, negative records included.
Build the map of negative pockets: for every gathered record whose available quantity is strictly negative, accumulate that negative amount under the key of its Location, lot, container and owner.
Walk the gathered records in order; for each record let the takeable quantity be its available quantity and skip the record when that is less than or equal to zero.

Look up the negative pocket for the record's key; when it is non-zero, let the offset be the smaller of the pocket's absolute value and the takeable quantity, add the offset back to the pocket so that the pocket moves towards zero, and subtract the offset from the takeable quantity.
When the takeable quantity is now less than or equal to zero, skip the record.

Otherwise set the takeable quantity to the smaller of itself and the remaining wanted quantity, append the pair of the record and that quantity to the result, and reduce both the remaining wanted quantity and the available quantity by it.
Stop the walk as soon as the remaining wanted quantity is zero at the product unit's step, or the available quantity is zero at the product unit's step.
Return the list of pairs.
records.formula: available for taking = sum( on-hand over the gathered records whose on-hand > 0 ) − sum( reserved over all the gathered records ) ; negative pocket(key) = sum over the gathered records of that key whose available quantity < 0 of ( on-hand − reserved ) ; takeable(record) = ( on-hand − reserved ) − minimum( | negative pocket(key) | , on-hand − reserved ) ; taken(record) = minimum( takeable(record) , remaining wanted quantity )

rounding.what: The comparisons of the wanted quantity, of the remaining wanted quantity and of the available quantity against zero, and the two conversions of the re-expression step.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit for every comparison; the line unit's step and the packaging unit's step for the two reduction steps.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; truncation towards zero and then half away from zero for the reductions.
rounding.step: Before the walk for the clamping and the reductions, and after every pair is appended for the stopping test.

result.name: list of pairs of a Stock Quantity record and a positive quantity to take
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the line creation of a reservation and by the distribution of a processed quantity; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A negative record shares its Location, lot, container and owner with a positive record.
edge_cases.outcome: The negative pocket is subtracted from the positive record's takeable quantity before anything is reserved, so the shortage is absorbed by the goods that are really there.

edge_cases.case: A negative record's characteristics differ from every positive record, for example because one of them sits in a container.
edge_cases.outcome: No pocket applies to the positive records and they are reserved in full.

edge_cases.case: The available quantity runs out before the wanted quantity is met.
edge_cases.outcome: The walk stops and the sum of the pairs is strictly less than the wanted quantity, which makes the move partially available.

edge_cases.case: The product is tracked by serial number and a fractional quantity is wanted.
edge_cases.outcome: The wanted quantity becomes zero and the result is empty.

edge_cases.case: The wanted quantity is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: An empty result is returned before the walk begins.

Record B offers twelve, the pocket removes five leaving seven, and the smaller of seven and the remaining seven is seven, giving the single pair of record B with seven.

records.name: The reservation-quantity computation when goods are given back
records.purpose: Decides how much of an existing reservation is released and from which Stock Quantity records, and refuses to release more than was ever reserved.

operands.name: wanted quantity
operands.constraints: strictly negative for this direction; its absolute value is the quantity to give back

operands.name: gathered records
operands.unit_or_currency: an ordered list of Stock Quantity records
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: reserved quantity of each gathered record
operands.source: the reserved field of the record
operands.constraints: never negative

operands.name: product display name
operands.source: the product, used in the refusal message
operands.constraints: always available

preconditions.condition: The absolute value of the wanted quantity is not greater than the sum of the reserved quantities of the gathered records, compared at the product unit's step.
preconditions.otherwise: The calculation fails with the message that it is not possible to unreserve more products of the named product than there are in stock.

procedure: Gather the candidate records and compute the available quantity of the set exactly as for the taking direction, then clamp and re-express the wanted quantity in the same way.
Recognise the direction: the wanted quantity is strictly negative at the product unit's step.
Set the available quantity to the sum of the reserved quantities over the gathered records.
When the absolute value of the wanted quantity is strictly greater than that sum at the product unit's step, fail with the refusal message.
Walk the gathered records in order; for each record let the givable quantity be the smaller of the record's reserved quantity and the absolute remaining wanted quantity.
Append the pair of the record and the negation of the givable quantity to the result.
Increase both the remaining wanted quantity and the available quantity by the givable quantity.
Stop the walk as soon as the remaining wanted quantity is zero at the product unit's step, or the available quantity is zero at the product unit's step.
Return the list of pairs.
records.formula: available for giving back = sum( reserved over the gathered records ) ; givable(record) = minimum( reserved(record) , | remaining wanted quantity | ) ; the pair appended is ( record , − givable(record) )

rounding.what: The comparison of the absolute wanted quantity against the total reserved quantity, and the stopping tests against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the sums themselves are exact.
rounding.step: Before the walk for the refusal test, and after every pair is appended for the stopping test.

result.name: list of pairs of a Stock Quantity record and a negative quantity to give back
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the calling calculation, which lowers the reserved counters; never stored.

edge_cases.case: More is asked back than was reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The calculation fails with the message that it is not possible to unreserve more products of the named product than there are in stock, and nothing is changed.

edge_cases.case: A gathered record has nothing reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The givable quantity is zero for it and the pair carries zero, so the walk simply moves on.

edge_cases.case: Exactly the reserved total is asked back.
edge_cases.outcome: Every record is drained to zero and the walk stops when the available quantity reaches zero.

worked_examples.description: Giving back three units spread over two reserved records

records.name: Q1
Q2

worked_examples.narrative: The two records hold seven reserved in total, which covers the three asked back. The first record gives its whole two, the second gives the remaining one, and the walk stops with nothing left to give back.

worked_examples.description: Asking back more than is reserved

records.name: Q1
Q2

expected_outputs.outcome: the calculation fails and no pair is produced

worked_examples.narrative: Nine is asked back while only seven is reserved, so the refusal fires before the walk and the reserved counters are left untouched.

records.name: Increasing or decreasing an on-hand or a reserved figure
records.purpose: The single routine that writes a quantity onto the Stock Quantity records; every reservation, every completion and every count correction goes through it, which is what makes the stored figures consistent.

operands.name: product
operands.constraints: must be storable

operands.name: Location
operands.constraints: its usage must not be virtual

operands.name: on-hand delta
operands.constraints: signed; at least one of the two deltas must be given

operands.name: reserved delta
operands.constraints: signed; at least one of the two deltas must be given

operands.name: lot, container and owner
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot, a container and a Contact, each optional
operands.constraints: used as the exact characteristics of the record

operands.name: supplied incoming date
operands.source: the calling calculation, typically the date remembered when the goods left their source
operands.constraints: optional

preconditions.condition: At least one of the on-hand delta and the reserved delta is supplied.
preconditions.otherwise: The routine fails with the message that a quantity or a reserved quantity should be set.

preconditions.condition: The product is storable and the Location's usage is not virtual.
preconditions.otherwise: No Stock Quantity record may exist for that combination and the write is refused.

procedure: Gather the candidate records with strict matching.
When a lot was requested and the on-hand delta is strictly positive, narrow the gathered set to the records that carry a lot.

When a lot was requested and the on-hand delta is not strictly positive, narrow the gathered set to the records that carry a lot or whose on-hand quantity is strictly positive, so that quantity is never taken away from a lot-less record that is already negative.
Compute the incoming date to stamp with the oldest-arrival rule.

When the gathered set is non-empty, take a write lock on its first record, which the gathering order has already put in front, and use that record; otherwise create a new record carrying the product, Location, lot, container, owner and the computed incoming date.
Write the incoming date on that record, always.
When an on-hand delta was given, write the new on-hand quantity as the old one plus the delta.
When a reserved delta was given, write the new reserved quantity as the greater of zero and the old one plus the delta, so that the counter can never be driven below zero by this routine.
Return the available quantity recomputed with strict matching and negative results allowed, together with the incoming date that was stamped.
records.formula: new on-hand = old on-hand + on-hand delta ; new reserved = maximum( 0 , old reserved + reserved delta ) ; returned available quantity = strict available quantity of the set , negative results allowed

rounding.what: Nothing in the arithmetic itself; the narrowing tests compare an on-hand quantity against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit for those comparisons.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the additions are exact.
rounding.step: Before the record is chosen, when the gathered set is narrowed.

result.name: the recomputed available quantity and the stamped incoming date
result.unit_or_currency: the product unit and an instant
result.stored_or_displayed: The quantities are stored on the Stock Quantity record; the returned pair is consumed by the calling calculation, which uses a negative available quantity to decide whether other reservations must be freed.

edge_cases.case: No record matches the strict characteristics.
edge_cases.outcome: A new record is created with the computed incoming date, which is how a destination Location acquires its first record for a product.

edge_cases.case: The write lock cannot be taken because another transaction holds it.
edge_cases.outcome: A new record is created instead of waiting; the duplicate is collapsed later by the merge pass, which is why the one-record-per-characteristics invariant holds only at rest.

edge_cases.case: A reserved delta would drive the counter below zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The counter is clamped at zero, so an over-release simply empties it.

edge_cases.case: A negative on-hand delta is applied where a lot was requested and only a lot-less negative record exists.
edge_cases.outcome: That record is excluded by the narrowing, so the negative pocket is not deepened.

edge_cases.case: The recomputed available quantity comes back negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The calling calculation frees other reservations for its absolute value.

worked_examples.description: Taking four units out of a shelf during a completion
worked_examples.narrative: The completion first releases four of the reservation, taking the counter from six to two, and then removes four from the on-hand figure, taking it from six to two; the strict available quantity comes back as two less two, that is zero, so no reservation has to be freed.

worked_examples.description: A reserved delta that would go below zero
worked_examples.narrative: Three less five is minus two, which the clamp raises to zero, so the counter empties rather than turning negative.

records.name: The incoming date stamped on a Stock Quantity record
records.purpose: Fixes which arrival date survives when quantities of different ages merge onto one record, which is what keeps first in first out stable and therefore what decides which goods leave next.

operands.name: incoming dates of the gathered records
operands.source: the incoming-date field of each gathered record whose on-hand quantity is strictly positive
operands.constraints: only strictly positive records contribute

operands.name: supplied incoming date
operands.source: the calling calculation, typically the date remembered when the goods left their source Location
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: reservation bypass of the Location
operands.constraints: a Location that bypasses reservation contributes no candidate date

operands.name: current instant
operands.constraints: used only as the last fallback

preconditions.condition: The gathered set has been narrowed by the lot rules of the writing routine.
preconditions.otherwise: Dates of records that the write will not touch would compete for the stamp.

procedure: When the Location bypasses reservation, start from an empty list of candidate dates.
Otherwise start from the incoming dates of the gathered records whose on-hand quantity is strictly positive.
Append the supplied incoming date when one was given.
When the list of candidates is non-empty, take its minimum, so that the oldest arrival date wins.
When the list is empty, take the current instant.
Write that date on the record, always, whether the record already existed or was created.
records.formula: incoming date = minimum( incoming dates of the gathered records whose on-hand > 0 , together with the supplied incoming date when one was given ) ; incoming date = the current instant , when that list is empty

rounding.what: Nothing; the dates are compared and stored at their stored precision.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: incoming date
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Quantity record and read by the first in first out and last in first out orderings.

edge_cases.case: The record being written has a negative on-hand quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: Its own date is not a candidate, because only strictly positive records contribute.

edge_cases.case: The Location bypasses reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the supplied date competes; when none was supplied the current instant is stamped.

edge_cases.case: Goods of two different ages merge onto one record.
edge_cases.outcome: The older date is stamped, so the merged quantity keeps the arrival date of the oldest goods it contains.

edge_cases.case: The merge pass collapses duplicate records.
edge_cases.outcome: The surviving record takes the minimum of the group's incoming dates, by the same principle.

worked_examples.description: The completion of the second worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The goods left a record whose incoming date was the second of March; that date is carried to the destination and, with no positive record already there, it is the only candidate and is stamped as it stands.

worked_examples.description: Goods arriving onto a shelf that already holds older stock
worked_examples.narrative: The candidates are the first and the twentieth of March; the minimum is the first of March, so the merged quantity keeps the older date and leaves first under first in first out.

records.name: Changing only a reservation counter
records.purpose: Names the variant of the writing routine that moves a reserved counter without moving any goods, which is what a reservation, an unreservation and the cleaning pass use.

operands.name: product, Location, lot, container and owner
operands.unit_or_currency: the five-part key of a Stock Quantity record
operands.constraints: the same key the detail line draws from

operands.name: reserved delta
operands.constraints: signed; positive when a line is created, negative when a line is deleted or completed

preconditions.condition: No on-hand delta is supplied.
preconditions.otherwise: The full writing routine applies and the goods themselves move.

preconditions.condition: The Location does not bypass reservation for the move that owns the line.
preconditions.otherwise: No counter is raised at all, because goods coming from outside the company are not reserved.

procedure: Call the writing routine with the reserved delta alone and no on-hand delta.
Let the routine gather with strict matching, choose or create the record, stamp the incoming date and clamp the new counter at zero exactly as it does for a full write.
Change nothing else: the on-hand quantity is untouched and no goods move.
records.formula: new reserved = maximum( 0 , old reserved + reserved delta ) , with the on-hand quantity unchanged

rounding.what: Nothing in the arithmetic; the comparisons inherited from the writing routine are made at the product unit's step.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the addition is exact.
rounding.step: Inherited from the writing routine.

result.name: reserved quantity of the Stock Quantity record
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the record and shown as the reserved figure of the Location.

edge_cases.case: The delta would drive the counter below zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The counter is clamped at zero.

edge_cases.case: No record exists for the key.
edge_cases.outcome: One is created with a zero on-hand quantity and the raised counter, which the cleaning pass and the empty-record deletion will tidy up if the reservation disappears.

edge_cases.case: The Location bypasses reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: The counter is not raised at all and the cleaning pass lowers any counter it finds there to zero.

worked_examples.description: Creating a detail line of four units against a shelf
worked_examples.narrative: Creating the line raises the counter from two to six while the on-hand quantity stays at six, which is exactly the state the first worked trace of the document reaches after its two lines are created.

records.name: The already-reserved snapshot and the selected set of a reservation pass
records.purpose: Fixes which moves a reservation pass touches and freezes the figure it measures the missing quantity against, because creating a detail line immediately invalidates that figure.

operands.name: input set of Stock Moves
operands.source: the calling operation, for example the availability check of a Transfer or the propagation after a completion
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: processed quantity of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.source: the move, read before anything is changed
operands.constraints: recomputed from the detail lines, so it changes as soon as a line is created

operands.name: forced quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
