operands.source: the calling operation, when it insists on a quantity
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: status and picked flag of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: a stored status value and a yes or no flag
operands.constraints: used to select the set when no quantity is forced

preconditions.condition: The snapshot of the processed quantities is taken once, up front, before any line is created.
preconditions.otherwise: Every move after the first would measure its missing quantity against a figure the pass itself has already changed, and would reserve too little.

procedure: Record, before anything is changed, the current processed quantity of every move of the input set, and call it that move's already-reserved figure.

When no forced quantity was supplied, restrict the set to the moves that are not picked and whose status is the stored value `confirmed`, the stored value `waiting` or the stored value `partially_available`.
When a forced quantity was supplied, process every move of the input set whatever its status.

Pre-load the quantity records for the moves that have originating moves and do not bypass reservation, keyed by product, Location, lot, container and owner; that cache is what the gathering consults in strict matching.
records.formula: already reserved(move) = the move's processed quantity read before the pass begins ; selected set = { moves that are not picked and whose status is `confirmed`, `waiting` or `partially_available` } , when no quantity is forced ; selected set = the whole input set , when one is

rounding.what: Nothing at this step.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the snapshot copies the stored figures.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs while the set is selected.

result.name: the selected set of moves, their already-reserved figures and the pre-loaded record cache
result.unit_or_currency: a list of moves, quantities in each move's line unit, and a map of records
result.stored_or_displayed: Held for the duration of the pass; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A move of the input set is already picked.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded unless a quantity is forced, because a picked move is being processed by a person and must not be re-reserved underneath them.

edge_cases.case: A move is in draft, done or cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded unless a quantity is forced.

edge_cases.case: A move has originating moves and bypasses reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: Its records are not pre-loaded, because the chained branch of the reservation reads the distribution map instead.

worked_examples.description: The first two steps of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The move's processed quantity is zero, so its already-reserved figure is zero; it is not picked and its status is confirmed, so it is selected for processing.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch for the pre-loaded record cache

records.name: The missing quantity of a move in a reservation pass
records.purpose: Gives the quantity a move still has to promise, expressed first in the document's own unit and then in the product unit, which is the figure every branch of the reservation works from.

operands.name: move demand
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.source: the demand field of the Stock Move
operands.constraints: may be zero or negative

operands.name: already-reserved figure
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.source: the snapshot taken at the start of the reservation pass
operands.constraints: frozen before any line is created

operands.name: forced quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: when supplied it replaces the subtraction entirely

operands.name: line unit and product unit
operands.constraints: must belong to the same category

preconditions.condition: The already-reserved figure is the snapshot, not a freshly read processed quantity.
preconditions.otherwise: The figure would already include the lines this pass has created and the move would reserve too little.

procedure: When no quantity was forced, subtract the already-reserved figure from the move's demand, both in the line unit.
When a quantity was forced, take that forced quantity as the missing quantity in the line unit.
Compare the missing quantity in line units against zero at the product unit's rounding; when it is less than or equal to zero, mark the move as fully assigned and move on to the next move.
Otherwise convert the missing quantity from the line unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero, and use that figure for the rest of the processing.
records.formula: missing in line units = move demand − already reserved , or the forced quantity when one was supplied ; missing = convert( missing in line units , line unit , product unit , half away from zero )

rounding.what: The conversion of the missing quantity from the line unit into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: After the subtraction and after the test against zero, once per move.

result.name: missing quantity
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the branch of the reservation that applies to the move; never stored.

edge_cases.case: The move is already fully reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The missing quantity is zero or less and the move is marked fully assigned without any record being read.

edge_cases.case: A quantity is forced.
edge_cases.outcome: The demand and the snapshot are ignored entirely and the forced quantity is used as it stands.

edge_cases.case: The demand is zero and nothing is forced.
edge_cases.outcome: The branch that takes goods from stock marks the move fully assigned at once.

edge_cases.case: The line unit differs from the product unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion rounds half away from zero at the product unit's step, so a demand that is not representable in the product unit is rounded before anything is gathered.

worked_examples.description: The third step of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve less nothing already reserved is twelve, which is positive at the product unit's rounding, and the line unit equals the product unit so the conversion leaves it at twelve.

worked_examples.description: A move demanding two dozen of which one dozen is already reserved
worked_examples.narrative: One dozen is still missing, which converts to twelve product units, and it is that figure the gathering and the reservation-quantity computation work with.

records.name: Reserving a move that bypasses reservation
records.purpose: Creates the detail lines of a move whose goods come from outside the reserved world, such as a receipt from a vendor or a return from a customer, where nothing is promised and the lines only record what will arrive.

operands.name: missing quantity
operands.source: the missing-quantity computation of the reservation pass
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: distribution map
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from the four-part key to a quantity in the product unit
operands.source: what the parents brought and the siblings took, when the move has originating moves
operands.constraints: holds only strictly positive entries

operands.name: tracking mode of the product
operands.constraints: decides whether one line per unit is produced

operands.name: lot policy of the Operation Type
operands.source: the Operation Type of the Transfer
operands.constraints: creating lots and using existing lots are separate choices

preconditions.condition: The source Location's usage is vendor, customer, inventory loss or production, or the product is not storable.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the two reserving branches applies instead.

procedure: When the move has originating moves, compute what they brought and what the siblings took and walk the resulting map.

For each key of the map that still offers an available quantity, create one line for the smaller of the remaining missing quantity and that available quantity, forcing that key's Location, lot, lot name, owner and container onto the line, and reduce the missing quantity; stop when it reaches zero.

When a missing quantity remains, the product is tracked by serial number and the Operation Type allows creating or using lots, create one line of exactly one unit for each whole unit of the missing quantity.

Otherwise, when a missing quantity remains, look for a line of this move that can absorb it: the same unit as the move, the same source Location, the same destination Location, the same Transfer, not picked, no lot, no destination container, no source container and no owner.
When such a line exists, raise its quantity by the missing quantity converted into the line unit, rounding half away from zero.
When none exists, create a new line for the missing quantity.
Mark the move as fully assigned and as needing put-away.
records.formula: line quantity from a map key = minimum( remaining missing quantity , available quantity of that key ) ; absorbed quantity = convert( missing quantity , product unit , line unit , half away from zero ) added to the absorbing line ; number of single-unit lines for a serial-tracked product = the whole part of the missing quantity

rounding.what: The conversion of a missing quantity into the line unit when an existing line absorbs it, and the reduction of a serial-tracked missing quantity to whole units.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit for the conversion; whole units of the product unit for the serial-tracked case.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversion; truncation towards zero for the whole-unit count.
rounding.step: Once per absorbed line, and once when the single-unit lines are produced.

result.name: the move's detail lines and its status
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit or the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: The lines are stored; the move is marked fully assigned and needing put-away.

edge_cases.case: The move has no originating move.
edge_cases.outcome: The distribution map is not consulted and the whole missing quantity is created as one line, or absorbed by a matching open line.

edge_cases.case: The distribution map covers only part of the missing quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The remainder follows the serial-tracked or the plain path, so the move is still marked fully assigned.

edge_cases.case: The product is tracked by serial number and the Operation Type allows neither creating nor using lots.
edge_cases.outcome: The single-unit expansion does not apply and one plain line is produced.

edge_cases.case: No reserved counter is touched at all.
edge_cases.outcome: That is the defining property of this branch; the cleaning pass lowers any counter it finds at such a Location to zero.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of ten units from a vendor Location with no originating move
worked_examples.narrative: Nothing is promised because the goods are not yet in the company; one line of ten is created, the move is marked fully assigned and the lines are pushed through put-away.

worked_examples.description: The same receipt for a serial-tracked product with an Operation Type that creates lots
worked_examples.narrative: Three whole units give three lines of exactly one unit each, so that a serial number can be typed on each of them.

records.name: Reserving a move that takes from stock and has no originating move
records.purpose: The ordinary reservation: a move looks for the goods it needs at its source Location and promises whatever it finds, which decides whether it becomes fully assigned or only partially available.

operands.name: missing quantity
operands.source: the missing-quantity computation of the reservation pass
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: source Location of the move
operands.constraints: its usage must not bypass reservation

operands.name: supply method of the move
operands.constraints: an advanced move is skipped entirely

operands.name: taken quantity
operands.source: the reservation-quantity computation run for the missing quantity
operands.constraints: between zero and the missing quantity

preconditions.condition: The source Location's usage does not bypass reservation and the move has no originating move.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two branches applies.

preconditions.condition: The move's supply method is take from stock.
preconditions.otherwise: The move is skipped entirely, because an advanced move must wait for the move that supplies it.

procedure: When the demand is zero and no quantity was forced, mark the move as fully assigned and move on to the next move.
When the move's supply method is advanced, skip the move entirely.
Run the reservation-quantity computation for the move's product at the move's source Location with the missing quantity, loose matching and the move's line unit.
Create or extend the detail lines from the pairs it returns, and let the taken quantity be the total of those pairs.
When the taken quantity is zero at the product unit's rounding step, move on to the next move and leave the move's status as it is.
Mark the move as needing put-away.
When the missing quantity and the taken quantity are equal at the product unit's rounding step, mark the move fully assigned; otherwise mark it partially available.
When the product is tracked by serial number, set the move's serial-number count to its demand.
records.formula: taken = sum of the quantities of the pairs the reservation-quantity computation returned ; status = fully assigned when comparison( missing , taken , product unit ) = 0 , partially available when 0 < taken < missing , unchanged when taken = 0

rounding.what: The comparison of the taken quantity against zero and against the missing quantity.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: After the lines have been created, once per move.

result.name: the move's detail lines, its raised reserved counters and its status
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit and in the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: The lines and the counters are stored; the status is stored on the move.

edge_cases.case: Nothing at all is available.
edge_cases.outcome: The taken quantity is zero, no line is created and the move keeps the status it had, typically confirmed.

edge_cases.case: Only part of the missing quantity is available.
edge_cases.outcome: The move becomes partially available and the remainder is reserved by a later pass when goods arrive.

edge_cases.case: The move's supply method is advanced.
edge_cases.outcome: The move is skipped so that it does not steal the goods its own supplying move is about to deliver.

edge_cases.case: The demand is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The move is marked fully assigned without reading any record.

worked_examples.description: The reservation of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve is missing and twelve is taken in two pairs, so the two figures are equal at the product unit's rounding and the move is marked fully assigned.

worked_examples.description: The same move against a Location that offers only five
worked_examples.narrative: Five is taken out of the twelve missing, which is neither zero nor equal to the missing quantity, so the move becomes partially available.

records.name: Reserving a chained move against what its predecessors delivered
records.purpose: Makes a move of a multi-step route reserve exactly the goods its predecessor delivered, in the very Location and container it delivered them to, instead of competing for them with any other document.

operands.name: distribution map
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from the key of Location, lot, container and owner to a quantity in the product unit
operands.source: what the parents brought and the siblings took
operands.constraints: holds only strictly positive entries; may be empty

operands.name: existing detail lines of the move
operands.constraints: their quantities are subtracted from the map before it is walked

operands.name: real quantity of the move
operands.source: the move's demand converted into the product unit
operands.constraints: the ceiling of what the move may hold

operands.name: quantities already taken in this walk
operands.constraints: accumulated as the map is consumed

preconditions.condition: The source Location's usage does not bypass reservation and the move has at least one originating move.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two branches applies.

preconditions.condition: The distribution map is reduced by the move's existing lines before it is walked.
preconditions.otherwise: A second reservation pass over the same move would count the goods it already holds twice.

procedure: Compute the distribution map; when it is empty, move on to the next move.

Subtract from the map what this move has already reserved: for each existing line of the move with a non-zero quantity in the product unit, reduce the map entry for its source Location, lot, source container and owner by that quantity, when such an entry exists.

For each remaining map entry, in map order, compute the need as the move's real quantity less the sum of its existing line quantities in the product unit less the sum of the quantities already taken in this loop.
Run the reservation-quantity computation with strict matching for the smaller of the entry's quantity and the need, at the entry's Location, lot, container and owner.

Collect the line values, and remember the taken quantity under the key of the need, Location, lot, container and owner only when new line values were produced, because an update of an existing line is already reflected in the sum of the existing lines.
Create all the collected lines in one operation.

Walk the remembered taken quantities in order, skipping the zero ones; for each non-zero one mark the move as needing put-away, and when the need less the taken quantity is zero at the product unit's step mark the move fully assigned and stop the walk, otherwise mark it partially available.
records.formula: need = move real quantity − sum( existing line quantities in the product unit ) − sum( quantities already taken in this loop ) ; requested at a map entry = minimum( entry quantity , need ) ; status = fully assigned when need − taken = 0 at the product unit's step , partially available otherwise

rounding.what: The conversion of each existing line's quantity into the product unit, and the comparison of the need against the taken quantity.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversion; comparison at the step for the test.
rounding.step: Before the map is walked for the subtraction, and after each map entry has been served for the status test.

result.name: the move's detail lines, its raised reserved counters and its status
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit and the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: The lines and the counters are stored; the status is stored on the move.

edge_cases.case: The distribution map is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is reserved and the move keeps its status, because its predecessors have delivered nothing it may still claim.

edge_cases.case: A sibling move has already claimed part of what the parents brought.
edge_cases.outcome: The map has already been reduced by the sibling's lines, so the two moves never promise the same goods.

edge_cases.case: A second reservation pass runs over the same move.
edge_cases.outcome: The subtraction of the existing lines keeps the map honest and no quantity is counted twice.

edge_cases.case: The strict reservation at a map key finds less than the map promised.
edge_cases.outcome: The move becomes partially available for the shortfall, which is how a lost or a moved container shows up.

worked_examples.description: The second step of a two-step delivery whose first step delivered eight units into a container
worked_examples.narrative: The map offers eight at the exact characteristics the first step delivered to; the need is ten, so eight is requested and eight is taken, which leaves a shortfall of two and makes the move partially available.

worked_examples.description: The same move re-reserved after a second parent delivered the missing two

existing_lines.key: the output Location, no lot, container PACK0002, no owner

worked_examples.narrative: The map now offers ten, but the eight the move already holds are subtracted first, leaving two; the need is also two, so two is taken and the move becomes fully assigned without double counting.

records.name: The distribution map: what the parents brought and the siblings took
records.purpose: Computes, per exact set of characteristics, how much of what a move's predecessors delivered has not yet been claimed by that move or by its siblings, which is the quantity a chained reservation may promise.

operands.name: completed detail lines of the reachable parent moves
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit of each line
operands.source: the move's originating moves, then their destination moves, then their originating moves
operands.constraints: only completed lines count

operands.name: detail lines of the completed siblings
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit of each line
operands.source: the destination moves of this move's originating moves, minus this move itself, restricted to the done ones
operands.constraints: grouped by source characteristics

operands.name: detail lines of the open siblings
operands.source: the siblings whose status is partially available or assigned, plus those this very pass has already marked assigned or partially available
operands.constraints: their groups replace rather than add to the completed ones

operands.name: product unit
operands.constraints: every quantity is converted into it

preconditions.condition: The move has at least one originating move.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no predecessor to distribute and the map is not built.

procedure: Collect the completed moves reachable as the move's originating moves, then their destination moves, then their originating moves, which deliberately includes the sibling chains feeding the same intermediate step.
Take all their detail lines and group them by the key of destination Location, lot, destination container and owner.
For each group sum the line quantities converted into the product unit; that is the incoming side.
Take the destination moves of this move's originating moves, minus this move itself, and call them the siblings.

Among the siblings take those whose status is done, collect their detail lines grouped by the key of source Location, lot, source container and owner, and sum the quantities converted into the product unit.

Among the siblings take those whose status is partially available or assigned, plus those this very reservation pass has already marked assigned or partially available, and collect their detail lines grouped by the same key, summing the quantities already expressed in the product unit; those groups replace, and do not add to, any group of the previous step with the same key.
For each key present on the incoming side, subtract the outgoing figure of that key from the incoming figure.
Drop every key whose difference is not strictly greater than zero at the product unit's rounding step.
Return the remaining keys and quantities as the distribution map.
records.formula: incoming(key) = sum over the completed parent detail lines of that key of convert( line quantity , line unit , product unit ) ; outgoing(key) = the open siblings' sum for that key when there is one , otherwise the completed siblings' sum ; distributable(key) = incoming(key) − outgoing(key) , kept only when > 0 at the product unit's step

rounding.what: The conversion of each parent line and each completed sibling line into the product unit, and the test of each difference against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversions; comparison at the step for the test.
rounding.step: Once per line as the groups are summed, and once per key after the subtraction.

result.name: distribution map
result.unit_or_currency: a map from the four-part key to a quantity in the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Held for the duration of the reservation of one move; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A sibling is open and also has completed lines under the same key.
edge_cases.outcome: The open group replaces the completed one, so the sibling's current promise counts rather than its history.

edge_cases.case: A key exists only on the outgoing side.
edge_cases.outcome: It is ignored, because the map is built from the keys of the incoming side.

edge_cases.case: The difference is zero or negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The key is dropped and the reservation offers nothing at those characteristics.

edge_cases.case: A sibling chain feeds the same intermediate step.
edge_cases.outcome: The double hop of the collection step includes it, so goods delivered by a parallel chain are distributed too.

worked_examples.description: A first step that delivered ten units into an output Location, with one sibling already holding three
worked_examples.narrative: Ten arrived and an open sibling has already promised three of them, so seven remain distributable at exactly those characteristics.

worked_examples.description: The same figures where the sibling has instead completed its three
worked_examples.narrative: A completed sibling consumes the same three, so the distributable figure is again seven; the two sibling sources differ only in which of them wins when both exist for one key.

records.name: Creating or extending the detail lines of a reservation
records.purpose: Turns the pairs of record and quantity that the reservation-quantity computation produced into detail lines, deciding for each pair whether an existing line can absorb it without losing a fraction in the unit conversion.

operands.name: pairs of a Stock Quantity record and a quantity
operands.constraints: in gathering order

operands.name: existing detail lines of the move
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: only lines with no destination container and a product that is not serial-tracked may be candidates

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count, not a unit rounding step

operands.name: lot policy of the Operation Type
operands.source: the Operation Type of the Transfer
operands.constraints: decides whether a serial-tracked quantity is expanded into single-unit lines

preconditions.condition: At most one candidate line exists per key of source Location, lot, source container and owner.
preconditions.otherwise: The index would be ambiguous and two lines could absorb the same pair.

procedure: Build the candidate map: index every existing detail line of the move that has no destination container and whose product is not serial-tracked by its source Location, lot, source container and owner.
Merge the pairs that share the same Location, lot, container and owner so that one key produces one entry, summing their quantities.
For each merged entry, add its quantity to the running total taken.

Look up a candidate for the entry's key; when one exists, convert the entry's quantity into the candidate's line unit rounding half away from zero and then round that figure to the Product Unit precision, and convert the result back into the product unit rounding half away from zero.

When the entry's quantity and the figure converted back are equal once both are rounded to the Product Unit precision, increase the candidate's quantity by the figure in line units and go on to the next entry.

Otherwise, when the product is tracked by serial number and the Operation Type allows creating or using lots, produce one new line of exactly one unit per whole unit of the entry's quantity, each carrying the record's Location, lot, container and owner.
Otherwise produce one new line for the entry's quantity, carrying the record's Location, lot, container and owner.
Create all the produced lines in one operation, which is what raises the reserved counters.
records.formula: line units = round to digits( convert( quantity , product unit , candidate line unit , half away from zero ) , Product Unit precision ) ; back = convert( line units , candidate line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) ; the candidate absorbs the entry when round to digits( quantity , Product Unit precision ) = round to digits( back , Product Unit precision )

rounding.what: The quantity expressed in the candidate's line unit, the figure converted back into the product unit, and the equality test between the two.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit and of the product unit for the two conversions; the `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, for the rounding and for the equality test.
rounding.step: Once per merged entry, before the decision to absorb or to create.

result.name: the created or extended detail lines and the total taken
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's unit, and the total in the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: The lines are stored; the total taken is returned to the reservation branch, which uses it to set the move's status.

edge_cases.case: The entry's quantity cannot be expressed exactly in the candidate's line unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The round trip does not return the original figure at the Product Unit precision, so a new line is created in the product unit instead of corrupting the candidate.

edge_cases.case: Two pairs share the same characteristics.
edge_cases.outcome: They are merged into one entry before the candidate is looked up, so one key never produces two lines.

edge_cases.case: The candidate carries a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not indexed at all, so a packed line is never enlarged by a later reservation.

edge_cases.case: The product is serial-tracked.
edge_cases.outcome: No line is a candidate and each whole unit becomes its own line of exactly one unit, provided the Operation Type allows creating or using lots.

worked_examples.description: The line creation of the first worked trace of the document

pairs.key: shelf A, no lot, no container, no owner
shelf B, no lot, container PACK0001, no owner

worked_examples.narrative: There is no existing line, so no candidate; the two pairs have different keys and are not merged; two lines are created and creating them raises the counters of the two records to six and eight.

worked_examples.description: An entry of five product units offered to a candidate line expressed in dozens
worked_examples.narrative: Five product units are nought point four two dozen once rounded to two digits, which converts back to five point nought four rather than five, so the candidate may not absorb the entry and a new line is created instead.

records.name: What creating a detail line does
records.purpose: Specifies the side effects of inserting a Stock Move Line, which is the only place a reserved counter is raised and, on a completed Transfer, the only place goods move outside the completion algorithm.

operands.name: line values
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of field values including a quantity
operands.source: the reservation, the distribution of a processed quantity, the serial-number generation or a person typing in the detail screen
operands.constraints: must carry a product and a quantity

operands.name: quantity in the product unit
operands.source: the line's quantity converted from its own unit
operands.constraints: must not be negative

operands.name: move of the line
operands.source: the line values, or resolved from the Transfer
operands.constraints: may be absent, in which case one is found or created

operands.name: picked quantity record
operands.source: the calling context when a person picked a record in the screen
operands.constraints: optional

preconditions.condition: The line's quantity is not negative.
preconditions.otherwise: The creation is refused with the message that negative quantities may not be entered.

preconditions.condition: For a serial-tracked product the quantity in the product unit is zero or exactly one.
preconditions.otherwise: The creation is refused with the message that only one unit of a product with a unique serial number may be processed.

procedure: Stamp the company from the move, or failing that from the Transfer; inherit the move's picked flag when none was given; when a quantity record was picked in the screen, copy its product, lot, container, Location and owner onto the line.
Insert the rows.

For each new line that has no move: when its Transfer is not done, link it to an existing move of the same Transfer and product, preferring one whose processed quantity is still below its real quantity; when none exists, or when the Transfer is already done, create a move for it with a demand of zero, or for a done Transfer with the line's quantity as demand, already in the Transfer's status.

For each new line whose status is not done, decide whether it must reserve: when the line has a move it must reserve exactly when that move does not bypass reservation; when it has no move it must reserve exactly when the product is storable and the Location does not bypass reservation.

When it must reserve and its quantity in the product unit is non-zero, raise the reserved counter for the product, source Location, lot, source container and owner by that quantity, and mark the move for status recomputation.
Recompute the statuses of the marked moves.

For each new line whose status is done, because it was added onto an already completed Transfer, move the quantity immediately: decrease the source, compensate lot-less negatives when needed, increase the destination, then unreserve and re-reserve the downstream moves.
records.formula: reserved counter(product , source Location , lot , source container , owner) increases by convert( line quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) , when the line must reserve and that figure is non-zero

rounding.what: The conversion of the line's quantity into the product unit before the counter is raised.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, at the moment the counter is raised.

result.name: the inserted Stock Move Line, the raised reserved counter and possibly a created Stock Move
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit and in the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: All of it is stored; the move's status is recomputed as a consequence.

edge_cases.case: The line is created on an open Transfer with no move.
edge_cases.outcome: A move of the same Transfer and product is found, preferring one not yet fully processed, or a move with a demand of zero is created.

edge_cases.case: The line is created on a Transfer that is already done.
edge_cases.outcome: A move is created with the line's quantity as its demand, already in the done status, and the goods move immediately.

edge_cases.case: The move bypasses reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: No counter is raised at all.

edge_cases.case: The quantity in the product unit is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: No counter is raised, but the line still exists and can be filled in later.

worked_examples.description: Creating the second line of the first worked trace of the document

inputs.line: eight units from shelf B inside the container PACK0001

worked_examples.narrative: The line must reserve because the move does not bypass reservation, so eight is added to the counter of the record at exactly the line's source characteristics and the move's status is recomputed.

worked_examples.description: Adding a line of two units to a Transfer that is already done
worked_examples.narrative: Because the Transfer is done, a move is created with the line's quantity as its demand in the done status, and the two units are taken from the source and put into the destination at once.

records.name: Put-away after a reservation pass
records.purpose: States that every move a reservation pass marked as needing put-away has its detail lines directed to their final shelves, so that a reservation and a placement always happen together.

operands.name: moves marked as needing put-away
operands.source: the three branches of the reservation, each of which sets the marker when it created or extended a line
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: detail lines of those moves
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: the lines that are pushed through the put-away selection

operands.name: suppression of put-away
operands.constraints: a screen that is about to rewrite the destination Locations itself suppresses it

preconditions.condition: The move was marked as needing put-away by its reservation branch.
preconditions.otherwise: Its lines keep the destination Location they already carry.

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not forbid put-away.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is placed at all.

procedure: Collect the moves that the reservation pass marked as needing put-away.

Push the detail lines of every such move through the application of put-away to a set of detail lines, which groups them by their outermost destination container and resolves a Location for each group or each line.
Do nothing when the calling context forbids put-away.
records.formula: for every move marked as needing put-away: its detail lines are passed to the application of put-away , which writes a destination Location on each of them

rounding.what: Nothing here; the put-away selection applies its own rounding inside the occupancy and the capacity check.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, inside the selection.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step, inside the selection.
rounding.step: Only inside the selection of each line or group.

result.name: the destination Locations of the reserved lines
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Move Lines.

edge_cases.case: The branch that bypasses reservation created the lines.
edge_cases.outcome: It marks the move as needing put-away as well, so goods arriving from outside are placed exactly like reserved goods.

edge_cases.case: The chained branch reserved nothing at a map entry.
edge_cases.outcome: It does not mark the move for that entry, so no put-away runs for it.

edge_cases.case: Put-away is suppressed by the calling context.
edge_cases.outcome: The lines keep the destination Location of their move.

worked_examples.description: The eighth step of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Both lines are pushed through the put-away selection, which finds no rule at the customer Location, so both keep it.

records.name: Whole-container detection after a reservation pass
records.purpose: States that the containing Transfer re-examines its containers after every reservation, so that a container whose whole contents have just been reserved travels as a container.

operands.name: containing Transfer
operands.source: the moves of the reservation pass
operands.constraints: the detection runs on it as a whole

operands.name: suppression of the detection
operands.constraints: set when the backorder moves of a completion are confirmed

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not suppress the whole-container detection.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is re-examined, which is what keeps the containers of a Transfer being validated from being disturbed while its backorder moves are confirmed.

procedure: After every reservation pass, unless the calling context explicitly suppresses it, re-run the whole-container detection on the containing Transfer.
Let that detection group the Transfer's detail lines by source container, test each group against the whole-container test, and mark the qualifying groups as entire packages.
Let it finish by running the container promotion on the destination containers of all the Transfer's lines.
records.formula: after every reservation pass: the containing Transfer re-runs the whole-container detection , unless the calling context suppresses it

rounding.what: Nothing here; the whole-container test applies its own comparison.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision, inside the test.
rounding.method: A zero test on the difference at that precision, inside the test.
rounding.step: Only inside the whole-container test of each group.

result.name: the destination containers and entire-package flags of the Transfer's lines
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Move Lines and on the containers.

edge_cases.case: The detection is suppressed.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is marked, which is the case when the backorder moves created during a completion are confirmed.

edge_cases.case: A reservation has just completed a container's contents.
edge_cases.outcome: The group now passes the whole-container test and the container is taken over as an entire package.

edge_cases.case: The container's type is reusable.
edge_cases.outcome: It is never taken over, whatever the reservation did.

worked_examples.description: The ninth step of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The detection runs after the reservation, finds that the single line claims eight of the nine the container holds, and marks nothing.

records.name: Unreserving a set of moves
records.purpose: Releases the promises a set of moves made, deleting their open detail lines and lowering the reserved counters, while protecting the lines a person has already picked.

operands.name: input set of Stock Moves
operands.source: the calling operation, for example the unreserve action of a Transfer or a change of demand
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: status of each move
operands.constraints: decides whether the move is skipped or refused

operands.name: picked flag of each move and of each line
operands.constraints: a picked line survives

operands.name: quantity of each line in the product unit
operands.source: the line's quantity converted from its own unit
operands.constraints: used to lower the counter

preconditions.condition: No move of the set is done, except a done move whose destination Location's usage is inventory loss.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation fails with the message that a stock move that has been set to done may not be unreserved.

procedure: Build the set of moves to unreserve: skip a move that is cancelled; skip a move that is done and whose destination Location's usage is inventory loss; skip a move that is picked.
Fail for any other done move with the message that a stock move that has been set to done may not be unreserved.
Walk the detail lines of those moves; keep a line that is picked and remember its move as not to be recomputed; schedule every other line for deletion.

Delete the scheduled lines; each deletion lowers the reserved counter for the line's product, source Location, lot, source container and owner by its quantity in the product unit, using strict matching, but only when the line has a move and that move does not bypass reservation for the line's source Location.
Recompute the status of every unreserved move except the ones remembered, because deleting a line already triggers the recomputation for the others.
records.formula: reserved counter(product , source Location , lot , source container , owner) decreases by convert( line quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) , for every deleted line whose move does not bypass reservation

rounding.what: The conversion of each deleted line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per deleted line, at the moment the counter is lowered.

result.name: the surviving detail lines, the lowered reserved counters and the recomputed statuses
result.stored_or_displayed: The deletions and the counters are stored; the statuses are stored on the moves.

edge_cases.case: A move of the set is cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped silently.

edge_cases.case: A move is done and its destination is an inventory-loss Location.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped silently, which is what lets a count adjustment be reverted.

edge_cases.case: A move is picked.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped entirely, so a person's work is not undone underneath them.

edge_cases.case: Some lines of a move are picked and others are not.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the unpicked ones are deleted and the move is not recomputed a second time.

edge_cases.case: The move bypasses reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: The lines are still deleted but no counter is lowered, because none was ever raised.

worked_examples.description: Unreserving the move of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Both lines are open and are deleted; the counter of the first record falls from six to two, keeping the two units another document had reserved, and the counter of the second falls to zero; the move goes back to confirmed.

records.name: Changing an open detail line
records.purpose: Keeps the reserved counters in step when a person edits the characteristics or the quantity of a line that has not yet been completed, by releasing the old promise in full and making the new one up to what exists.

operands.name: current quantity of the line in the product unit
operands.constraints: the figure the old promise was made for

operands.name: new quantity in the product unit
operands.source: the written quantity converted from the written unit, or the line's current figure when neither is being written
operands.constraints: must not be negative

operands.name: old characteristics
operands.unit_or_currency: a Location, a lot, a container and an owner
operands.constraints: the key the counter was raised on

operands.name: new characteristics
operands.unit_or_currency: a Location, a lot, a container and an owner
operands.constraints: the key the counter is raised on next

preconditions.condition: The line is not done and the product is storable.
preconditions.otherwise: The replay of a completed line applies instead, or nothing at all happens for a product that holds no stock.

preconditions.condition: The new quantity in the product unit is not negative.
preconditions.otherwise: The write fails with the message that reserving a negative quantity is not allowed.

procedure: Recognise the trigger: any of the source Location, destination Location, lot, source container, destination container, owner or unit changes, the destination container alone excepted, or the quantity changes.

Compute the new quantity in the product unit: when the quantity or the unit is being written, convert the new quantity from the new unit rounding half away from zero; otherwise keep the line's current figure.
Lower the reserved counter for the old Location, lot, container and owner by the line's current quantity in the product unit, releasing the old promise in full.
Raise the reserved counter for the new key by the new quantity, unless the move bypasses reservation for the new source Location.
Let the writing routine clamp the counter at zero, so that an over-reservation simply reserves what exists.
Mark the move for status recomputation when the quantity or the unit actually changed.
records.formula: reserved counter(old key) decreases by the line's current quantity in the product unit ; reserved counter(new key) increases by convert( new quantity , new line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) , clamped at zero from below

rounding.what: The conversion of the written quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Before the old promise is released, so that the new figure is known when the new promise is made.

result.name: the rewritten line and the two adjusted reserved counters
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit and the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the line and on the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: Only the destination container changes.
edge_cases.outcome: No counter is touched at all, because the destination container does not take part in the source key.

edge_cases.case: The new key has less stock than the new quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The counter is raised only as far as the goods exist; the clamp of the writing routine absorbs the difference.

edge_cases.case: The new source Location bypasses reservation.
edge_cases.outcome: The old promise is released and no new one is made.

edge_cases.case: The new quantity converts to a negative figure.
edge_cases.outcome: The write fails with the message that reserving a negative quantity is not allowed and nothing is changed.

worked_examples.description: Moving a promise of four units from one shelf to another

inputs.old_key: shelf A, no lot, no container, no owner
inputs.new_key: shelf C, no lot, no container, no owner

worked_examples.narrative: The old promise of four is released in full, taking the first counter from six to two, and four is promised at the new shelf, taking its counter from nothing to four.

worked_examples.description: Raising the quantity of a line beyond what the Location holds

inputs.key: shelf A, no lot, no container, no owner

expected_outputs.comment: the counter is raised by the written figure and the cleaning pass and the freeing of reservations settle the excess

worked_examples.narrative: The old four is released, leaving two, and nine is promised, giving eleven; the clamp only prevents a negative counter, so an over-promise is resolved by the reservation-freeing and the cleaning pass rather than by refusing the write.

records.name: Changing a completed detail line
records.purpose: Replays a movement that has already happened when a person unlocks a completed Transfer and edits a line, strictly undoing the original movement before applying the new one so that no figure is patched by a difference.

operands.name: current quantity of the line in the product unit
operands.constraints: the quantity that actually moved

operands.name: new quantity in the product unit
operands.constraints: must not be negative

operands.name: source and destination Locations and containers
operands.source: the line, before and after the write
operands.constraints: the destination container is used when the destination is addressed

operands.name: remembered incoming date
operands.source: returned by the writing routine when the destination is decreased
operands.constraints: carried back onto the source

preconditions.condition: The line's move is done and the product is storable.
preconditions.otherwise: The rules for an open line apply instead.

preconditions.condition: The Transfer has been unlocked by a person.
preconditions.otherwise: The processed quantities of a locked done Transfer are not editable.

procedure: Undo the original movement: decrease the destination, using the destination container, by the line's current quantity in the product unit, and remember the incoming date that comes back.
Increase the source by the same quantity, stamping that remembered date.
Remember the downstream moves that are neither done nor cancelled.
Post a note on the Transfer describing the change.
Apply the write.
Redo the movement with the new values: decrease the source by the new quantity in the product unit, then increase the destination, with the destination container, by the same quantity.
When the available quantity at the source came back negative, free other reservations for the absolute value of that negative figure.
Re-check the serial-number uniqueness constraint.
Unreserve and re-reserve the remembered downstream moves.
records.formula: undo: destination on-hand decreases by the old quantity in the product unit and source on-hand increases by the same ; redo: source on-hand decreases by the new quantity in the product unit and destination on-hand increases by the same ; reservations freed = | negative available quantity returned at the source |

rounding.what: The conversion of the old and the new quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once for the undo and once for the redo; the two are never combined into a single difference.

result.name: the rewritten line, the corrected on-hand quantities and the re-reserved downstream moves
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the line, on the Stock Quantity records and on the downstream moves.

edge_cases.case: The new quantity is larger than the old one.
edge_cases.outcome: The redo may drive the source available quantity negative, which frees other reservations for the difference.

edge_cases.case: The line's Locations are changed as well as its quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The undo uses the old Locations and the redo uses the new ones, because the write is applied between them.

edge_cases.case: The new quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The undo restores the source and the redo moves nothing; the line survives with a zero quantity, which is the supported way to reverse a completed line.

edge_cases.case: A downstream move had already reserved the goods.
edge_cases.outcome: It is unreserved and re-reserved after the replay, so its promise follows the corrected figures.

worked_examples.description: Correcting a completed line from four units to three
worked_examples.narrative: The undo puts the four units back on the source and removes them from the destination; the write then applies; the redo takes three from the source and puts three into the destination, so the net effect of the correction is one unit returned to the source.

records.name: Re-stamping the date of a detail line on a write
records.purpose: Fixes the two situations in which a write moves a line's date to the present, so that the date always marks the instant the line last became more real rather than the instant of any edit.

operands.name: picked flag before and after the write
operands.source: the line and the written values
operands.constraints: a change from not picked to picked is one of the two triggers

operands.name: quantity in the product unit before and after the write
operands.source: the line and the written values
operands.constraints: an increase on an already picked line is the other trigger

operands.name: status of the line
operands.constraints: draft, cancelled and done lines are never re-stamped this way

operands.name: explicitly written date
operands.constraints: when present it wins and no automatic stamping occurs

preconditions.condition: No date is being written explicitly in the same operation.
preconditions.otherwise: The explicit value wins and no automatic re-stamping occurs.

preconditions.condition: The unit, the quantity or the picked flag is being written.
preconditions.otherwise: The date is left alone.

procedure: Re-stamp the line's date with the current instant when the line is becoming picked while it was not.
Re-stamp the line's date with the current instant when the line is already picked and the new quantity in the product unit is strictly greater than the old one.
Leave the date unchanged in every other case, including a decrease of the quantity on a picked line.
Never re-stamp a line whose status is draft, cancelled or done by this rule.
records.formula: line date = the current instant , when ( the line becomes picked while it was not ) or ( the line is already picked and new quantity in the product unit > old quantity in the product unit ) ; line date unchanged , otherwise

rounding.what: The comparison of the new quantity against the old one, which is made after both have been converted into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversions; a strict comparison for the test.
rounding.step: Once per write, before the date is decided.

result.name: line date
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Move Line and read by the traceability walk and by the put-away rule that looks for the most recently used Location.

edge_cases.case: The quantity of a picked line is reduced.
edge_cases.outcome: The date is unchanged, because the line has not become more real.

edge_cases.case: The line is not picked and its quantity rises.
edge_cases.outcome: The date is unchanged; only a picked line is re-stamped on an increase.

edge_cases.case: The line's status is done.
edge_cases.outcome: No automatic re-stamping occurs; the completion itself stamps the date of every surviving line.

edge_cases.case: A date is written together with a quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The explicit value is kept.

worked_examples.description: A picker ticks a line as picked
worked_examples.narrative: The line becomes picked while it was not, which is the first trigger, so its date moves to the current instant even though the quantity did not change.

worked_examples.description: A picker raises the quantity of an already picked line
worked_examples.narrative: The line is already picked and its quantity in the product unit rises from four to six, which is the second trigger.

worked_examples.description: A picker lowers the quantity of an already picked line
worked_examples.narrative: The quantity falls, so neither trigger fires and the date stands.

records.name: Freeing other reservations when a movement drives a Location negative
records.purpose: Takes back the promises other documents made for goods that no longer exist, choosing the victims in a fixed order so that the document at hand is robbed first and the latest-promised documents next.

operands.name: quantity to free
operands.source: the absolute value of the negative available quantity returned at the source key
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: product, Location, lot, container and owner
operands.source: the movement that drove the figure negative
operands.constraints: the exact characteristics whose availability went negative

operands.name: untouchable line identifiers
operands.source: the calling calculation, plus the current line
operands.constraints: every line already processed in a completion loop is in the set

operands.name: candidate lines
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.source: the open detail lines matching the key exactly
operands.constraints: not done, not cancelled, not picked, strictly positive in the product unit

preconditions.condition: The current move does not bypass reservation for that Location.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is done at all, because no promise was ever made there.

procedure: Add the current line's identifier to the untouchable set.
When the current move bypasses reservation for that Location, do nothing.

Search the candidate lines: status neither done nor cancelled; exactly this product, lot, Location, owner and source container; quantity in the product unit strictly greater than zero; not picked; identifier not in the untouchable set.

Sort the candidates: first those that belong to the current Transfer, then by the Transfer's scheduled date descending, falling back to the move's date and to zero when there is neither, then by identifier descending.
Walk the sorted candidates; for each one remember its move as needing re-reservation.

When the candidate's quantity in the product unit is less than or equal to the quantity still to free, subtract it from that quantity and schedule the whole candidate for deletion, stopping as soon as nothing is left to free.
Otherwise reduce the candidate's quantity by the quantity still to free converted into the candidate's own unit, rounding half away from zero, and stop.
Reset to take from stock the supply method of every move that owned a deleted candidate and of every move remembered, and clear their originating links.
Delete the scheduled candidates.
Re-run the reservation on the remembered moves, walking them in reverse order.
records.formula: quantity still to free = | negative available quantity | ; for each candidate in order: when its quantity in the product unit ≤ quantity still to free , quantity still to free = quantity still to free − candidate quantity and the candidate is deleted ; otherwise candidate quantity = candidate quantity − convert( quantity still to free , product unit , candidate line unit , half away from zero ) and the walk stops

rounding.what: The conversion of the remaining quantity to free into the unit of the candidate that is only partly reduced.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the candidate's own line unit.
rounding.step: Once, on the last candidate touched.

result.name: the deleted and reduced candidate lines, the lowered reserved counters and the re-reserved moves
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the product unit and in each candidate's line unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the lines, on the Stock Quantity records and on the moves.

edge_cases.case: A candidate is picked.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded from the search, so a person's own work is never taken away.

edge_cases.case: No candidate exists.
edge_cases.outcome: The negative figure stands and the Location keeps a negative quantity record until goods arrive.

edge_cases.case: The victims' own re-reservation drives another key negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The routine recurses, and every visited line has been added to the untouchable set carried into the recursion, so the recursion terminates.

edge_cases.case: Two candidates share a scheduled date.
edge_cases.outcome: The higher identifier is robbed first.

edge_cases.case: A candidate belongs to the current Transfer.
edge_cases.outcome: It is robbed before any candidate of another document, whatever the dates.

worked_examples.description: An over-delivery of three units at a shelf that another document had fully reserved
worked_examples.narrative: The line of the current Transfer is robbed first and is deleted whole, freeing two; one remains to free, which is taken from the later-scheduled line by reducing it from five to four; both owning moves are reset to take from stock and re-reserved.

records.name: Writing the processed quantity of a move
records.purpose: Checks that a quantity a person types is representable at the general decimal precision and decides whether the detail lines must be enlarged or reduced to match it.

operands.name: new processed quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: must equal itself rounded to the Product Unit precision

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count, not a unit rounding step

operands.name: quantities of the existing detail lines
operands.constraints: converted into the move's line unit without rounding

operands.name: product display name
operands.source: the product, used in the refusal message
operands.constraints: always available

preconditions.condition: The move is not cancelled.
preconditions.otherwise: The write fails with the message that a cancelled stock move may not be changed and that a new line should be created instead.

preconditions.condition: The written value equals itself rounded to the Product Unit precision.
preconditions.otherwise: The error about not respecting the rounding precision defined on the system is collected for that move and the move is skipped.

procedure: For each move, round the written quantity to the Product Unit precision, rounding half away from zero.
When the rounded figure differs from the written value at that precision, collect the error about the rounding precision defined on the system, naming the product's display name, and skip the move.
Compute the difference between the written quantity and what the detail lines actually add up to, converting each line's quantity into the move's line unit without any rounding.
When the difference is strictly positive, run the distribution of a processed quantity with the move's whole new quantity.
When the difference is strictly negative, run the reduction of a processed quantity with the absolute difference.
When any error was collected, fail with all of them joined by line breaks.
records.formula: rounded = round to digits( new quantity , Product Unit precision ) ; the write is refused for that move when rounded ≠ new quantity ; delta = new quantity − sum over the lines of convert( line quantity , line unit , move line unit , none )

rounding.what: The check that the written quantity is representable; the conversion of each line into the move's line unit is deliberately not rounded.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, for the check; no rounding at all for the conversions inside the difference.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the check; none for the conversions.
rounding.step: The check first, once per move; the difference afterwards, from unrounded conversions.

result.name: the move's processed quantity and its rebuilt detail lines
result.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
result.stored_or_displayed: The processed quantity is recomputed from the lines and stored; the lines themselves are created, enlarged, reduced or deleted.

edge_cases.case: The written value has more decimals than the general precision allows.
edge_cases.outcome: The error about the rounding precision defined on the system is collected and that move is skipped, while the other moves of the same write are still processed.

edge_cases.case: The lines already add up to exactly the written quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference is zero, neither the distribution nor the reduction runs and the lines are untouched.

edge_cases.case: Several moves are written at once and more than one fails the check.
edge_cases.outcome: All the messages are joined by line breaks into a single failure.

edge_cases.case: The move is cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: The write is refused outright.

worked_examples.description: Raising a processed quantity from four to seven with a general precision of two digits

expected_outputs.branch: the distribution of a processed quantity runs with the whole new quantity of 7.0

worked_examples.narrative: Seven rounds to seven at two digits so the check passes; the lines add up to four, so the difference is three, which is positive, and the distribution is run with the whole figure of seven rather than with the difference.

worked_examples.description: A value with three decimals written while the general precision is two digits

expected_outputs.outcome: the error about the rounding precision defined on the system is collected and the move is skipped

worked_examples.narrative: One point nought nought five rounds half away from zero to one point nought one, which differs from the written value, so the write is refused for that move.

records.name: Distributing a processed quantity over the detail lines
records.purpose: Rebuilds the detail lines of a move so that they add up to a target quantity, enlarging the lines that can still draw from their own records before reserving anywhere else and only then creating stock out of nothing.

operands.name: target quantity
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.source: the write of the processed quantity
operands.constraints: converted once into the product unit without rounding

operands.name: existing detail lines
operands.constraints: walked in order; a negative line is skipped

operands.name: destination container of each line
operands.constraints: a line that already carries one is never enlarged or reduced here

operands.name: records already consumed
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the enlargement attempts of the first walk
operands.constraints: must not be used twice

preconditions.condition: The target quantity is strictly greater than what the lines currently add up to.
preconditions.otherwise: The reduction of a processed quantity applies instead.

procedure: Convert the target quantity once into the product unit without rounding and call it the remaining quantity; keep the original figure as the total.
Walk the existing detail lines in order; let the line quantity be the line's own quantity and skip the line when that is negative.
Convert the line quantity into the product unit without rounding when the line's unit differs from the product unit.
When the remaining quantity, expressed back in the move's line unit, is zero, schedule the line for deletion and continue.

When the line quantity is strictly greater than the remaining quantity, set the line's quantity to the remaining quantity, converted into the line's own unit without rounding when the units differ, set the remaining quantity to zero and continue.
When the line already has a destination container, subtract the line quantity from the remaining quantity and continue without touching the line.

Otherwise subtract the smaller of the remaining quantity and the line quantity from the remaining quantity; when the remaining quantity, expressed in the move's line unit, is now zero or less, continue.

Try to enlarge the line: run the reservation-quantity computation with strict matching at the line's Location, lot, container and owner for the remaining quantity, let the extra be the total it offers and remember the records it touched so that they are not used twice.

When the extra is less than or equal to the remaining quantity, reduce the remaining quantity by the extra and set the line's quantity to the extra plus its own original quantity, converted into the line's unit when needed.

When the remaining quantity, expressed in the move's line unit, is still strictly positive and the move does not bypass reservation, run the reservation-quantity computation with loose matching at the move's source Location for the total.

Walk the resulting pairs, skipping the records already consumed; for each one create a new line for the smaller of the remaining quantity and the pair's quantity, reduce the remaining quantity and stop as soon as it reaches zero.

When the remaining quantity, expressed in the move's line unit, is still strictly positive, create a single line for the whole remaining quantity expressed in the move's line unit for a product that is not serial-tracked, or one line of exactly one unit in the product unit for each whole unit of the remaining quantity for a serial-tracked product.
Apply the collected create, update and delete operations to the move's line list.
Push the newly created lines through the put-away selection.
records.formula: remaining = convert( target quantity , move line unit , product unit , none ) ; per line: remaining = remaining − minimum( remaining , line quantity in the product unit ) ; enlargement: new line quantity = original line quantity + extra offered by the strict reservation ; the final line, when the remaining quantity survives both walks, carries the whole remaining quantity

rounding.what: Nothing during the walk: every conversion between the line unit, the move's line unit and the product unit is made without rounding.
rounding.precision: Not applicable during the walk; the reservation-quantity computation applies its own rounding internally.
rounding.step: No rounding at any step of the distribution itself, which is deliberate so that a fraction is not lost line after line.

result.name: the rebuilt detail lines of the move
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored; the move's processed quantity is recomputed from them.

edge_cases.case: A line already carries a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: Its quantity counts against the remaining figure but the line itself is never touched, so a packed line is not rewritten.

edge_cases.case: The remaining quantity reaches zero while lines are still to be walked.
edge_cases.outcome: Those lines are scheduled for deletion.

edge_cases.case: No stock at all can be reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: A single line for the whole remaining quantity is created, which is how an over-processing or a movement from a Location that bypasses reservation is recorded.

edge_cases.case: The product is serial-tracked and stock is missing.
edge_cases.outcome: One line of exactly one unit is created for each whole unit of the remaining quantity.

edge_cases.case: A record was already consumed by an enlargement.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped in the second walk, so the same goods are never promised twice.

worked_examples.description: Raising a processed quantity from four to seven where the existing line can draw three more from its own record

existing_lines.key: shelf A, no lot, no container, no owner

worked_examples.narrative: The target of seven leaves three after the existing four is counted; the strict reservation at the line's own characteristics offers exactly three, so the line is enlarged to seven and no new line is needed.

worked_examples.description: The same target where nothing more can be reserved anywhere
worked_examples.narrative: Neither the strict nor the loose reservation offers anything, so a single line of three is created for the shortfall and the goods will be taken from a record that goes negative at completion.

records.name: Reducing a processed quantity
records.purpose: Gives back the goods that were reserved last when a processed quantity is lowered, so that the choice the removal strategy made for the remaining quantity is preserved.

operands.name: quantity to remove
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.source: the absolute value of the negative difference computed when the processed quantity was written
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: detail lines of the move
operands.constraints: walked in reverse order of identifier

operands.name: picked flag of each line
operands.constraints: a picked line is skipped when the calling context asks to reduce only unpicked lines

operands.name: status of each line
operands.constraints: a done or cancelled line is reduced but never deleted

preconditions.condition: The quantity to remove is expressed in the move's line unit.
preconditions.otherwise: The comparisons against the line quantities would be made in the wrong unit.

procedure: Walk the detail lines in reverse order of identifier, which is the reverse of the order in which the removal strategy created them, so that the goods reserved last are given back first.
Skip a picked line when the calling context asks to reduce only unpicked lines.
Stop as soon as the quantity still to remove is zero at the move's line unit.
For the current line, compute the amount to remove from it as the smaller of its own quantity and the quantity still to remove converted into the line's unit without rounding.
Skip the line when that amount is zero at the line's unit.
When the amount equals the line's whole quantity and the line is neither done nor cancelled, schedule the line for deletion; otherwise reduce the line's quantity by that amount.
Reduce the quantity still to remove by the amount converted back into the move's line unit without rounding.
Delete the scheduled lines, each deletion lowering the reserved counters.
records.formula: amount removed from a line = minimum( line quantity , convert( quantity still to remove , move line unit , line unit , none ) ) ; quantity still to remove = quantity still to remove − convert( amount removed , line unit , move line unit , none )

rounding.what: Nothing: both conversions are made without rounding.
rounding.precision: Not applicable during the walk.
rounding.step: No rounding at any step, which keeps the total exactly equal to the quantity asked for.

result.name: the reduced and deleted detail lines and the lowered reserved counters
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's unit and in the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the lines and on the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: A line is done or cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: Its quantity is reduced but the line is never deleted.

edge_cases.case: The calling context asks to spare picked lines.
edge_cases.outcome: Picked lines are skipped entirely, so only the unpicked promise is given back.

edge_cases.case: A line's whole quantity is removed.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is deleted, which lowers the reserved counter for its exact source characteristics.

edge_cases.case: Lines that were re-created by the lot assignment sit at the end of the list.
edge_cases.outcome: They are given back first, because the walk is in reverse order of identifier.

worked_examples.description: Lowering a processed quantity of twelve to nine across two lines
worked_examples.narrative: The walk starts at the last line, removes three of its eight leaving five, and stops; the first line, which the strategy chose first, is untouched.

worked_examples.description: Lowering the same processed quantity to three
worked_examples.narrative: The last line is removed whole, which leaves one to remove; the first line is reduced from four to three and the walk stops.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that reduces only unpicked lines

records.name: The put-away selection entry point
records.purpose: Answers where arriving goods should physically go, by selecting the applicable rules of the arrival Location, ordering them by specificity and walking them until one names a Location that can accept the goods.

operands.name: arrival Location
operands.source: the destination Location of the move or of the line
operands.constraints: always given

operands.name: product
operands.constraints: always given

operands.name: quantity
operands.source: the line or the calling calculation
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: container
operands.constraints: optional

operands.name: packaging unit
operands.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure, or nothing
operands.constraints: optional; its container type is used when no container was given

operands.name: additional quantities per Location
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from Location to a quantity in the product unit
operands.source: the calling screen, to account for goods it is already sending to those Locations
operands.constraints: entries may be negative

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not forbid put-away.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is resolved and the goods keep the destination Location they already carry.

procedure: Determine the container type: the container's type when a container was given, else the packaging unit's container type when a packaging unit was given, else none.
Build the product set as the products named in the calling context together with the product given as input.
Build the category chain: when all the products of the set share exactly one category, that category and all of its ancestors; otherwise the empty set.

Select the arrival Location's own put-away rules that pass all three tests: the rule names no product or names a product of the set; the rule names no category or names a category of the chain; the rule names no container type or the determined container type is among them.
Sort the selected rules by specificity, most specific first.

Determine the candidate Locations: the Locations named in the calling context when there are any, else the arrival Location's internal descendants, the arrival Location itself included when it is internal.
When at least one rule was selected, build the occupancy map and run the rule walk.
