When the rule walk returned a Location, that is the answer.

Otherwise, when the arrival Location's usage is virtual and there is at least one candidate Location, the answer is the first candidate Location; in every other case the answer is the arrival Location itself.
records.formula: put-away Location = the first Location the rule walk returns ; = the first candidate Location , when no rule returned one and the arrival Location's usage is virtual and a candidate exists ; = the arrival Location itself , otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing in the selection itself; the capacity check compares quantities at the product unit's rounding step.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, inside the capacity check.
rounding.step: Only inside the capacity check of each candidate.

result.name: the destination Location for the arriving goods
result.stored_or_displayed: Written onto the destination Location of the detail line, or of every line of a container group.

edge_cases.case: No rule of the arrival Location passes the three tests.
edge_cases.outcome: No occupancy map is built, the walk does not run and the answer is the arrival Location itself, or its first internal descendant when it is virtual.

edge_cases.case: Every rule points at a Location that fails its capacity check.
edge_cases.outcome: The walk returns nothing and the goods stay in the arrival Location.

edge_cases.case: The products of the calling context span more than one category.
edge_cases.outcome: The category chain is empty, so only the rules that name no category can be selected.

edge_cases.case: A packaging unit is supplied but no container.
edge_cases.outcome: The packaging unit's container type is used, so a rule that names container types can still apply.

worked_examples.description: The third worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Both rules pass the three tests; the rule naming the product sorts first; the walk of that rule accepts the third bin, so the first rule is never reached and the answer is that bin.

records.name: The specificity sort of the put-away rules
records.purpose: Fixes the order in which the applicable put-away rules are tried, so that the most specific rule decides where the goods go and two implementations reach the same shelf.

operands.name: selected put-away rules
operands.source: the three applicability tests of the entry point
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: container types named by each rule
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of container types, possibly empty
operands.constraints: the first sort key

operands.name: product named by each rule
operands.constraints: the second sort key

operands.name: category named by each rule
operands.constraints: the third and fourth sort keys

operands.name: own category of the product
operands.constraints: used to tell an exact category match from an ancestor match

preconditions.condition: The rules have already passed the three applicability tests.
preconditions.otherwise: A rule that cannot apply would be given a place in the order.

procedure: Build for each rule a key of four truth values, in this order: the rule names at least one container type; the rule names a product; the rule's category is the product's own category rather than merely an ancestor of it; the rule names a category at all.
Compare the keys element by element, treating a truth value as greater than a falsehood, so that the rule that satisfies the earlier and more specific condition sorts first.
Leave rules whose keys are equal in their own order, which is priority ascending and then product.
records.formula: sort key = ( names a container type , names a product , names the product's own category , names any category ) , compared as truth values in descending order , ties keeping the rules' own order of priority ascending then product

rounding.what: Nothing.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; the result is an order, not a number.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the ordered list of put-away rules
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the rule walk; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A rule names a container type and another names a product.
edge_cases.outcome: The container-type rule sorts first, because the container type is the first element of the key.

edge_cases.case: Two rules name a category, one the product's own and one an ancestor.
edge_cases.outcome: The rule naming the product's own category sorts first.

edge_cases.case: Two rules have identical keys.
edge_cases.outcome: Their own order stands, which is priority ascending and then product.

worked_examples.description: The fifth step of the third worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Both keys start with a falsehood for the container type; the second element decides, because the rule naming the product has a truth value there while the rule naming only a category has a falsehood, so the product rule sorts first.

records.name: The occupancy map counted in containers
records.purpose: Gives, per candidate Location, the number of containers of one type that the Location already holds or is about to receive, which is the figure the container capacity of a storage category is compared against.

operands.name: candidate Locations
operands.constraints: the map is built only when at least one of them carries a storage category

operands.name: container type
operands.source: the container being put away, or the packaging unit
operands.constraints: must be determined for this variant of the map

operands.name: destination containers on open detail lines
operands.source: the open detail lines targeting each Location
operands.constraints: open means the status is not draft, done or cancelled

operands.name: containers already stored
operands.source: the containers of that type already in the Location
operands.constraints: counted once each

operands.name: additional quantities per Location
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from Location to a figure
operands.constraints: entries may be negative

operands.name: excluded line identifiers
operands.constraints: those lines are skipped

preconditions.condition: A container with a container type is being put away.
preconditions.otherwise: The occupancy map is built as a quantity of the product instead.

preconditions.condition: At least one candidate Location carries a storage category.
preconditions.otherwise: The map is not built at all, because no capacity test would consult it.

procedure: For each candidate Location, count the distinct destination containers of the given type on the open detail lines that target that Location, skipping the lines listed as excluded in the calling context.
Add the number of distinct containers of that type already stored in the Location.
Add the entry of the supplied additional-quantity map for that Location, when there is one; such an entry may be negative when a screen is recomputing put-away for lines it is about to rewrite.
records.formula: occupancy(location) = number of distinct destination containers of the type on the open detail lines targeting the location + number of distinct containers of the type already stored in the location + the additional entry for that location

rounding.what: Nothing; the figure is a count of containers.
rounding.precision: Whole containers.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: occupancy figure per candidate Location
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the capacity check; never stored.

edge_cases.case: One container is named by several open lines.
edge_cases.outcome: It is counted once, because the count is of distinct containers.

edge_cases.case: A screen recomputes put-away for the lines it is rewriting.
edge_cases.outcome: It passes the negation of those lines' own contribution, so they are not counted twice.

edge_cases.case: A line is listed as excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped entirely, which is how a line avoids counting itself against its own capacity.

records.name: The occupancy map counted in product quantity
records.purpose: Gives, per candidate Location, the quantity of the product the Location already holds or is about to receive, which is the figure the product capacity of a storage category is compared against.

operands.name: candidate Locations
operands.constraints: the map is built only when at least one of them carries a storage category

operands.name: on-hand quantities of the product's records
operands.source: the Stock Quantity records of the product in each Location
operands.constraints: summed as they stand

operands.name: quantities of the open detail lines targeting the Location
operands.source: the open detail lines whose destination Location is that Location
operands.constraints: open means the status is not draft, done or cancelled

operands.name: additional quantities per Location
operands.unit_or_currency: a map from Location to a quantity in the product unit
operands.constraints: entries may be negative

operands.name: excluded line identifiers
operands.constraints: those lines are skipped

preconditions.condition: No container with a container type is being put away.
preconditions.otherwise: The occupancy map is built as a count of containers instead.

preconditions.condition: At least one candidate Location carries a storage category.
preconditions.otherwise: The map is not built at all.

procedure: For each candidate Location, sum the on-hand quantities of the product's Stock Quantity records in that Location.
Add, for each open detail line targeting that Location and not listed as excluded, the line's quantity converted from its own unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Add the entry of the supplied additional-quantity map for that Location, when there is one; such an entry may be negative.
records.formula: occupancy(location) = sum of the on-hand quantities of the product's records in the location + sum over the open detail lines targeting the location of convert( line quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) + the additional entry for that location

rounding.what: The conversion of each open line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per open line, as the sum is accumulated.

result.name: occupancy figure per candidate Location
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the capacity check; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A Location holds nothing and is targeted by nothing.
edge_cases.outcome: Its occupancy is zero, which makes it skipped by the first pass of the rule walk and considered only by the second.

edge_cases.case: A screen recomputes put-away for lines it is about to rewrite.
edge_cases.outcome: It passes the negation of those lines' quantities so that they are not counted twice.

edge_cases.case: A line is listed as excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped, which is how a line avoids counting its own quantity against itself.

records.name: The put-away rule walk
records.purpose: Tries the applicable rules in specificity order and, within a rule that names a storage category, prefers a Location that already holds the same goods before considering any empty Location of that category.

operands.name: ordered put-away rules
operands.constraints: walked in order

operands.name: destination sublocation of each rule
operands.constraints: must be a descendant of the rule's arrival Location

operands.name: sublocation mode of each rule
operands.unit_or_currency: a choice of no sublocation, a storage category or the last used Location
operands.constraints: decides how the target is narrowed

operands.name: storage category of each rule
operands.constraints: when present, the children are narrowed to that exact category

operands.name: occupancy figure of each candidate
operands.unit_or_currency: a count of containers or a quantity in the product unit
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: already rejected Locations
operands.constraints: starts empty and grows as capacity checks fail

preconditions.condition: At least one rule was selected by the applicability tests.
preconditions.otherwise: The walk does not run at all.

procedure: Keep a set of already rejected Locations, initially empty, and take each selected rule in order.
Let the target be the rule's destination sublocation.

When the rule's sublocation mode is the last used Location, look for the most recent completed detail line whose destination Location is inside the target and whose product is this product, and, when the rule names container types, whose destination container is of one of those types, ordered by date descending and limited to one; when such a line exists, replace the target by its destination Location.
Let the children be the internal descendants of the target.

When the rule names no storage category: go to the next rule when the target is already rejected; return the target when it passes the capacity check with its own occupancy figure; otherwise go to the next rule.
When the rule names a storage category, narrow the children to the descendants whose storage category is exactly that category.

First pass: for each of those children that is not already rejected, when a container type was determined and the Location holds at least one quantity record whose container is of that type, run the capacity check and return the Location when it passes, otherwise add it to the rejected set; when no container type was determined and the Location's occupancy figure is strictly greater than zero, do the same.

Second pass: for each child whose storage category is that category and which is not already rejected, run the capacity check and return the Location when it passes, otherwise add it to the rejected set.
When every rule has been walked without returning, return nothing.
records.formula: the walk returns the first Location that passes its capacity check , preferring within a category rule the Locations whose occupancy is strictly greater than zero , or which already hold a container of the determined type

rounding.what: The test of an occupancy figure against zero, and the comparisons inside the capacity check.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per candidate, inside the first pass and inside the capacity check.

result.name: the chosen Location, or nothing
result.stored_or_displayed: Returned to the put-away entry point; never stored on its own.

edge_cases.case: A Location fails a capacity check under one rule.
edge_cases.outcome: It is added to the rejected set and is not tested again under a later rule of the same walk.

edge_cases.case: The rule's mode is the last used Location and no completed line exists.
edge_cases.outcome: The target is left as the rule's own destination sublocation.

edge_cases.case: The first pass rejects every Location that already holds the goods.
edge_cases.outcome: The second pass considers the remaining Locations of the right category, which is how goods spill onto an empty shelf.

edge_cases.case: No rule returns a Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The walk returns nothing and the entry point falls back to the arrival Location or to its first internal descendant.

records.name: The mixing policy of a capacity check
records.purpose: Decides whether a Location may hold the arriving goods at all, given the storage category's rule on mixing products, before any weight or quantity is compared.

operands.name: storage category of the Location
operands.constraints: when absent the whole check passes

operands.name: mixing policy
operands.unit_or_currency: one of the stored values for an empty Location only, for the same product only, and for mixed products
operands.constraints: always one of the three

operands.name: positive records of the Location
operands.source: the Location's records whose on-hand quantity is strictly greater than zero at the product unit's step
operands.constraints: the basis of both restrictive policies

operands.name: products named in the calling context
operands.source: the calling context, used when a container of several products is being put away
operands.constraints: used when no single product was given

operands.name: open detail lines targeting the Location
operands.source: the lines whose status is neither done nor cancelled and whose destination is that Location
operands.constraints: consulted by the same-product policy

preconditions.condition: The Location carries a storage category.
preconditions.otherwise: The capacity check passes immediately and no mixing test is made.

procedure: Take the Location's quantity records whose on-hand quantity is strictly greater than zero at the product unit's rounding step and call them the positive records.
Under the policy that admits only an empty Location, fail the check when there is at least one positive record.
Under the policy that admits only the same product, take the product given as input, or, when no product was given because a container is being put away, the products named in the calling context.
Fail the check when there is at least one positive record whose product is not that product, or when more than one product is involved.
Fail the check as well when at least one open detail line, whose status is neither done nor cancelled, targets this Location with a different product.
Under the policy that admits mixed products, make no test at all.
records.formula: empty-only policy: the check fails when the count of positive records > 0 ; same-product policy: the check fails when any positive record names another product , or more than one product is involved , or an open detail line targets the Location with another product ; mixed policy: no test

rounding.what: The test of each record's on-hand quantity against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per record, before the policy is applied.

result.name: the mixing verdict of the capacity check
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the capacity check, which stops at the first failure.

edge_cases.case: The Location holds a record whose on-hand quantity is zero or negative.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not a positive record and does not block an empty-only Location.

edge_cases.case: A container of several products is being put away.
edge_cases.outcome: The products named in the calling context are used, so the same-product policy rejects a Location that holds any of the other products.

edge_cases.case: An open line will bring a different product.
edge_cases.outcome: The same-product policy fails even though nothing of that product is physically there yet.

edge_cases.case: The Location has no storage category.
edge_cases.outcome: The whole capacity check passes and no mixing test is made.

worked_examples.description: The two bins of the third worked trace of the document under the same-product policy
worked_examples.narrative: The first bin holds only the arriving product and passes; the second holds another product and fails; the third holds nothing but is targeted by an open line of the same product, which is not a different product, so it passes.

records.name: The capacity check for a container of a known type
records.purpose: Decides whether a Location may accept one more container of a given type, testing the storage category's maximum weight against the forecasted weight and the container capacity against the occupancy.

operands.name: storage category maximum weight
operands.unit_or_currency: a weight in the unit the products are weighed in
operands.source: the storage category of the Location
operands.constraints: must be a positive number

operands.name: forecasted weight of the Location
operands.source: the Location weight calculation, excluding the detail lines listed as excluded
operands.constraints: may be negative when more is leaving than is present

operands.name: incoming package weight
operands.source: the open detail lines whose destination container is the container being put away
operands.constraints: the sum of each line's quantity in the product unit multiplied by the product's weight

operands.name: container capacity of the storage category
operands.source: the capacity of the storage category for that container type, when one exists
operands.constraints: must be a positive number

operands.name: occupancy of the Location
operands.source: the occupancy map counted in containers
operands.constraints: may be negative

preconditions.condition: A container with a container type was given.
preconditions.otherwise: The product branch of the capacity check applies.

preconditions.condition: The Location carries a storage category and has passed the mixing test.
preconditions.otherwise: The check has already passed or already failed.

procedure: Compute the Location's forecasted weight, excluding the detail lines listed as excluded in the calling context.

Compute the incoming package weight as the sum, over the open detail lines whose destination container is that container, of the line's quantity in the product unit multiplied by the product's weight.
Fail the check when the storage category's maximum weight is strictly less than the forecasted weight plus the incoming package weight.
Look for a container capacity of the storage category for that container type; when one exists and the occupancy is greater than or equal to its quantity, fail the check.
Otherwise the check passes.
records.formula: the check fails when storage category maximum weight < forecasted weight + incoming package weight ; the check also fails when a container capacity exists for the type and occupancy ≥ that capacity quantity ; incoming package weight = sum over the open lines of that destination container of ( line quantity in the product unit × product weight )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit before it is multiplied by the weight.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Half away from zero; the weights themselves are multiplied and summed exactly.
rounding.step: Once per line, while the incoming package weight is accumulated.

result.name: the capacity verdict for a container
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the rule walk, which returns the Location on a pass and rejects it on a failure.

edge_cases.case: No container capacity exists for that type.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the weight test applies.

edge_cases.case: The occupancy already equals the capacity.
edge_cases.outcome: The check fails, because the comparison is greater than or equal to, not strictly greater.

edge_cases.case: The storage category has no maximum weight.
edge_cases.outcome: The weight test cannot fail, because a maximum weight must be a positive number to exist at all.

edge_cases.case: Lines are listed as excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: They are omitted from the forecasted weight, so a container does not weigh against itself.

worked_examples.description: A shelf with a maximum weight of one hundred that already forecasts sixty, receiving a pallet holding thirty units of a product weighing one
worked_examples.narrative: Ninety is within the maximum of one hundred and the third pallet is still below the capacity of three, so the shelf accepts the container.

worked_examples.description: The same shelf when it already holds three pallets
worked_examples.narrative: The weight still fits but the occupancy has reached the capacity, so the check fails and the walk rejects the shelf.

records.name: The capacity check for a product quantity
records.purpose: Decides whether a Location may accept a quantity of a product, applying a weight test and two distinct quantity tests, one that rejects a Location already at capacity and one that rejects a Location this quantity would push over it.

operands.name: storage category maximum weight
operands.unit_or_currency: a weight in the unit the products are weighed in
operands.source: the storage category of the Location
operands.constraints: must be a positive number

operands.name: forecasted weight of the Location
operands.source: the Location weight calculation, excluding the detail lines listed as excluded
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no weight

operands.name: quantity being put away
operands.constraints: may be zero

operands.name: product capacity of the storage category
operands.source: the capacity of the storage category for that product, when one exists
operands.constraints: must be a positive number

operands.name: occupancy of the Location
operands.source: the occupancy map counted in product quantity
operands.constraints: may be negative

preconditions.condition: No container was given, or the container has no container type.
preconditions.otherwise: The container branch of the capacity check applies.

preconditions.condition: The Location carries a storage category and has passed the mixing test.
preconditions.otherwise: The check has already passed or already failed.

procedure: Compute the Location's forecasted weight, excluding the detail lines listed as excluded in the calling context.
Fail the check when the storage category's maximum weight is strictly less than the forecasted weight plus the product's weight multiplied by the quantity.
Look for a product capacity of the storage category for that product; when one exists and the occupancy is greater than or equal to its quantity, fail the check.
When one exists and the quantity plus the occupancy is strictly greater than its quantity, fail the check.
Otherwise the check passes.
records.formula: the check fails when storage category maximum weight < forecasted weight + product weight × quantity ; the check fails when a product capacity exists and occupancy ≥ that capacity quantity ; the check fails when a product capacity exists and quantity + occupancy > that capacity quantity

rounding.what: The comparisons of the three tests, and the conversions inside the forecasted weight and the occupancy.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit for the quantities; the weights are compared as they stand.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversions inside the two inputs; plain comparison for the three tests.
rounding.step: Once per test, after both inputs are known.

result.name: the capacity verdict for a product quantity
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the rule walk, which returns the Location on a pass and rejects it on a failure.

edge_cases.case: The quantity is zero and the Location is already at capacity.
edge_cases.outcome: The first quantity test still fails, which is what keeps a line with no quantity yet from being directed at a full shelf.

edge_cases.case: The Location is below capacity but the quantity would push it over.
edge_cases.outcome: The second quantity test fails.

edge_cases.case: No product capacity exists for that product.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the weight test applies.

edge_cases.case: The product carries no weight.
edge_cases.outcome: The weight test compares the maximum weight against the forecasted weight alone.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document: a storage category with a maximum weight of fifty and a product capacity of thirty
worked_examples.narrative: All three tests pass and the Location is accepted for the five units.

worked_examples.description: The same Location with twelve units put away instead
worked_examples.narrative: The weight still fits and the shelf is not yet at capacity, but the twelve units would push it to thirty-four against a capacity of thirty, so the Location is rejected and the walk continues to the next candidate.

worked_examples.description: The first bin of the third worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Eighteen units weighing a half each give a forecasted weight of nine, which is far within the maximum of forty, but six more units would take the bin to twenty-four against a capacity of twenty, so the bin is rejected.

records.name: Applying put-away to a set of detail lines
records.purpose: Runs the put-away selection over the lines of a move, grouping them by the outermost container so that a container is never split across two shelves while loose lines may each go their own way.

operands.name: detail lines to place
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of lines with quantities in their own units
operands.source: the reservation, the distribution of a processed quantity, the serial-number generation or a push rule
operands.constraints: may be empty

operands.name: outermost destination container of each line
operands.source: the destination container chain of the line
operands.constraints: the grouping key

operands.name: candidate Locations
operands.source: the internal descendants of the moves' destination Location
operands.constraints: passed to the put-away selection

operands.name: excluded lines
operands.constraints: every line of the group, so that a line never counts its own quantity as occupancy

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not forbid put-away.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is done at all and the lines keep their current destination Locations.

procedure: When the calling context forbids put-away, do nothing.
Group the lines by their destination container's outermost container.
For each group, let the candidate Locations be the internal descendants of the moves' destination Location, and let the excluded lines be the identifiers of every line of the group.

When the group's outermost container has a container type, resolve one Location for the whole group, passing the group's products in the calling context and the candidate Locations, and write that Location on every line of the group.

When the group has an outermost container but no container type, resolve a Location line by line, removing each line from the excluded set once it has been resolved, and stop early once more than one distinct Location has been used; when more than one Location was used at the end, abandon the grouping and reset every line of the group to its move's destination Location.

When the group has no container at all, resolve a Location line by line, passing the move's packaging unit so that container-type rules can apply, and removing each line from the excluded set once it has been resolved.
records.formula: one Location for the whole group , when the outermost container has a type ; one Location per line , with the group abandoned and every line reset to the move's destination Location when an untyped container would be split ; one Location per line , when there is no container

rounding.what: Nothing in the grouping itself; the put-away selection applies its own rounding inside the occupancy and the capacity check.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, inside the selection.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step, inside the selection.
rounding.step: Only inside the selection of each line or group.

result.name: the destination Location written on each detail line
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Move Line.

edge_cases.case: An untyped container's lines resolve to different Locations.
edge_cases.outcome: The grouping is abandoned and every line of the group goes back to the move's destination Location, because a container may not be split across shelves.

edge_cases.case: A line is removed from the excluded set once resolved.
edge_cases.outcome: Its quantity then counts as occupancy for the lines resolved after it, so two lines of one move do not both fill the same shelf.

edge_cases.case: The move carries a packaging unit and the lines have no container.
edge_cases.outcome: The packaging unit is passed so that a rule naming container types can still apply.

edge_cases.case: The group's container carries a type.
edge_cases.outcome: One Location is resolved for the whole group and written on every line at once.

groups: the group with no container, holding L1 and L2

worked_examples.narrative: Neither line carries a destination container, the container on the second line being a source container, so both are resolved line by line; the customer Location has no put-away rule, so both lines keep it.

worked_examples.description: A pallet whose two lines would fall on two different shelves, the pallet having no container type
worked_examples.narrative: More than one Location was used for one container, so the grouping is abandoned and both lines are reset to the move's destination Location rather than splitting the pallet.

records.name: The whole-container test
records.purpose: Decides whether a set of detail lines represents the entire contents of a container, which is what lets a Transfer move the container as a unit instead of moving its goods out of it.

operands.name: quantities of the container's records per product and lot
operands.source: the Stock Quantity records whose container is that container
operands.constraints: grouped by product and lot

operands.name: quantities of the detail lines per product and lot
operands.source: the detail lines being tested, converted into the product unit
operands.constraints: grouped by product and lot

operands.name: Product Unit of Measure precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record named `Product Unit of Measure`, the decimal precision setting used for this comparison
operands.constraints: a digit count

preconditions.condition: Both sides are grouped by the same key of product and lot.
preconditions.otherwise: A container could be judged fully represented while a lot it holds is missing from the lines.

procedure: Group the container's Stock Quantity records by product and lot and sum their quantities.
Group the detail lines by product and lot and sum their quantities converted into the product unit.
For every key present on either side, compare the two sums at the `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision.
Fail the test when any key exists on one side only.
Fail the test when any pair of sums differs at that precision.
Treat an empty set of lines as a match.
records.formula: for every key of product and lot: sum of the container's record quantities for that key = sum of the line quantities in the product unit for that key , compared at the `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision , and no key exists on one side only

rounding.what: The comparison of the two sums for each key.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision, a digit count.
rounding.method: A zero test on the difference at that precision.
rounding.step: Once per key, after both sums have been taken.

result.name: the whole-container verdict
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the whole-container detection on a Transfer; never stored on its own.

edge_cases.case: The set of lines is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The test is treated as a match, which is what lets an empty container be carried along.

edge_cases.case: The lines claim less than the container holds.
edge_cases.outcome: The test fails and the container is not taken over as an entire package.

edge_cases.case: A lot of the container is missing from the lines.
edge_cases.outcome: The key exists on one side only and the test fails.

edge_cases.case: The container's type is reusable.
edge_cases.outcome: The detection that uses this test refuses to take the container over whatever the test says, because a reusable container stays behind.

worked_examples.description: The ninth step of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The container holds nine and the lines claim eight, which differ at the comparison precision, so the container is not fully represented and nothing is flagged as an entire package.

worked_examples.description: The same container when the lines claim all nine
worked_examples.narrative: The two sums agree for the single key and no key exists on one side only, so the container is fully represented and may be taken over as an entire package.

records.name: The weight of a container
records.purpose: Gives the physical weight of a container as it stands, adding the weight of its own type, of every container nested inside it and of all the goods it holds.

operands.name: base weight of the container's type
operands.source: the container type of the container
operands.constraints: zero when the container has no type

operands.name: base weight of each descendant container's type
operands.source: the container types of the containers nested inside it, at every level
operands.constraints: each counted once

operands.name: on-hand quantity of each contained record
operands.source: the Stock Quantity records inside the container and inside its descendants
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no weight

preconditions.condition: The weight is asked for outside the context of one Transfer.
preconditions.otherwise: The figure for a Transfer applies instead, because the container's contents are still being assembled.

procedure: Take the base weight of the container's own type.
Add the base weight of the type of every container nested inside it, at every level.
Add, for every quantity record contained in it, the record's on-hand quantity multiplied by the weight of its product.
Return the sum.
records.formula: container weight = container type base weight + sum over every descendant container of ( that container's type base weight ) + sum over every contained quantity record of ( record on-hand quantity × product weight )

rounding.what: Nothing; the sums and the products are exact.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: container weight
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and displayed on the container; consumed by the shipping weight of a Transfer when no manual weight was entered.

edge_cases.case: The container has no type.
edge_cases.outcome: The base weight contributes nothing and only the contents count.

edge_cases.case: A product carries no weight.
edge_cases.outcome: Its records contribute nothing to the total.

edge_cases.case: The container holds a record with a negative quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces the total, because the sum is taken as it stands.

edge_cases.case: The container is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The weight is the base weight of its own type alone.

worked_examples.description: A pallet of base weight twenty holding forty units of a product weighing two
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty for the pallet plus forty times two for the goods gives one hundred.

worked_examples.description: The same pallet holding a nested box of base weight three
worked_examples.narrative: The nested box adds its own base weight of three to the one hundred, giving one hundred and three.

records.name: The weight of a container in the context of one Transfer
records.purpose: Gives the weight a container will have once the Transfer has finished filling it, computed from the detail lines that target it rather than from the goods it currently holds.

operands.name: base weight of the container's type
operands.source: the container type of the container
operands.constraints: zero when the container has no type

operands.name: quantities of the Transfer's detail lines targeting the container
operands.source: the detail lines whose destination container is that container
operands.constraints: converted into the product unit without rounding

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no weight

operands.name: containers whose destination container is this one
operands.source: the destination chain of the Transfer's containers, directly or transitively
operands.constraints: each contributes its own type base weight and its own line sum

preconditions.condition: The weight is asked for in the context of one Transfer.
preconditions.otherwise: The plain container weight applies, which reads the goods actually inside the container.

procedure: Take the base weight of the container's own type.

Add, for every detail line of the Transfer whose destination container is this container, the line's quantity converted into the product unit without rounding, multiplied by the weight of its product.
Add, for every container that has this one as destination container, directly or transitively, that container's type base weight together with the same line sum computed for it.
Return the sum.
records.formula: container weight for a transfer = container type base weight + sum over the transfer's detail lines whose destination container is this container of ( convert( line quantity , line unit , product unit , none ) × product weight ) + sum over every container that has this one as destination container, directly or transitively, of ( that container's type base weight + the same line sum for that container )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit, which is deliberately made without rounding.
rounding.precision: Not applicable; no rounding is applied.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: container weight for a Transfer
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the shipping weight of the Transfer when the container carries no manually entered shipping weight.

edge_cases.case: The container already holds goods that this Transfer does not name.
edge_cases.outcome: They do not count, because the figure is built from the Transfer's own lines.

edge_cases.case: A container is nested into this one by the Transfer's destination-container links.
edge_cases.outcome: Its base weight and its own line sum are added, at every level of the chain.

edge_cases.case: No line targets the container.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the base weight of its type is counted.

worked_examples.description: A pallet of base weight twenty that the Transfer is filling with forty units of a product weighing two
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty for the pallet plus eighty for the goods the Transfer is putting on it gives one hundred, even though the pallet is still physically empty.

worked_examples.description: The same pallet receiving a box of base weight three that itself receives six units
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred for the pallet and its own goods, plus three for the box and twelve for the six units it receives, gives one hundred and fifteen.

records.name: Whole-container detection on a Transfer
records.purpose: Marks the containers that a Transfer is moving in their entirety, so that the goods travel inside the container instead of being taken out of it.

operands.name: detail lines of the Transfer
operands.constraints: grouped by source container

operands.name: source container of each line
operands.constraints: the group with no container is skipped

operands.name: Transfers owning the lines of a group
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of Transfers or one batch
operands.constraints: must form a single document or a single batch

operands.name: container type reusability
operands.source: the container type of the container
operands.constraints: a reusable container is never taken over

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not suppress the detection.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing is marked, which is what keeps the containers of a Transfer being validated from being disturbed while its backorder moves are confirmed.

procedure: Group the Transfer's detail lines by source container and skip the group with no container.
For each group, check that the Transfers owning those lines form a single document, or a single batch.
Check that the container is fully represented by the lines of that document, filtered to storable products and to the container or any of its descendants.
Check that the container's type is not reusable.

When all three hold, write onto every line of the group that has no destination container yet and whose status is neither done nor cancelled: the destination container is the container itself, and the entire-package flag is set.
Finally run the container promotion on the destination containers of all the Transfer's lines.
records.formula: a group's container is taken over when its lines belong to one document or one batch , the whole-container test holds for the lines of that document filtered to storable products and to the container or its descendants , and the container's type is not reusable

rounding.what: The comparison inside the whole-container test.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision.
rounding.method: A zero test on the difference at that precision.
rounding.step: Once per group, inside the whole-container test.

result.name: the destination container and the entire-package flag of the group's lines
result.unit_or_currency: a container and a yes or no flag
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Move Lines.

edge_cases.case: The lines of a group belong to more than one document and no single batch.
edge_cases.outcome: The group is not taken over, because no one document is moving the whole container.

edge_cases.case: The container's type is reusable.
edge_cases.outcome: The container is never taken over; its goods are moved out of it instead.

edge_cases.case: A line of the group already has a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: It is left as it is; only the lines with no destination container are written.

edge_cases.case: The detection is suppressed by the calling context.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is marked at all.

worked_examples.description: The ninth step of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The single group holds one line claiming eight while the container holds nine, so the test fails and no line is flagged as an entire package.

worked_examples.description: The same group when the line claims all nine
worked_examples.narrative: The test passes and the container is written as the destination container of the line, with the entire-package flag set, so the goods travel inside the container.

records.name: Container promotion for whole containers
records.purpose: Considers a parent container moved once every one of its children has been added, so that a pallet travels as a pallet rather than as a set of boxes.

operands.name: containers already carrying a destination container
operands.source: the whole-container detection or a previous round of the promotion
operands.constraints: grouped by parent container

operands.name: children of each parent container
operands.constraints: the promotion applies only when the group is exactly the whole set of children

operands.name: container type reusability of the parent
operands.source: the container type of the parent
operands.constraints: a reusable parent is never promoted

operands.name: list of allowed containers
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of containers, or nothing
operands.constraints: when supplied, the parent must be in it

preconditions.condition: The containers being considered have a parent container.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to promote to.

procedure: Group the containers by their parent container.
For each parent that is not empty, check that the parent's children are exactly the group.
Check that the parent's type is not reusable, and, when a list of allowed containers was supplied, that the parent is in that list.
When all three hold, set the destination container of every container of the group to the parent.
When any container of the set now has a destination container, recurse on those destination containers so that the next level up is considered too.
Stop when no container of the set gained a destination container.
records.formula: the parent is promoted when { the children of the parent } = { the containers of the group } and the parent's type is not reusable and , when a list of allowed containers was supplied , the parent is in it

rounding.what: Nothing; the promotion compares sets of containers.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the destination container of the promoted group's containers
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on each container of the group.

edge_cases.case: Only some children of a parent are being moved.
edge_cases.outcome: The parent is not promoted, so a partly emptied pallet stays where it is.

edge_cases.case: The parent's type is reusable.
edge_cases.outcome: The parent is never promoted.

edge_cases.case: The promotion sets a destination container on the group.
edge_cases.outcome: The routine recurses on those destination containers, so a whole tower of containers can be promoted level by level.

edge_cases.case: No container gains a destination container in a round.
edge_cases.outcome: The recursion stops.

worked_examples.description: A pallet holding exactly three boxes, all three being moved

expected_outputs.recursion: runs on the pallet, which has no parent, so it stops

worked_examples.narrative: The group is exactly the set of children, so the pallet becomes the destination container of all three boxes and the tower is considered moved as a pallet.

worked_examples.description: The same pallet where only two of the three boxes are moved
worked_examples.narrative: The group is not the whole set of children, so the pallet is not promoted and the two boxes travel on their own.

records.name: Applying the destination containers at completion
records.purpose: Turns the destination-container links that a Transfer built into real parent links once the goods have moved, refusing the two situations in which the links would describe an impossible physical arrangement.

operands.name: containers to process
operands.source: the completion of the detail lines
operands.constraints: restricted to those not yet processed

operands.name: destination container of each container
operands.constraints: the grouping key

operands.name: Locations of the group's containers after the movement
operands.source: the containers, read after the goods have moved
operands.constraints: must be a single Location

operands.name: contents of the destination container
operands.constraints: their Location must equal the group's new Location

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not ask for destination containers to be ignored.
preconditions.otherwise: Neither the container history snapshots nor this application runs, which is what an inventory adjustment asks for.

preconditions.condition: The goods have already moved on the Stock Quantity records.
preconditions.otherwise: The Locations read in the first check would be the ones from before the movement.

procedure: Restrict the work to the containers not yet processed.
Group them by their destination container.
For the group whose destination container is empty, clear the parent container of every container of the group and mark them processed.

For every other group, read the Locations of the group's containers after the movement; when there is more than one, fail with the message that the named containers are moved to different locations while being in the same container.

Read the destination container's own contents, meaning its records with a non-zero quantity; when there are any and their Location is not the group's new Location, fail with the message that a container holding packages in another location may not be moved to a different location.
Write on every container of the group that the parent container becomes the destination container and that the destination container is cleared, and mark them processed.
When any processed container's parent itself has a destination container or a parent, recurse on those parents.
records.formula: parent container = destination container , and destination container = empty , for every container of a group that passes the two checks ; the group is refused when the count of distinct Locations of its containers ≠ 1 , or when the destination container holds contents in another Location

rounding.what: Nothing; the checks compare Locations and container sets.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the parent container of each processed container
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the container; the destination container is cleared at the same time.

edge_cases.case: A group's containers end up in more than one Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The completion fails with the message naming the containers and the container they share.

edge_cases.case: The destination container already holds goods somewhere else.
edge_cases.outcome: The completion fails with the message naming the old and the new Location.

edge_cases.case: The destination container is empty for a group.
edge_cases.outcome: The parent container of every container of that group is cleared, which is how a container is taken out of its parent.

edge_cases.case: A parent gained a destination container of its own.
edge_cases.outcome: The routine recurses on it; the processed set is carried along so that no container is revisited and the recursion terminates.

worked_examples.description: Three boxes promoted onto a pallet, all three arriving in the same Location
worked_examples.narrative: There is one Location and the pallet holds nothing elsewhere, so the three boxes become children of the pallet and their destination links are cleared.

worked_examples.description: The same three boxes where one arrives in another Location

expected_outputs.failure: the completion fails with the message that the named containers are moved to different locations while being in the same container

worked_examples.narrative: Two distinct Locations are read for one group, so the arrangement is impossible and the completion is refused.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that ignores destination containers

records.name: Putting goods into a container
records.purpose: Creates or reuses a container for the lines a person selected, deciding which lines are packed, which container is used and where the new container is directed.

operands.name: selected detail lines
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of lines with quantities
operands.source: the screen the person acted from
operands.constraints: only lines that are neither done nor cancelled and whose quantity is strictly positive are eligible

operands.name: destination container of each selected line
operands.constraints: lines with none are packed, the outermost containers of the others are nested

operands.name: picked flag of each selected line
operands.constraints: when at least one positive line is picked and the selection is not forced, the unpicked ones are ignored

operands.name: Operation Types of the selection
operands.constraints: must be exactly one

operands.name: supplied container, container type and name
operands.unit_or_currency: a container, a container type and a text
operands.constraints: each optional

preconditions.condition: The selection spans exactly one Operation Type.
preconditions.otherwise: The action fails with the message that products from different transfers with different operation types may not be packed into the same package.

procedure: Split the selection: the lines to pack are those that are neither done nor cancelled, have a strictly positive quantity and have no destination container; the containers to pack are the outermost destination containers of the remaining such lines.
When the selection is not forced and at least one line among those with a positive quantity is picked, ignore the unpicked ones entirely.
Fail when the selection spans more than one Operation Type.
For the lines to pack: when they point at more than one destination Location, open the destination chooser first, and let the chosen Location rewrite all of them.
When the Operation Type asks to set a container type and none of a container, a container type or a name was supplied, open the wizard first.

Otherwise create or take the container: the given container when one was supplied; else a new container with the given name and the given type; else a new container with the given name and, when the move's packaging unit resolves to exactly one container type, that type.
When exactly one line is being packed, re-run put-away for that line with the new container, so that the container is directed to a Location that can accept it.
Write the container as the destination container of every line being packed.
When the Operation Type asks to print the container label automatically, return the label document action instead of the container.
For the containers to pack, remember the whole current destination chain of those containers, create or take the new container in the same way, and set it as their destination container.
Clear the destination container of every remembered container that no longer has any open detail line, so that a broken chain does not leave stale links.
Re-run put-away on the new container's detail lines, because the outermost container changed.
records.formula: lines to pack = { selected lines : status not done and not cancelled , quantity > 0 , no destination container } ; containers to pack = the outermost destination containers of the remaining such lines ; the new container's type = the supplied type , else the single container type the move's packaging unit resolves to , else none

rounding.what: Nothing in the packing itself; the put-away that follows applies its own rounding.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, inside the put-away.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step, inside the put-away.
rounding.step: Only inside the put-away run for the packed lines.

result.name: the container and the destination container written on the packed lines
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the lines and on the nested containers; the label document is returned instead when the Operation Type asks for it.

edge_cases.case: Some positive lines are picked and others are not, and the selection is not forced.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the picked ones are packed.

edge_cases.case: The lines point at more than one destination Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The destination chooser opens first and the chosen Location is written on all of them before they are packed.

edge_cases.case: Exactly one line is packed.
edge_cases.outcome: Put-away is re-run for it with the new container, so that a container type can direct it to a suitable shelf.

edge_cases.case: An existing container is nested into a new one.
edge_cases.outcome: The whole former destination chain is remembered and every remembered container that has no open line left has its destination container cleared.

edge_cases.case: The selection spans two Operation Types.
edge_cases.outcome: The action fails with the message about different operation types.

worked_examples.description: Packing two loose lines of one delivery into a new container
worked_examples.narrative: Both lines are open, positive and unpacked, they share one destination Location and one Operation Type, so the named container is created and written on both; put-away is not re-run because more than one line is being packed.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that considers every line for packing

records.name: Unpacking a container
records.purpose: Empties a container by detaching its child containers and relocating the goods it directly holds to the same Location with no container.

operands.name: child containers
operands.source: the containers whose parent is the container being unpacked
operands.constraints: each has its parent cleared

operands.name: quantity records directly held
operands.source: the records whose container is the container being unpacked
operands.constraints: relocated to the same Location with no container

operands.name: relocation reference
operands.source: the operation itself, which stamps the reference "Quantities unpacked" on the adjustment moves it creates
operands.constraints: reproduced verbatim

preconditions.condition: The container exists and may be read by the acting user.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation cannot run.

procedure: Clear the parent container of every child container.
When the container directly holds quantity records, relocate them to the same Location with no container and the reference "Quantities unpacked".
Run the record housekeeping afterwards, so that the emptied records are merged, their reservations cleaned and the empty ones deleted.
records.formula: for every child container: parent container = empty ; for every directly held record: the same quantity is moved to the same Location with no container , under the reference "Quantities unpacked"

rounding.what: Nothing in the unpacking itself; the housekeeping applies its own rounding when it deletes empty records.
rounding.precision: The greater of six digits and twice the number of decimal digits of the shipped product-unit precision record, inside the empty-record deletion.
rounding.method: Rounding to that digit count for the zero tests, inside the deletion only.
rounding.step: Only inside the housekeeping that follows.

result.name: the emptied container, the detached children and the relocated records
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the containers and on the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: The container holds only child containers.
edge_cases.outcome: Their parent links are cleared and no record is relocated.

edge_cases.case: The container holds no record and no child.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing happens.

edge_cases.case: The relocation creates adjustment-style moves.
edge_cases.outcome: They are handed over to the valuation domain like any other completed movement, because goods have changed their container rather than their Location.

worked_examples.description: Unpacking a pallet holding two boxes and six loose units
worked_examples.narrative: The two boxes lose their parent and stand on their own; the six loose units stay in the same Location but leave the pallet, under the reproduced reference for unpacked quantities.

records.name: Removing containers from a Transfer
records.purpose: Undoes the addition of one or more containers to a Transfer, deleting the lines that only existed because the container was added and clearing the links the addition created.

operands.name: containers being removed
operands.constraints: their whole destination chain is collected

operands.name: open detail lines of those containers
operands.source: the lines whose destination container is one of the removed containers
operands.constraints: restricted to the Transfers named in the context when the context names any

operands.name: entire-package flag of each line
operands.constraints: decides whether the line is deleted or merely cleared

operands.name: moves with a zero demand
operands.source: the moves left with no detail line after the deletion
operands.constraints: deleted when their demand is zero

preconditions.condition: A Transfer is in context.
preconditions.otherwise: The complementary action of adding containers fails with the message that a transfer is needed to add these packages to.

procedure: Collect the whole destination chain of the containers being removed, together with all of their open detail lines.

For each of those lines, restricted to the Transfers named in the context when the context names any: when the line's destination container is one of the removed containers, delete the line if it was added as an entire package, and otherwise merely clear its destination container.
Delete the collected lines and clear the destination container of the collected updates.
Delete the moves that had a zero demand and no detail line left.
Clear the destination container of every container that had one of the removed containers as destination, and of the removed containers themselves.
Clear the destination container of every container of the remembered chain that no longer has any open detail line.
Re-run put-away on the surviving lines, because the outermost container changed.
records.formula: a line is deleted when its destination container is a removed container and its entire-package flag is set ; a line only has its destination container cleared otherwise ; a move is deleted when its demand is zero and it has no detail line left

rounding.what: Nothing in the removal itself; the put-away that follows applies its own rounding.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, inside the put-away.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step, inside the put-away.
rounding.step: Only inside the put-away run for the surviving lines.

result.name: the surviving detail lines, the deleted moves and the cleared container links
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the lines, the moves and the containers.

edge_cases.case: A line was added because the whole container was added.
edge_cases.outcome: It is deleted, because it only existed to carry the container.

edge_cases.case: A line existed before the container was added and was later directed into it.
edge_cases.outcome: Only its destination container is cleared and the line survives.

edge_cases.case: A move is left with no line and a demand of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: It is deleted, so the Transfer does not keep an empty move behind.

edge_cases.case: A container of the remembered chain has no open line left.
edge_cases.outcome: Its destination container is cleared so that the chain does not keep a stale link.

worked_examples.description: Removing a container that had been added whole to a Transfer

expected_outputs.move_of_L5: deleted, having a zero demand and no line left

worked_examples.narrative: The line that only existed because the container was added is removed together with its empty move, while the pre-existing line simply leaves the container and is put away again.

records.name: The net weight of a Location
records.purpose: Gives the weight of the goods a Location physically holds, which is the basis of the forecasted weight the capacity checks compare against a storage category's maximum.

operands.name: on-hand quantity of each of the Location's records
operands.source: the Stock Quantity records of the Location
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no weight

preconditions.condition: The products of the Location's records carry a weight, or a weight of zero is acceptable.
preconditions.otherwise: The figure understates the physical weight, which is the documented behaviour rather than an error.

procedure: Take every Stock Quantity record of the Location.
Multiply each record's on-hand quantity by the weight of its product.
Sum the products.
records.formula: net weight(location) = sum over the location's quantity records of ( on-hand quantity × product weight )

rounding.what: Nothing; the products and the sum are exact.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: net weight of the Location
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand, displayed on the Location and consumed by the forecasted weight.

edge_cases.case: A record holds a negative quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces the net weight, because the sum is taken as it stands.

edge_cases.case: The Location holds no record.
edge_cases.outcome: The net weight is zero.

edge_cases.case: A product carries no weight.
edge_cases.outcome: Its records contribute nothing.

worked_examples.description: The first bin of the third worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Eighteen units weighing a half each give a net weight of nine, which is the figure the capacity check of that bin uses as its forecasted weight because no open line leaves or arrives.

records.name: The forecasted weight of a Location
records.purpose: Gives the weight a Location will hold once the open movements have run, which is the figure a capacity check compares against the storage category's maximum weight.

operands.name: net weight of the Location
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: quantities of the open detail lines leaving the Location
operands.source: the lines whose source Location is that Location and whose status is not draft, done or cancelled
operands.constraints: converted into the product unit

operands.name: quantities of the open detail lines arriving in the Location
operands.source: the lines whose destination Location is that Location and whose status is not draft, done or cancelled
operands.constraints: converted into the product unit

operands.name: excluded line identifiers
operands.constraints: those lines are omitted from both sums

preconditions.condition: The set of excluded lines is supplied by the calling put-away, so that a line does not weigh against itself.
preconditions.otherwise: A line being placed would count its own quantity as occupancy and the Location would look fuller than it will be.

procedure: Compute the net weight of the Location.
Subtract, for every open detail line leaving the Location and not listed as excluded, the line's quantity in the product unit multiplied by the weight of its product.
Add, for every open detail line arriving in the Location and not listed as excluded, the line's quantity in the product unit multiplied by the weight of its product.
Treat as open any line whose status is not draft, done or cancelled.
records.formula: forecast weight(location) = net weight(location) − sum over the open detail lines leaving the location of ( quantity in the product unit × product weight ) + sum over the open detail lines arriving in the location of ( quantity in the product unit × product weight )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, as each sum is accumulated.

result.name: forecasted weight of the Location
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand, displayed on the Location and consumed by the capacity check.

edge_cases.case: More is leaving than the Location holds.
edge_cases.outcome: The forecasted weight is negative, which the capacity check accepts because it only compares the maximum against the sum.

edge_cases.case: A line is listed as excluded.
edge_cases.outcome: It is omitted from both sums, so a line being placed does not weigh against itself.

edge_cases.case: A line is in draft.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not open and contributes to neither sum.

worked_examples.description: The third bin of the third worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The bin holds nothing, nothing leaves it and an open line brings five units weighing a half each, so its forecasted weight is two and a half.

worked_examples.description: A shelf holding twenty units of weight one with eight leaving and three arriving
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty less eight plus three gives fifteen, which is the weight the shelf will carry once the open movements have run.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that excludes detail lines from the occupancy

records.name: The bulk weight of a Transfer
records.purpose: Gives the weight of the goods a Transfer moves that are not inside any container, which is one of the two parts of the shipping weight a carrier is quoted on.

operands.name: detail lines with no destination container
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of lines with quantities in their own units
operands.constraints: lines carrying a destination container are excluded

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no weight

preconditions.condition: The Transfer has detail lines.
preconditions.otherwise: The bulk weight is zero.

procedure: Take the Transfer's detail lines that have no destination container.
Convert each line's quantity from its own unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Multiply each converted quantity by the weight of its product.
Sum the products.
records.formula: bulk weight(transfer) = sum over the transfer's detail lines that have no destination container of ( convert( line quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) × product weight )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, before the multiplication.

result.name: bulk weight of the Transfer
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and displayed on the Transfer; consumed by the shipping weight.

edge_cases.case: Every line carries a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: The bulk weight is zero and the whole shipping weight comes from the containers.

edge_cases.case: A product carries no weight.
edge_cases.outcome: Its lines contribute nothing.

edge_cases.case: A line's unit differs from the product unit.
edge_cases.outcome: It is converted first, rounding half away from zero at the product unit's step.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of six loose units of a product weighing two and forty units already packed
worked_examples.narrative: Only the six loose units count, giving twelve; the forty packed units are weighed through their container instead.

records.name: The shipping weight of a Transfer
records.purpose: Gives the total weight a carrier is asked to move, combining the loose goods with the weight of every outermost container, and letting a person override the figure by hand.

operands.name: bulk weight of the Transfer
operands.constraints: zero when every line is packed

operands.name: outermost destination containers of the Transfer's lines
operands.source: the destination container chain of the lines
operands.constraints: each counted once

operands.name: manually entered shipping weight of each container
operands.constraints: when set it replaces the computed container weight

operands.name: container weight for this Transfer
operands.source: the container weight computed in the context of the Transfer
operands.constraints: used when no manual weight is set

preconditions.condition: The Transfer's lines have been assigned to their containers.
preconditions.otherwise: The container part of the figure understates the shipment.

procedure: Compute the bulk weight of the Transfer.
For each outermost destination container of the Transfer's lines, take its manually entered shipping weight when one is set.
Otherwise take the container weight computed in the context of this Transfer.
Add those container figures to the bulk weight.
Store the result, which a person may afterwards overwrite by hand.
records.formula: shipping weight(transfer) = bulk weight(transfer) + sum over the outermost destination containers of the transfer's lines of ( the container's manually entered shipping weight when set , otherwise the container weight for this transfer )

rounding.what: The conversions inside the bulk weight and inside the container weight for a Transfer.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit inside the bulk weight; no rounding at all inside the container weight for a Transfer.
rounding.method: Half away from zero inside the bulk weight; none inside the container figure.
rounding.step: Once per line, inside each of the two parts.

result.name: shipping weight of the Transfer
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Transfer and overwritable by hand; read by the shipping domain to price the shipment.

edge_cases.case: A container carries a manually entered shipping weight.
edge_cases.outcome: That weight is used and the computed container weight is ignored for it.

edge_cases.case: A container is nested inside another.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the outermost one is counted, because its own figure already includes the nested chain.

edge_cases.case: A person overwrites the stored figure.
edge_cases.outcome: The manual value stands until the figure is recomputed.

worked_examples.description: A delivery with six loose units of weight two and one pallet of base weight twenty carrying forty units of the same product
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve for the loose goods plus one hundred for the pallet and its contents gives one hundred and twelve.

worked_examples.description: The same delivery where the pallet was weighed on a scale at ninety-five
worked_examples.narrative: The manual weight replaces the computed one, giving twelve plus ninety-five, that is one hundred and seven.

records.name: The shipping volume of a Transfer
records.purpose: Gives the volume a Transfer moves, computed from the processed quantity of each move rather than from the detail lines, which the shipping domain uses alongside the weight.

operands.name: processed quantity of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: recomputed from the detail lines

operands.name: line unit of each move
operands.constraints: must belong to the category of the product unit

operands.name: product volume
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no volume

preconditions.condition: The processed quantities are up to date with the detail lines.
preconditions.otherwise: The volume does not match what will actually leave.

procedure: Take every move of the Transfer.
Convert each move's processed quantity from its line unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Multiply each converted quantity by the volume of its product.
Sum the products.
records.formula: shipping volume(transfer) = sum over the transfer's moves of ( convert( processed quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) × product volume )

rounding.what: The conversion of each move's processed quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per move, before the multiplication.

result.name: shipping volume of the Transfer
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and displayed on the Transfer; read by the shipping domain.

edge_cases.case: A product carries no volume.
edge_cases.outcome: Its move contributes nothing.

edge_cases.case: A move has a processed quantity of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes nothing.

edge_cases.case: The figure is built from moves and not from lines.
edge_cases.outcome: Goods inside a container are counted exactly once, through their move, and no container volume is added.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of forty-six units of a product whose volume is one hundredth per unit
worked_examples.narrative: Forty-six units at one hundredth each give a volume of forty-six hundredths.

records.name: The estimated shipping weight of a batch
records.purpose: Gives the weight a batch of Transfers will load onto a vehicle, counting a manually weighed container as it stands and building the weight of every other container from its type and its goods.

operands.name: destination containers with a manual shipping weight
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of containers with a weight each
operands.source: the containers of the batch's detail lines
operands.constraints: their weight is taken as it stands and their goods are not counted again

operands.name: destination containers with a type but no manual weight
operands.source: the containers of the batch's detail lines
operands.constraints: only their type's base weight is counted here

operands.name: detail lines of the batch
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: counted unless their destination container was already counted with a manual weight

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no weight

preconditions.condition: The batch has Transfers with detail lines.
preconditions.otherwise: The estimated weight is zero.
