procedure: Sum the manual shipping weights of the destination containers of the batch's lines that carry one.
Add the base weight of the type of every destination container that has a type but no manual weight.
Add, for every detail line of the batch whose destination container was not already counted with a manual weight, the product's weight multiplied by the line's quantity in the product unit.
Return the sum.
records.formula: estimated shipping weight(batch) = sum over the destination containers with a manual shipping weight of ( that weight ) + sum over the destination containers with a type but no manual weight of ( the type's base weight ) + sum over the batch's detail lines whose destination container was not already counted with a manual weight of ( product weight × line quantity in the product unit )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, inside the third sum.

result.name: estimated shipping weight of the batch
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and displayed on the batch; consumed by the load percentage.

edge_cases.case: A container carries a manual shipping weight.
edge_cases.outcome: Its goods are not counted a second time, because the manual figure is taken to include them.

edge_cases.case: A container has no type and no manual weight.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes no base weight and only its goods count.

edge_cases.case: A line has no destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: Its goods count in the third sum, exactly like the goods of an unweighed container.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document
worked_examples.narrative: The pallet has no manual weight, so its base weight of twenty is counted and all forty-six units, forty on the pallet and six loose, are weighed at two each for ninety-two, giving one hundred and twelve in total.

records.name: The estimated shipping volume of a batch
records.purpose: Gives the volume a batch of Transfers will load onto a vehicle, taking the outer dimensions of every typed container that was not weighed by hand and the volume of the remaining goods.

operands.name: destination containers with a type but no manual weight
operands.source: the containers of the batch's detail lines
operands.constraints: their outer dimensions are used

operands.name: length, width and height of each such container type
operands.constraints: each must be a positive number

operands.name: detail lines of the batch
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: counted unless their destination container was already counted with a manual weight

operands.name: product volume
operands.constraints: zero when the product carries no volume

preconditions.condition: The container types carry their three dimensions.
preconditions.otherwise: The container part of the volume is understated, which is the documented behaviour rather than an error.

procedure: For every destination container that has a type but no manual shipping weight, multiply the length, the width and the height of its type and divide the product by one thousand million, which converts cubic millimetres into cubic metres.
Sum those container volumes.
Add, for every detail line of the batch whose destination container was not already counted with a manual weight, the product's volume multiplied by the line's quantity in the product unit.
Return the sum.
records.formula: estimated shipping volume(batch) = sum over the destination containers with a type but no manual weight of ( length × width × height ÷ 1 000 000 000 ) + sum over the batch's detail lines whose destination container was not already counted with a manual weight of ( product volume × line quantity in the product unit )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit; the division by one thousand million is exact.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversion.
rounding.step: Once per line, inside the second sum.

result.name: estimated shipping volume of the batch
result.stored_or_displayed: Computed on demand and displayed on the batch; consumed by the load percentage.

edge_cases.case: A container carries a manual shipping weight.
edge_cases.outcome: Neither its dimensions nor its goods count, because the manual weight excludes it from both sums.

edge_cases.case: A container has no type.
edge_cases.outcome: No outer volume is counted for it and only its goods count.

edge_cases.case: A product carries no volume.
edge_cases.outcome: Its lines contribute nothing to the second sum.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve hundred by eight hundred by fifteen hundred cubic millimetres divided by one thousand million gives one and forty-four hundredths; the forty-six units at one hundredth each add forty-six hundredths, for a total of one and nine tenths.

records.name: The load percentages of a batch against its vehicle category
records.purpose: Expresses the estimated weight and volume of a batch as a share of what the assigned vehicle category can carry, so that a planner sees whether the load fits.

operands.name: estimated shipping weight of the batch
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: estimated shipping volume of the batch
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: weight capacity of the vehicle category
operands.source: the vehicle category assigned to the batch
operands.constraints: the percentage is left empty when it is zero or absent

operands.name: volume capacity of the vehicle category
operands.source: the vehicle category assigned to the batch
operands.constraints: the percentage is left empty when it is zero or absent

preconditions.condition: The batch names a vehicle category whose capacity is strictly positive.
preconditions.otherwise: The corresponding percentage is left empty rather than being computed.

procedure: Divide the estimated shipping weight by the vehicle category's weight capacity and multiply by one hundred.
Divide the estimated shipping volume by the vehicle category's volume capacity and multiply by one hundred.
Leave a percentage empty when the corresponding capacity is zero or absent.
records.formula: used weight percentage = 100 × estimated shipping weight ÷ vehicle category weight capacity ; used volume percentage = 100 × estimated shipping volume ÷ vehicle category volume capacity

rounding.what: Nothing; the divisions are carried at full precision and only the display applies a presentation format.
rounding.precision: Not applicable to the stored figure.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step of the calculation.

result.name: the used weight percentage and the used volume percentage
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the batch; empty when the corresponding capacity is zero or absent.

edge_cases.case: The vehicle category has no weight capacity.
edge_cases.outcome: The weight percentage is empty while the volume percentage may still be computed.

edge_cases.case: The load exceeds the capacity.
edge_cases.outcome: The percentage is greater than one hundred, which is shown rather than refused.

edge_cases.case: The batch has no vehicle category.
edge_cases.outcome: Both percentages are empty.

worked_examples.description: The worked example of the document
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred times one hundred and twelve divided by eight hundred gives fourteen percent of the vehicle's weight capacity.

worked_examples.description: The same batch against a vehicle category whose volume capacity is five
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred times one and nine tenths divided by five gives thirty-eight percent of the vehicle's volume capacity.

records.name: Merging duplicate Stock Quantity records
records.purpose: Collapses the duplicate records that concurrent transactions create, so that the rule of one record per set of characteristics holds again once no operation is in flight.

operands.name: records grouped by product, company, Location, lot, container and owner
operands.source: the whole record set, or the Locations and products of a restricted set
operands.constraints: only groups of more than one row are processed

operands.name: on-hand quantity of each record of a group
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: reserved quantity of each record of a group
operands.constraints: never negative individually

operands.name: counted quantity of each record of a group
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: incoming date of each record of a group
operands.constraints: always set

preconditions.condition: The whole pass runs inside a save point.
preconditions.otherwise: A failure part-way through would leave the records half merged.

procedure: Group the records by product, company, Location, lot, container and owner, and keep only the groups with more than one row; when the pass is run on a restricted set, limit the grouping to the Locations and products of that set.
For each group, keep the row with the lowest identifier.
Write on the kept row the sum of the on-hand quantities of the group.
Write on the kept row the greater of zero and the sum of the reserved quantities of the group.
Write on the kept row the sum of the counted quantities of the group.
Write on the kept row the minimum of the incoming dates of the group.
Delete the other rows of the group.
When the pass fails, log the failure and change nothing, because the whole pass runs inside a save point.
records.formula: kept on-hand = sum of the on-hand quantities of the group ; kept reserved = maximum( 0 , sum of the reserved quantities of the group ) ; kept counted = sum of the counted quantities of the group ; kept incoming date = minimum of the incoming dates of the group

rounding.what: Nothing; the four aggregations are exact.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: one surviving Stock Quantity record per set of characteristics
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the product unit and an instant
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored; the other rows of the group are deleted.

edge_cases.case: The group's reserved quantities sum below zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The kept counter is clamped at zero.

edge_cases.case: The group's records carry different incoming dates.
edge_cases.outcome: The oldest survives, which keeps first in first out stable across the merge.

edge_cases.case: The pass fails part-way.
edge_cases.outcome: The save point is rolled back, the failure is logged and nothing is changed.

edge_cases.case: The pass runs on a restricted set.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the Locations and products of that set are grouped.

worked_examples.description: Two rows created concurrently for the same characteristics
worked_examples.narrative: The lower identifier survives and takes the summed quantities and the older arrival date, and the second row is deleted.

records.name: Cleaning the reservation counters
records.purpose: Makes the reserved counters agree with the detail lines that justify them, repairing the counters that a failed transaction or a bypassing Location left behind.

operands.name: records with a non-zero reserved counter, grouped by the five-part key
operands.constraints: the total reserved per group and the records themselves are noted

operands.name: open detail lines grouped by the same key
operands.source: the lines whose status is waiting another move, waiting, partially available or assigned, whose quantity in the product unit is non-zero and whose product is storable
operands.constraints: summed per key to form the justified figure

operands.name: reservation bypass of the Location
operands.constraints: a bypassing Location must hold no reservation at all

operands.name: product-level bypass
operands.source: the extension point that lets a product refuse reservation
operands.constraints: consulted only for the keys with no counter

preconditions.condition: No operation is in flight for the records being repaired.
preconditions.otherwise: The pass would fight a reservation that is being made at the same moment.

procedure: Group the records whose reserved counter is non-zero by product, Location, lot, container and owner, noting for each group the total reserved and the records themselves.
Group the open detail lines by the same key, summing their quantities in the product unit, and call the result the justified map.
For each reserved group: when the Location bypasses reservation, lower the counter by the whole reserved total, bringing it to zero.
Otherwise, when the reserved total differs from the justified figure at the product unit's rounding step, adjust the counter by the justified figure less the reserved total.
Remove the key from the justified map once it has been handled.

For each key left in the justified map, meaning lines that reserve against no counter at all: skip it when the Location bypasses reservation or when the product-level bypass says so; otherwise raise the counter by the justified quantity.
records.formula: adjustment(key) = justified(key) − reserved(key) , applied when the two differ at the product unit's step ; adjustment(key) = − reserved(key) , when the Location bypasses reservation ; adjustment(key) = + justified(key) , for a key with lines but no counter

rounding.what: The comparison of the reserved total against the justified figure.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the sums themselves are exact.
rounding.step: Once per group, after both figures are known.

result.name: the corrected reserved counters
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: A Location that bypasses reservation holds a counter.
edge_cases.outcome: It is emptied, because nothing there may be promised.

edge_cases.case: Lines exist for a key with no counter at all.
edge_cases.outcome: The counter is raised to the justified figure, unless the Location or the product bypasses reservation.

edge_cases.case: The two figures agree at the product unit's step.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is written.

edge_cases.case: A line is picked but still open.
edge_cases.outcome: It is one of the open statuses and therefore justifies its share of the counter.

worked_examples.description: A counter left too high after a failed transaction

inputs.key: Bolt at shelf A, no lot, no container, no owner

worked_examples.narrative: Four is justified by the open lines while six is reserved, so the counter is lowered by two.

worked_examples.description: A counter standing at a vendor Location
worked_examples.narrative: The Location bypasses reservation, so the whole counter is removed whatever the lines say.

records.name: Deleting empty Stock Quantity records
records.purpose: Removes the records that hold nothing at all, using a digit count generous enough that a rounding remainder left by a chain of conversions still counts as zero.

operands.name: on-hand quantity of the record
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: reserved quantity of the record
operands.constraints: never negative

operands.name: counted quantity of the record
operands.constraints: may be absent

operands.name: assignee for counting
operands.constraints: a record with an assignee is never deleted

operands.name: digit count for the zero tests
operands.source: the greater of six and twice the number of decimal digits of the shipped product-unit precision record
operands.constraints: at least six

preconditions.condition: The housekeeping task is running, which happens when the quantity screens are opened unless the system parameter that skips it is set.
preconditions.otherwise: The empty records simply remain until the next run.

procedure: Compute the digit count as the greater of six and twice the number of decimal digits of the shipped product-unit precision record.
Delete a record when its on-hand quantity rounded to that digit count is zero, or its on-hand quantity is absent.
Require as well that its reserved quantity rounded to that digit count is zero.
Require as well that its counted quantity rounded to that digit count is zero, or that its counted quantity is absent.
Require as well that no user is assigned for counting.
Delete only the records for which all four conditions hold.
records.formula: n = maximum( 6 , 2 × the number of decimal digits of the shipped product-unit precision record ) ; the record is deleted when round to digits( on-hand , n ) = 0 or on-hand is absent , and round to digits( reserved , n ) = 0 , and ( round to digits( counted , n ) = 0 or counted is absent ) , and no user is assigned

rounding.what: The three quantities, each rounded before it is tested against zero.
rounding.precision: The greater of six digits and twice the number of decimal digits of the shipped product-unit precision record.
rounding.step: Once per quantity, immediately before its zero test.

result.name: the deletion of the record
result.stored_or_displayed: The record is removed from storage.

edge_cases.case: A record carries a tiny remainder from a chain of conversions.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds to zero at the generous digit count and the record is deleted.

edge_cases.case: A record has an assignee for counting but holds nothing.
edge_cases.outcome: It survives, because a count has been requested on it.

edge_cases.case: A record has a counted quantity of zero that was deliberately typed.
edge_cases.outcome: It still satisfies the third condition and, with nothing else on the record and no assignee, is deleted.

edge_cases.case: The shipped product-unit precision record has three decimal digits.
edge_cases.outcome: Twice three is six, which equals the floor of six, so the digit count is six.

worked_examples.description: A record left with a conversion remainder
worked_examples.narrative: Twice two is four, which is below six, so six digits are used; the remainder rounds to zero, nothing is reserved or counted and no user is assigned, so the record is deleted.

worked_examples.description: The same record with a counting assignee
worked_examples.narrative: Every quantity is zero but a user is assigned for counting, so the record survives until the count has been made.

records.name: The merge key of two Stock Moves
records.purpose: Defines when two moves of one Transfer describe the same thing and may be collapsed into one, which decides how many lines a document shows and how reservation is organised.

operands.name: the twelve base members of the key
operands.source: the product, the unit price, the supply method, the source Location, the intermediate destination Location, the final Location, the line unit, the owner restriction, the original return move, the propagate-cancel flag, the transfer description and the never-attribute values
operands.constraints: every one must be equal for a merge

operands.name: scheduled date
operands.constraints: added to the key when the system parameter that restricts merging to the same date is set

operands.name: deadline
operands.constraints: added to the key unless the system parameter that ignores the deadline when merging is set

operands.name: unit price precision
operands.source: the smaller of the currency's decimal places and the price precision setting
operands.constraints: used to format the price for the comparison

preconditions.condition: The two moves belong to the same candidate set, meaning the same Transfer, or the target plus the moves being merged.
preconditions.otherwise: They are never compared.

procedure: Take the twelve base members of the key: the product, the unit price, the supply method, the source Location, the intermediate destination Location, the final Location, the line unit, the owner restriction, the original return move, the propagate-cancel flag, the transfer description and the never-attribute values.
Add the scheduled date to the key when the system parameter that restricts merging to the same date is set.
Remove the supply method from the key when the merge is a merge into an explicit target.
Add the deadline to the key unless the system parameter that ignores the deadline when merging is set.
Compare the members that hold a number with a fractional part as text formatted at each field's own precision, so that two values differing only by representation error still merge.
Format the unit price at the smaller of the currency's decimal places and the price precision setting.
Declare the two moves mergeable when every member of the resulting key is equal.
records.formula: merge key = ( product , unit price formatted at minimum( currency decimal places , price precision ) , supply method , source Location , intermediate destination Location , final Location , line unit , owner restriction , original return move , propagate-cancel flag , transfer description , never-attribute values ) , with the scheduled date added when the same-date parameter is set , the supply method removed for a merge into a target , and the deadline added unless the parameter that ignores it is set

rounding.what: Every member holding a number with a fractional part, formatted as text before it is compared.
rounding.precision: Each field's own precision; for the unit price the smaller of the currency's decimal places and the `Product Price` decimal precision.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied by the formatting.
rounding.step: Once per member, at the moment the key is built.

result.name: the merge key of a move
result.stored_or_displayed: Held for the duration of the merge; never stored.

edge_cases.case: Two moves differ only by a representation error in the unit price.
edge_cases.outcome: They merge, because the price is compared as text formatted at its own precision.

edge_cases.case: Two moves carry different unit prices.
edge_cases.outcome: They never merge, which is what stops two different costs from being silently averaged.

edge_cases.case: The merge is into an explicit target.
edge_cases.outcome: The supply method leaves the key, so a move of another supply method may be absorbed.

edge_cases.case: The system parameter that ignores the deadline is set.
edge_cases.outcome: Two moves with different deadlines may merge.

worked_examples.description: Two moves of one receipt with prices that differ only by representation error
worked_examples.narrative: Both prices format to the same text at two decimal places, and every other member is equal, so the two moves merge.

worked_examples.description: Two moves whose prices genuinely differ
worked_examples.narrative: The two prices format differently, so the moves stay separate and each keeps its own cost.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch for a merge into an explicit target

records.name: The move merge algorithm
records.purpose: Collapses the moves of a Transfer that share a merge key into one surviving move and absorbs the negative moves into their positive counterparts, so that the document stays readable and reservation stays efficient.

operands.name: candidate sets of moves
operands.source: the whole move list of each Transfer, or the explicit target together with the moves being merged
operands.constraints: each set is processed on its own

operands.name: merge key of each move
operands.constraints: the grouping key

operands.name: real quantity of each move
operands.source: the move's demand converted into the product unit
operands.constraints: a move whose real quantity is strictly below zero is a negative move

operands.name: demand of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: summed for the surviving move

operands.name: picked flag of each move
operands.constraints: a picked move scheduled for cancellation is not cancelled

preconditions.condition: The negative moves are detached from their Transfer before anything is written.
preconditions.otherwise: The change notes would be posted on a document that is about to lose the move.

procedure: Build the candidate sets: without an explicit target, every Transfer of the moves being merged contributes its whole move list as one set; with an explicit target, one set is formed from the target together with the moves being merged.
Compute the list of key members.

Separate the negative moves, those whose real quantity is strictly less than zero, from the rest, and detach them from their Transfer immediately; their key is the same key without the transfer description.
For each candidate set, drop the moves that are done, cancelled or draft, and the negative moves.

Group the remainder by the full key; for each group of more than one move, re-link every detail line of the group to the group's first move, write the merged values on that first move, schedule the other moves for deletion and remember the first move as merged.
Index the group's surviving move under the negative key.
For each negative move, walk the positive moves indexed under the same negative key and combine them.
Clear the propagate-cancel flag of every move scheduled for deletion or cancellation before it is processed.
Cancel and then delete the moves scheduled for deletion.
Cancel the moves scheduled for cancellation that are not picked.
Return the input moves plus the merged survivors, minus the deleted ones.
records.formula: a group merges when every member of the merge key is equal ; the first move of the group survives and takes the merged values ; a negative move is absorbed by a positive move indexed under the same key without the transfer description

rounding.what: The formatting of the key members that hold a number with a fractional part, and the unit price recomputed when a negative move is absorbed.
rounding.precision: Each field's own precision for the key; the `Product Price` decimal precision for the recomputed unit price.
rounding.step: Once when the key is built, and once when a negative move is absorbed.

result.name: the surviving moves and their merged values
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit and a unit price in the company currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the surviving moves; the others are cancelled and deleted.

edge_cases.case: A move of the group is done, cancelled or draft.
edge_cases.outcome: It is dropped from the grouping and is never merged.

edge_cases.case: A negative move finds no positive counterpart.
edge_cases.outcome: It stays detached and is turned into a return by swapping its Locations, negating its demand and switching to the return Operation Type.

edge_cases.case: A positive move is fully consumed by a negative one.
edge_cases.outcome: Its demand becomes zero and it is scheduled for cancellation, unless it is picked.

edge_cases.case: The surviving move's demand becomes zero after absorbing a negative move.
edge_cases.outcome: It is scheduled for cancellation.

worked_examples.description: Two identical moves of one receipt
worked_examples.narrative: The two moves share every key member, so the first survives with the summed demand of ten, the detail lines are re-linked to it and the second move is cancelled and deleted.

records.name: The unit price after absorbing a negative move
records.purpose: Recomputes the unit price of a move that has absorbed a negative one as the weighted average of the two prices; it is the only arithmetic on a money amount in the whole domain.

operands.name: real quantity of the positive move
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: unit price of the positive move
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per product unit
operands.constraints: written by whichever domain created the move

operands.name: real quantity of the negative move
operands.constraints: strictly negative

operands.name: unit price of the negative move
operands.unit_or_currency: the company currency per product unit
operands.constraints: written by whichever domain created the move

operands.name: surviving real quantity
operands.source: the move that survives the absorption
operands.constraints: the divisor; the result is zero when it is zero

operands.name: Product Price decimal precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record named `Product Price`, the decimal precision setting for product prices
operands.constraints: a digit count

preconditions.condition: The two moves share the merge key without the transfer description.
preconditions.otherwise: The negative move is not absorbed by that positive move at all.

preconditions.condition: The surviving real quantity is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The new unit price is set to zero instead of dividing.

procedure: Multiply the positive move's real quantity by its unit price.
Multiply the negative move's real quantity, which is negative, by its unit price.
Add the two products to obtain the combined value.
Divide the combined value by the surviving real quantity.
Round the quotient to the `Product Price` decimal precision, half away from zero.
Set the new unit price to zero instead when the surviving real quantity is zero.
records.formula: new total value = positive real quantity × positive unit price + negative real quantity × negative unit price ; new unit price = round to digits( new total value ÷ surviving real quantity , Product Price decimal precision ) , or zero when the surviving real quantity is zero

rounding.what: The quotient, which becomes the stored unit price.
rounding.precision: The `Product Price` decimal precision, a digit count.
rounding.step: Once, after the division and before the price is written.

result.name: unit price of the surviving move
result.unit_or_currency: the company currency per product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the move and read by the valuation domain, which only ever sees the already merged figure.

edge_cases.case: The surviving real quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The new unit price is zero and no division is performed.

edge_cases.case: The positive move is fully consumed instead.
edge_cases.outcome: The same formula is applied to the negative move's own real quantity, which then survives.

edge_cases.case: The two prices are equal.
edge_cases.outcome: The weighted average equals that price and nothing changes.

edge_cases.case: The combined value is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The rounded quotient is negative, which is stored as it stands.

worked_examples.description: A positive move of ten at three absorbing a negative move of four at five
worked_examples.narrative: Thirty less twenty gives a combined value of ten, which divided by the surviving six gives one and two thirds, rounded half away from zero at two digits to one and sixty-seven hundredths.

worked_examples.description: The same absorption where the demands cancel exactly
worked_examples.narrative: The surviving real quantity is zero, so no division is performed and the unit price is set to zero; the surviving move, whose demand has become zero, is scheduled for cancellation.

records.name: The merged values of a group of moves
records.purpose: Fixes what the surviving move of a merged group carries, in particular which scheduled date wins under each shipping policy and how the document references are combined.

operands.name: demands of the group's moves
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit, which is a key member and therefore shared
operands.constraints: summed, except in a merge into an explicit target

operands.name: dates of the group's moves
operands.constraints: the minimum or the maximum is taken according to the shipping policy

operands.name: shipping policy of each Transfer of the group
operands.unit_or_currency: as soon as possible, or all at once
operands.source: the Transfers of the group's moves
operands.constraints: the minimum is taken only when every Transfer ships as soon as possible

operands.name: destination moves and originating moves of the group's moves
operands.constraints: united

operands.name: origins of the group's moves
operands.constraints: the distinct ones are joined by a slash

preconditions.condition: The group's moves share every member of the merge key.
preconditions.otherwise: They are not a group and no merged value is computed.

procedure: Set the surviving move's demand to the sum of the demands of the group, or to the first move's demand alone when the merge is into an explicit target.
Set the surviving move's date to the minimum of the group's dates when every Transfer of the group ships as soon as possible, and to the maximum otherwise.
Set the surviving move's destination moves to the union of the destination moves of the group.
Set the surviving move's originating moves to the union of the originating moves of the group.
Set the surviving move's status to the relevant status among the moves of the group, as the state machine of the domain defines it.
Set the surviving move's origin to the distinct origins of the group joined by a slash.
records.formula: merged demand = sum of the demands of the group , or the first move's demand for a merge into an explicit target ; merged date = minimum of the dates when every transfer of the group ships as soon as possible , maximum otherwise ; merged destination moves = union ; merged originating moves = union ; merged origin = the distinct origins joined by "/"

rounding.what: Nothing; the demands are summed in a shared line unit and the dates are compared as they stand.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the values written on the surviving move
result.unit_or_currency: a demand in the line unit, an instant, sets of moves, a status and a text
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the surviving move.

edge_cases.case: The merge is into an explicit target.
edge_cases.outcome: The surviving move keeps the first move's demand instead of the sum, and the supply method has already left the key.

edge_cases.case: One Transfer of the group ships all at once.
edge_cases.outcome: The maximum of the dates is taken, because the condition requires every Transfer to ship as soon as possible.

edge_cases.case: Two moves share an origin.
edge_cases.outcome: It appears once in the joined text, because only the distinct origins are joined.

edge_cases.case: The group's moves have different statuses.
edge_cases.outcome: The relevant status of the group is taken, as the state machine defines it.

worked_examples.description: Two moves of one Transfer that ships as soon as possible
worked_examples.narrative: The demands add to ten, the earlier date wins because the Transfer ships as soon as possible, and the single distinct origin is carried through unchanged.

worked_examples.description: The same two moves on a Transfer that ships all at once
worked_examples.narrative: The later date wins because the goods must leave together, and the two distinct origins are joined by a slash.

records.name: Splitting a move: the unit and the demand of the new move
records.purpose: Decides in which unit a split-off move is expressed and what its demand is, keeping the document's own unit whenever the quantity can be carried in it without loss.

operands.name: quantity to split off
operands.source: the calling operation, for example the backorder step or the reception report
operands.constraints: may be zero, in which case nothing is produced

operands.name: line unit of the original move
operands.constraints: kept by the new move when the round trip is exact

operands.name: product unit
operands.constraints: used when the round trip is not exact

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count, used for the equality test

operands.name: forced unit
operands.source: the calling context, when it insists on a unit for the new move
operands.constraints: optional

preconditions.condition: The move is neither done nor cancelled.
preconditions.otherwise: The split fails with the message that a stock move set to done or cancel may not be split.

preconditions.condition: The move is not in draft.
preconditions.otherwise: The split fails with the message that a draft move may not be split and needs to be confirmed first.

preconditions.condition: The quantity to split off is not zero at the product unit's rounding step.
preconditions.otherwise: Nothing at all is produced.

procedure: Fail when the move is done or cancelled, and fail separately when it is in draft.
Produce nothing when the quantity to split off is zero at the product unit's rounding step.
Convert the quantity to split off from the product unit into the line unit, rounding half away from zero.
Convert that figure back from the line unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
When the quantity to split off and the figure converted back are equal at the Product Unit precision, give the new move the original line unit and a demand equal to the figure in line units.
Otherwise create the new move in the product unit with the quantity to split off as its demand.

Build the new move's values by copying the original and overriding the demand as decided, the supply method, the destination moves that are neither done nor cancelled, all the originating moves, the original return move, the unit price and the deadline; set the owner restriction when one is forced and the source Location when the calling context forces one.
records.formula: line units = convert( split quantity , product unit , line unit , half away from zero ) ; back = convert( line units , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) ; the new move keeps the line unit with a demand of line units when split quantity = back at the Product Unit precision , and is created in the product unit with a demand of split quantity otherwise

rounding.what: The two conversions of the round trip and the equality test between the original quantity and the figure converted back.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit and of the product unit for the conversions; the `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, for the test.
rounding.step: Once, before the unit of the new move is chosen.

result.name: the unit and the demand of the new move
result.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure and a quantity in it
result.stored_or_displayed: Returned as values; the caller creates the move from them.

edge_cases.case: The quantity cannot be expressed exactly in the line unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The new move is created in the product unit, so that no quantity is lost to the conversion.

edge_cases.case: A unit is forced by the calling context.
edge_cases.outcome: The new move is created in that unit.

edge_cases.case: The quantity to split off is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is produced and the original move is untouched.

edge_cases.case: The move is in draft.
edge_cases.outcome: The split is refused with its own message, distinct from the one for a done or cancelled move.

worked_examples.description: Splitting three product units off a move expressed in product units
worked_examples.narrative: The round trip returns the original figure, so the new move keeps the line unit with a demand of three.

worked_examples.description: Splitting five product units off a move expressed in dozens
worked_examples.narrative: Five product units are nought point four two dozen at two digits, which converts back to five point nought four, so the round trip is not exact and the new move is created in the product unit with a demand of five.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that forces the unit of a split move
business-rules.md switch that forces the source Location of a split move

records.name: Splitting a move: the surviving demand of the original
records.purpose: Gives the demand the original move keeps after a quantity has been split off it, written in a way that preserves the reservation the move already holds.

operands.name: real quantity of the original move
operands.source: the move's demand converted into the product unit
operands.constraints: may be smaller than the quantity split off

operands.name: quantity to split off
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: line unit of the move
operands.constraints: the surviving demand is written in it

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count

preconditions.condition: The write of the surviving demand suppresses unreservation.
preconditions.otherwise: Lowering the demand would unreserve the move and the reservation the split is meant to preserve would be lost.

procedure: Subtract the quantity to split off from the original move's real quantity and take the greater of zero and that difference.
Convert the result from the product unit into the line unit without any rounding.
Round the converted figure to the Product Unit precision, half away from zero.
Write it as the move's demand with unreservation suppressed, so that the existing reservation is preserved on the original move.
Recompute the original move's status.
records.formula: new demand = round to digits( convert( maximum( 0 , original real quantity − split quantity ) , product unit , line unit , none ) , Product Unit precision )

rounding.what: The converted surviving demand.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, applied after an unrounded conversion.
rounding.step: Once, after the conversion and before the demand is written.

result.name: the surviving demand of the original move
result.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the move; its status is recomputed as a consequence.

edge_cases.case: The quantity split off equals the whole real quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The surviving demand is zero and the move keeps its reservation until the completion prunes it.

edge_cases.case: The quantity split off exceeds the real quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The clamp at zero applies and the surviving demand is zero rather than negative.

edge_cases.case: The line unit differs from the product unit.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion is made without rounding and only the final figure is rounded, at a digit count rather than at the unit's step.

edge_cases.case: Unreservation is not suppressed.
edge_cases.outcome: The write would unreserve the move; the split therefore always suppresses it.

worked_examples.description: The backorder split of a move of ten of which seven were processed
worked_examples.narrative: Ten less the three carried over leaves seven, which is written as the surviving demand while the reservation for those seven is preserved.

worked_examples.description: A split larger than the move itself
worked_examples.narrative: The difference is negative, so the clamp gives zero and the original move keeps a demand of zero rather than a negative one.

records.name: Backorder creation on the moves
records.purpose: Splits off the part of each move that is not being processed, so that the unfinished demand survives in a backorder while the processed part is completed.

operands.name: processed quantity of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.source: the move, recomputed from its detail lines
operands.constraints: compared against the demand at a digit count

operands.name: demand of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: the figure the shortfall is measured against

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count, deliberately used instead of the line unit's rounding step

operands.name: line unit and product unit
operands.constraints: the shortfall is converted from one to the other

preconditions.condition: Backorders are not forbidden for this completion.
preconditions.otherwise: The step does not run at all and the short moves are cancelled instead.

procedure: For each move being completed, compare the processed quantity with the demand at the Product Unit precision, a digit count, and not at the line unit's rounding step.
Only when the processed quantity is strictly smaller does a backorder move arise for that move.
Compute the quantity to carry over as the demand less the processed quantity, converted from the line unit into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Split the move by that quantity and collect the resulting values.
Create all the backorder moves in one operation.

Confirm them with merging disabled, with supply-request creation disabled and with whole-container detection suppressed, so that their destination containers are not disturbed while the parent Transfer is being completed.
records.formula: a backorder move arises when processed quantity < demand at the Product Unit precision ; carry over = convert( demand − processed quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero )

rounding.what: The comparison of the processed quantity against the demand, and the conversion of the shortfall into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, for the comparison; the rounding step of the product unit for the conversion.
rounding.method: Comparison at the digit count; half away from zero for the conversion.
rounding.step: The comparison first, once per move; the conversion only when a shortfall exists.

result.name: the backorder moves and the reduced demands of the originals
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the line unit or the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored; the backorder moves are confirmed and later moved into the Transfer backorder.

edge_cases.case: The processed quantity exceeds the demand.
edge_cases.outcome: No backorder move is created, because the test is strictly smaller.

edge_cases.case: The processed quantity equals the demand at the digit count but not at the line unit's step.
edge_cases.outcome: No backorder move is created, because the comparison is deliberately made at the digit count.

edge_cases.case: Backorders are forbidden.
edge_cases.outcome: The step does not run and the short moves are cancelled by the pruning of the completion algorithm.

edge_cases.case: The backorder moves are confirmed.
edge_cases.outcome: Merging, supply-request creation and whole-container detection are all disabled for that confirmation.

worked_examples.description: A move of ten of which seven are processed
worked_examples.narrative: Seven is strictly below ten at two digits, so three are carried over into a backorder move and the original move keeps a demand of seven.

worked_examples.description: The Bolt move of the second worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve is not strictly below twelve at the digit count, so no backorder move is split off that move even though the Transfer as a whole will produce a backorder for its other move.

records.name: The completion algorithm of a set of moves
records.purpose: The algorithm that actually moves the goods: it prunes, splits the backorders, completes the detail lines, writes the done status and then pushes, propagates and backorders, in an order that no caller may change.

operands.name: input set of Stock Moves
operands.source: the validation of a Transfer, an inventory adjustment, a scrap or a manufacturing operation
operands.constraints: may contain draft moves

operands.name: flag forbidding backorders
operands.constraints: decides between splitting and cancelling the short moves

operands.name: processed quantity and picked flag of each move
operands.unit_or_currency: a quantity in the line unit and a yes or no flag
operands.constraints: decide whether the move is pruned, cancelled or completed

operands.name: adjustment flag of each move
operands.constraints: an adjustment move is completed even with a zero processed quantity

operands.name: detail lines of the moves to complete
operands.constraints: sorted by destination container descending, then by identifier

preconditions.condition: The pruning happens before the backorder split.
preconditions.otherwise: A move that pruning would have cancelled would be split instead.

preconditions.condition: The backorder split happens before the lines are completed.
preconditions.otherwise: Completing the lines changes the processed quantity the split measures against.

procedure: Confirm the moves of the set that are still in draft, with merging disabled, and add the results to the set.
Restrict the set to the moves that exist and whose status is neither done nor cancelled.

Prune: for a picked move, schedule for deletion every one of its detail lines that is not picked; for a move that is not an adjustment move and whose processed quantity is not strictly positive or which is not picked, cancel it when its demand is zero at the line unit or when backorders are forbidden; then delete the scheduled lines.
Select: keep the moves that are not cancelled, that either have a strictly positive processed quantity or are adjustment moves, and that are picked; call this set the moves to complete.
Run the company consistency check on the moves to complete.
Unless backorders are forbidden, create the backorder moves.
Sort the detail lines of the moves to complete by destination container descending and then by identifier, and run the line completion on them.

For every destination container of the picked lines that holds more than one quantity record, fail when those records with a strictly positive quantity sit in more than one Location, with the message about moving the same package content more than once, a line break, the words "Package: " and the container name.
When any line of the moves to complete has the same source container and destination container, run the empty-record deletion.
Write the status done and the current instant as the date on the moves to complete.

Push: take the moves that must not skip the push step, meaning those that are not adjustment moves and none of whose destination moves has a source Location that is an ancestor or a descendant of this move's destination Location, and apply the push rules.
Propagate: group the destination moves of the moves to complete by company and re-run the reservation on each group, with elevated rights, in that company.
Stop and return the moves when the calling context marks the operation as a scrap.
When the moves belong to a Transfer and backorders are not forbidden, create the Transfer backorder, and run whole-container detection on it when any of its moves is assigned.
Re-check the serial-number uniqueness constraint over the destination Locations and lots of the moves to complete.
Run the order-synchronisation hook, which does nothing in this domain and which other domains use to write back delivered quantities.
Return the moves to complete.
records.formula: the moves to complete = { moves that are not cancelled , that have a strictly positive processed quantity or are adjustment moves , and that are picked } ; each of them is written with the status done and the current instant as its date, after its lines have moved the goods

rounding.what: The comparison of a demand against zero during the pruning, and every comparison inside the line completion.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit for the pruning; the line unit's step and the `Product Unit` decimal precision inside the line completion.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step and at the digit count.
rounding.step: Once per move during the pruning, and once per line inside the completion.

result.name: the completed moves, the moved quantities and the records created by the push and the backorder
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the product unit and instants
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the moves, the detail lines, the Stock Quantity records, the containers and the new Transfers.

edge_cases.case: A move has a zero processed quantity and a zero demand.
edge_cases.outcome: It is cancelled by the pruning.

edge_cases.case: A move has a zero processed quantity and backorders are forbidden.
edge_cases.outcome: It is cancelled by the pruning rather than carried over.

edge_cases.case: A move is an adjustment move with a zero processed quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: It survives the pruning and is completed, which is how a count of zero is recorded.

edge_cases.case: The operation is a scrap.
edge_cases.outcome: The algorithm stops after the propagation and creates no Transfer backorder.

edge_cases.case: A destination container ends up split across Locations.
edge_cases.outcome: The completion fails with the message about moving the same package content more than once, naming the container.

worked_examples.description: The completion step of the second worked trace of the document

expected_outputs.pruning: the Paint move is not cancelled, because backorders are allowed and its demand is not zero

worked_examples.narrative: Only the picked Bolt move is completed; its processed quantity is not below its demand so no backorder move is split off it; the unpicked Paint move survives and is carried into the Transfer backorder at the end.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that marks the operation as a scrap

records.name: The rounding check of a detail line at completion
records.purpose: Refuses a line whose quantity cannot be represented consistently at both the unit's rounding step and the general digit count, which is where a mistyped quantity in an unusual unit is caught.

operands.name: line quantity
operands.constraints: must be representable at both precisions

operands.name: rounding step of the line unit
operands.source: the unit of measure of the line
operands.constraints: strictly positive

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count

operands.name: product display name and line unit name
operands.source: the product and the unit, used in the refusal message
operands.constraints: always available

preconditions.condition: The line is being completed.
preconditions.otherwise: The check is not made; the general precision check of the move applies when the processed quantity is written instead.

procedure: Round the line quantity at the line unit's rounding step, half away from zero, and call the result the unit-rounded figure.
Round the line quantity to the Product Unit precision, half away from zero, and call the result the digit-rounded figure.
Compare the two figures at the Product Unit precision.

When they differ, fail with the message that the quantity done for the named product does not respect the rounding precision defined on the named unit of measure, asking for the quantity or the unit's rounding precision to be changed.
records.formula: unit rounded = the line quantity rounded at the line unit's rounding step , half away from zero ; digit rounded = round to digits( line quantity , Product Unit precision ) ; the line is refused when unit rounded ≠ digit rounded at the Product Unit precision

rounding.what: The line quantity, rounded twice in two different ways, and the comparison of the two results.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit for one figure; the `Product Unit` decimal precision, a digit count, for the other and for the comparison.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for both.
rounding.step: Once per line, as the first check of the completion.

result.name: the rounding verdict of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: A failure stops the whole completion with the quoted message.

edge_cases.case: The line unit's rounding step is coarser than the digit count allows.
edge_cases.outcome: The two figures differ and the line is refused, which is the situation the check exists for.

edge_cases.case: The line unit's rounding step is one hundredth and the general precision is two digits.
edge_cases.outcome: The two figures agree for every representable quantity and the check always passes.

edge_cases.case: The quantity is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Both figures are zero and the check passes; the zero line is then scheduled for deletion unless it is an adjustment line.

worked_examples.description: A line of twelve in a unit whose rounding step is one hundredth, with a general precision of two digits
worked_examples.narrative: The two figures agree, so the line passes, as both lines of the second worked trace of the document do.

worked_examples.description: A line of two and a half in a unit whose rounding step is a whole unit
worked_examples.narrative: Rounding at the unit's step gives three while rounding at two digits gives two and a half, so the two differ and the completion is refused with the message about the rounding precision defined on the unit of measure.

records.name: Classifying the detail lines and resolving their lots at completion
records.purpose: Sorts the lines by quantity, refuses a negative one, deletes a zero one and settles which tracked lines still need a Lot before any goods are allowed to move.

operands.name: quantity of each line
operands.constraints: classified as strictly positive, strictly negative or zero

operands.name: tracking mode of the product
operands.constraints: an untracked product needs no lot

operands.name: exclusion from the lot requirement
operands.source: the line's move having an Operation Type, being an adjustment move, the line already having a lot, or the move belonging to a Scrap
operands.constraints: an excluded line is not recorded as tracked without a lot

operands.name: lot policy of the Operation Type
operands.constraints: creating lots and using existing lots are separate choices

operands.name: typed lot names
operands.constraints: matched against the existing Lots of the product and company

preconditions.condition: Every line has passed the rounding check.
preconditions.otherwise: The completion has already failed.

procedure: For a strictly positive quantity on an untracked product, accept the line as it is.
For a strictly positive quantity on a tracked product, when the line is not excluded from the lot requirement, record it as tracked without a lot.
Then, when there is no Operation Type, or the line already has a lot, or the Operation Type allows neither creating nor using existing lots, accept the line as it is.
Otherwise, when the Operation Type allows creating lots, record the line for lot resolution under the key of product and company; when it does not, record it as tracked without a lot.
For a strictly negative quantity, fail with the message that no negative quantities are allowed.
For a zero quantity, schedule the line for deletion unless it is an adjustment line.

Resolve the lots: for each group of product and company, search the existing Lots of that product whose company is that company or empty and whose name is one of the typed names; link a line to the Lot found for its typed name; record a line for creation when it has a typed name but no Lot was found; record it as tracked without a lot when it has no typed name at all.

When any line was recorded as tracked without a lot, fail with the message that a Lot or Serial Number must be supplied for the product, followed by one line per distinct product display name each prefixed by a hyphen and a space.
Create the missing Lots and link them.
Delete the lines scheduled for deletion and run the company consistency check on the survivors.
records.formula: a line is accepted when its quantity > 0 and either the product is untracked , or a lot is linked or resolvable , or the Operation Type allows neither creating nor using lots ; a line is refused when its quantity < 0 ; a line is deleted when its quantity = 0 and it is not an adjustment line

rounding.what: The classification of each quantity as positive, negative or zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, after the rounding check.

result.name: the accepted lines, the Lots linked to them and the deletions
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the lines; the failures stop the completion with their quoted messages.

edge_cases.case: A tracked line has no Operation Type at all.
edge_cases.outcome: The exclusion polarity means it is recorded as tracked without a lot and the completion fails, unless it is an adjustment line, already lotted or part of a scrap.

edge_cases.case: The Operation Type allows neither creating nor using lots.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is accepted without a lot, which is the supported way to receive or ship tracked goods without recording numbers.

edge_cases.case: A typed name matches no existing Lot and the Operation Type allows creating lots.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is recorded for creation and a Lot is created for it.

edge_cases.case: A line of zero is an adjustment line.
edge_cases.outcome: It survives, which is how a count of zero is recorded.

edge_cases.case: Several products are missing their lots.
edge_cases.outcome: One message lists each distinct product display name on its own line, prefixed by a hyphen and a space.

worked_examples.description: A completion of three lines of different kinds

expected_outputs.L3: recorded for lot creation, a Lot named LOT-A is created and linked

worked_examples.narrative: The untracked positive line is accepted, the zero line is deleted because it is not an adjustment line, and the tracked line's typed name becomes a new Lot.

worked_examples.description: A tracked line with neither a Lot nor a typed name

expected_outputs.outcome: the completion fails with the message that a Lot or Serial Number must be supplied for the product, listing the product display name prefixed by a hyphen and a space

worked_examples.narrative: Nothing identifies the goods, so the line is recorded as tracked without a lot and the whole completion stops.

related_rules: business-rules.md rule 6.1 on lots and products

records.name: Creating the missing Lots at completion
records.purpose: Turns the names a person typed on the detail lines into Lot records, creating one per name for a lot-tracked product and one per line for a serial-tracked one.

operands.name: typed names recorded for creation
operands.source: the lot resolution of the completion checks
operands.constraints: grouped with their product

operands.name: tracking mode of the product
operands.constraints: decides whether one record per name or one per line is created

operands.name: company of the line
operands.constraints: carried onto the Lot only under the two conditions below

operands.name: company of the product
operands.constraints: the Lot takes the line's company only when the product itself belongs to a company

preconditions.condition: The Operation Type allows creating lots.
preconditions.otherwise: No Lot is created and the line is recorded as tracked without a lot, which stops the completion.

procedure: Build one creation entry per distinct pair of product and typed name, except that for a product tracked by serial number one Lot is created per line even when the names repeat.
Give each entry the typed name and the product.
Give the entry the line's company as well when the product itself belongs to a company and the line's company is that company or one of its descendants.
Create the Lots.
Write each created Lot back onto all the lines that share its key.
records.formula: number of Lots created = the number of distinct pairs of product and typed name , for a product tracked by lot ; = the number of lines carrying a typed name , for a product tracked by serial number

rounding.what: Nothing; the calculation counts records.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the created Lots and the links written on the lines
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored; each Lot is written on every line that typed its name.

edge_cases.case: The same name is typed on two lines of a lot-tracked product.
edge_cases.outcome: One Lot is created and written on both lines.

edge_cases.case: The same name is typed on two lines of a serial-tracked product.
edge_cases.outcome: One Lot is created per line, which the uniqueness rule then rejects, so the person is told to correct the numbers.

edge_cases.case: The product belongs to no company.
edge_cases.outcome: The created Lot carries no company either, so it joins the company-less pool the uniqueness check compares against.

edge_cases.case: The line's company is a descendant of the product's company.
edge_cases.outcome: The Lot takes the line's company.

worked_examples.description: Two lines of a lot-tracked product typing the same name
worked_examples.narrative: One Lot is created for the single distinct pair of product and name and is written on both lines.

worked_examples.description: Two lines of a serial-tracked product typing the same name

expected_outputs.outcome: the uniqueness rule rejects the duplicate pair of product and name

worked_examples.narrative: One Lot is created per line, which produces two records with the same product and name, and the uniqueness check refuses them with its message listing the duplicate combination.

records.name: Moving the quantities at completion
records.purpose: The step that physically moves the goods, in a fixed order per line that keeps the reserved counters, the on-hand quantities and the arrival dates all correct.

operands.name: surviving detail lines
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: walked in the order the completion sorted them

operands.name: quantity of each line in the product unit
operands.source: the line's quantity converted from its own unit
operands.constraints: the figure by which each counter moves

operands.name: source Location, lot, source container and owner of each line
operands.constraints: the key the goods are taken from

operands.name: destination Location, lot, destination container and owner of each line
operands.constraints: the key the goods are put into

operands.name: returned available quantity and incoming date
operands.unit_or_currency: the product unit and an instant
operands.source: the writing routine when the source is decreased
operands.constraints: a negative available quantity triggers the freeing of reservations

preconditions.condition: The container history snapshots have been written before anything moves.
preconditions.otherwise: The snapshots would record the arrangement after the movement instead of before it.

preconditions.condition: The order per line is: release the reservation, take from the source, compensate lot-less negatives, put into the destination, free other reservations.
preconditions.otherwise: Any other order leaves one of the counters wrong.

procedure: Pre-load the quantity records for the surviving lines' products across their source and destination Locations, restricted to the lines' lots or to no lot.
Unless the calling context says to ignore destination containers, build the container history snapshots before anything moves, and create them.

For each surviving line, in order, release the reservation by lowering the reserved counter at the source by the line's quantity in the product unit; skip this when the move bypasses reservation for the source Location.

Take the goods out by decreasing the on-hand quantity at the source by the line's quantity in the product unit, using the line's lot, source container and owner, and remember the returned available quantity and the returned incoming date.

When the returned available quantity is negative and the line has a lot, read the strictly matched available quantity at the source with no lot; when it is non-zero, take the smaller of it and the absolute moved quantity away from the lot-less records and add the same amount to the lot's records.

Put the goods in by increasing the on-hand quantity at the destination Location by the same quantity, with the line's lot, the line's destination container and the line's owner, stamping the remembered incoming date.
When the available quantity returned when the source was decreased was negative, free other reservations for its absolute value, excluding every line already processed in this loop.
Add the line to the excluded set and continue with the next line.
Unless destination containers are being ignored, apply the destination containers to the containers themselves.
Stamp the current instant as the date of every surviving line.
records.formula: per line: reserved(source key) decreases by the line quantity in the product unit ; on-hand(source key) decreases by the same ; on-hand(destination key) increases by the same , stamped with the incoming date the source returned ; reservations freed = | negative available quantity returned at the source |

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, before the counters are moved.

result.name: the moved quantities, the stamped arrival dates and the freed reservations
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the product unit and instants
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Stock Quantity records, on the containers and on the detail lines.

edge_cases.case: The source goes negative for a lot-bearing line while lot-less stock exists at the same Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The lot-less pocket is reduced and the lot's records are raised by the same amount, which keeps the lot-level figure consistent instead of leaving a negative lot beside a positive untracked pocket.

edge_cases.case: The move bypasses reservation for its source Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The release step is skipped, because no counter was ever raised.

edge_cases.case: The source available quantity comes back negative.
edge_cases.outcome: Other reservations are freed for its absolute value, excluding the lines already processed in this loop.

edge_cases.case: The calling context ignores destination containers.
edge_cases.outcome: Neither the snapshots nor the application of the destination containers runs, which is what an inventory adjustment asks for.

records.name: The container history snapshots
records.purpose: Records, before any goods move, where every container of the destination chain stood and where it is going, so that the history of a container survives the movement.

operands.name: destination containers of the lines
operands.constraints: the whole destination chain of each is covered

operands.name: current Location of each container
operands.source: the container, read before the movement
operands.constraints: must be read before the quantities move

operands.name: destination Location of each container
operands.constraints: where the container is going

operands.name: parent container before the move and its full name
operands.constraints: read before the movement

operands.name: outermost destination container
operands.constraints: recorded on every snapshot of the chain

preconditions.condition: The snapshots are written before any quantity moves.
preconditions.otherwise: They would record the arrangement after the movement and the history would be useless.

preconditions.condition: The calling context does not ask for destination containers to be ignored.
preconditions.otherwise: No snapshot is created at all.

procedure: Take every container in the full destination chain of the lines' destination containers.
Create one snapshot per container, carrying the container itself and its full name.
Carry its current Location and its destination Location.
Carry the lines whose destination container is that container, and the Transfers of those lines.
Carry the parent container before the move and that parent's full name.
Carry the destination container and its destination-path name, and the outermost destination container.
records.formula: one snapshot per container of the full destination chain , carrying the container , its full name , its current Location , its destination Location , the lines targeting it , the Transfers of those lines , the parent before the move and that parent's full name , the destination container with its destination-path name , and the outermost destination container

rounding.what: Nothing; the snapshot records references and names.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the container history snapshots
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored, and displayed as the movement history of a container.

edge_cases.outcome: Both are in the destination chain and both receive a snapshot, each carrying the same outermost container.

edge_cases.case: No line carries a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: The chain is empty and no snapshot is created.

edge_cases.case: Destination containers are ignored.

records.name: Selecting the push rule for a completed move
records.purpose: Finds the rule that says the goods must continue beyond the Location they have just reached, and refuses to apply it to a return of a return.

operands.name: completed move
operands.constraints: already in the done status

operands.name: Warehouse to consider
operands.source: the move's own Warehouse, else the Warehouse of the Transfer's Operation Type
operands.constraints: none is considered when the destination Location belongs to a company that is not among the active ones

operands.name: Routes to pass
operands.source: the move's own preferred Routes together with the Routes of the container types in the destination chain of its detail lines
operands.constraints: passed to the rule engine

operands.name: packaging unit
operands.unit_or_currency: a unit of measure, or nothing
operands.constraints: passed to the rule engine

operands.name: original return move
operands.constraints: decides the last acceptance test

preconditions.condition: The move does not skip the push step, meaning it is not an adjustment move and none of its destination moves has a source Location that is an ancestor or a descendant of its destination Location.
preconditions.otherwise: No rule is looked for at all.

procedure: Determine the Warehouse to consider: the move's own Warehouse, else the Warehouse of the Transfer's Operation Type; when the move's destination Location belongs to a company that is not among the active ones, perform the rule search with elevated rights, read the move with all the user's companies allowed and consider no Warehouse.
Collect the container types of the containers in the destination chain of the move's detail lines and add their Routes to the move's own preferred Routes.
Ask the rule engine of the replenishment and procurement domain for a push rule for the move's product at the move's destination Location, passing those Routes, the Warehouse and the packaging unit.
While the returned rule carries an applicability filter and the move does not match it, add the rule to an exclusion list and ask again excluding those rules.
Accept the rule only when the move is not a return, or when it is a return whose original move's destination Location differs from the rule's destination Location.
records.formula: the rule is accepted when the move is not a return , or when it is a return and the destination Location of its original move ≠ the rule's destination Location

rounding.what: Nothing; the selection compares Locations, Routes and filters.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the push rule to run, or nothing
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the running of the rule; never stored on its own.

edge_cases.case: The returned rule carries an applicability filter the move does not match.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded and the engine is asked again, until a matching rule is found or none is.

edge_cases.case: The move is the return of a return whose original destination is the rule's destination.
edge_cases.outcome: The rule is refused, which is what stops the chain from pushing back and forth.

edge_cases.case: The destination Location belongs to an inactive company.
edge_cases.outcome: The search runs with elevated rights, the move is read with all the user's companies allowed and no Warehouse is considered.

edge_cases.case: A container of the destination chain carries a type with its own Routes.
edge_cases.outcome: Those Routes are added to the move's preferred Routes before the engine is asked.
