records.name: Handling a conflict between a count and a movement
records.purpose: Stops the application of a set of counts when some of them were typed against figures that have since moved, and gives the person the choice of keeping or discarding those counts.

operands.name: set of records being applied
operands.constraints: the whole set is carried to the conflict screen

operands.name: outdated subset
operands.source: the outdated indicator of each record
operands.constraints: the records whose on-hand quantity has moved since the count was typed

operands.name: the person's answer
operands.constraints: decides what happens to the outdated counts

preconditions.condition: At least one record of the set is outdated.
preconditions.otherwise: The counts are applied directly and no conflict screen opens.

procedure: Before applying, collect the records of the set that are outdated.
When there is at least one, open the conflict screen instead of applying, carrying the whole set and the outdated subset.
When the person chooses to keep the counted quantities, apply them unchanged.
When the person chooses to discard them, clear the counted quantities of the outdated records.
records.formula: the conflict screen opens when the count of outdated records > 0 ; keeping applies every counted quantity as typed ; discarding clears the counted quantity of each outdated record and leaves the others untouched

rounding.what: The comparison inside the outdated indicator of each record.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per record, before the screen is opened.

result.name: the applied or cleared counted quantities
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the records; the application then proceeds for the counts that survive.

edge_cases.case: Only some records of the set are outdated.
edge_cases.outcome: The screen carries the whole set as well as the outdated subset, and discarding clears only the outdated ones.

edge_cases.case: The person keeps the counts.
edge_cases.outcome: They are applied exactly as typed, so the movement that happened in the meantime is overwritten by the count.

edge_cases.case: No record is outdated.
edge_cases.outcome: The screen does not open and the counts are applied at once.

R2

R2

records.name: Reverting an inventory adjustment
records.purpose: Undoes a set of completed count corrections by creating the mirror movements, with their Locations and containers swapped, under a reference that names the original.

operands.name: completed adjustment detail lines
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: only lines with a non-zero quantity qualify

operands.name: source and destination Locations of each line
operands.constraints: swapped on the mirror

operands.name: source and destination containers of each line
operands.constraints: swapped on the mirror

operands.name: reference of the original adjustment
operands.constraints: the mirror's reference is that text followed by the word reverted in square brackets

preconditions.condition: At least one completed adjustment detail line has a non-zero quantity.
preconditions.otherwise: The notification that there are no inventory adjustments to revert is shown and nothing is created.

procedure: Take each completed adjustment detail line whose quantity is not zero.
Build a mirror move with the same product and unit, the line's quantity as demand, the confirmed status, the source and destination Locations swapped, the adjustment flag and the picked flag.

Give the mirror move one detail line with the quantities and characteristics swapped in the same way, so that the destination container becomes the source container and the source container becomes the destination container.
Set the reference of each mirror move to the original reference followed by the word reverted in square brackets.
Create the moves and complete them.
Show the notification that there are no inventory adjustments to revert when no line qualified.
records.formula: the mirror move carries the same product and unit , the line's quantity as demand , the confirmed status , the source Location and the destination Location swapped , the source container and the destination container swapped , the adjustment flag and the picked flag ; its reference is "*the original reference* [reverted]"

rounding.what: Nothing; the quantity is copied and only the completion applies its own rounding.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, inside the completion.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, inside the completion.
rounding.step: Only inside the completion of the mirror moves.

result.name: the completed mirror moves
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored and completed, which restores the on-hand quantities to what they were before the adjustment.

edge_cases.case: An adjustment line carries a quantity of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped, because only non-zero lines qualify.

edge_cases.case: No line qualifies at all.
edge_cases.outcome: The notification that there are no inventory adjustments to revert is shown.

edge_cases.case: The original line carried a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: The mirror carries it as its source container, so the goods leave the container they were put into.

edge_cases.case: The mirror moves are completed.
edge_cases.outcome: They are ordinary completed movements and are handed over to the valuation domain like any other.

worked_examples.narrative: The mirror move brings the unit back from the inventory-loss Location into the stock Location under a reference naming the original as reverted.

records.name: The last count date of a quantity record
records.purpose: Gives the day a Stock Quantity record was last counted, by searching the completed adjustment lines that touch its exact combination of Location, container, product, lot and owner.

operands.name: completed adjustment detail lines
operands.source: the adjustment moves of the system
operands.constraints: grouped by their seven-part key

operands.name: grouping key of the search
operands.unit_or_currency: product, lot, source container, owner, destination container, source Location and destination Location
operands.constraints: the maximum date is taken per group

operands.name: combinations reachable from a group
operands.unit_or_currency: Location, container, product, lot and owner
operands.source: the two Locations crossed with the two containers of the group
operands.constraints: each indexed with the group's maximum date

operands.name: the record's own combination
operands.unit_or_currency: Location, container, product, lot and owner
operands.constraints: the key it reads its date from

preconditions.condition: At least one completed adjustment line matches the record's combination.
preconditions.otherwise: The record has no last count date.

procedure: Take the completed adjustment detail lines and group them by product, lot, source container, owner, destination container, source Location and destination Location, keeping the maximum date per group.
For each group, index every combination of Location, container, product, lot and owner that is reachable from it, meaning the two Locations crossed with the two containers.
Keep the maximum date per combination.

Let the record read the date of its own combination, matching on the product, on the lot or having none, on the owner or having none, on the container either as source or as destination container or having none, and on the Location either as source or as destination Location.
records.formula: last count date(record) = maximum over the completed adjustment detail lines whose product , lot , owner , container and Location match the record , where the container matches as either the source or the destination container and the Location as either the source or the destination Location , of the line's date

rounding.what: Nothing; the maximum is taken over dates.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: last count date of the record
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the record and used, at the Location level, to compute the next count date.

edge_cases.case: The record has never been touched by an adjustment.
edge_cases.outcome: It has no last count date.

edge_cases.case: An adjustment moved goods out of the record's Location and into the inventory-loss Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The record's Location matches as the source Location, so the line counts.

edge_cases.case: An adjustment moved goods into the record's Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The Location matches as the destination Location, so the line counts as well.

edge_cases.case: The line carries no lot while the record does.
edge_cases.outcome: The match allows the line to have none, so an untracked adjustment still dates a lot-bearing record.

worked_examples.description: A record touched by two adjustments
worked_examples.narrative: Both lines touch the record's combination, one through its source Location and one through its destination Location, and the later of the two dates is taken.

records.name: The availability text of a Transfer
records.purpose: Gives the short indication of whether a delivery or an internal transfer can be served now, and if not when it is expected, together with the colour state that goes with it.

operands.name: status of the Transfer
operands.constraints: only waiting another operation, waiting and ready are evaluated

operands.name: kind of the Operation Type
operands.unit_or_currency: receipt, delivery, internal transfer or another kind
operands.constraints: only a delivery or an internal transfer is evaluated

operands.name: forecast availability of each move
operands.constraints: compared against the move's real quantity

operands.name: real quantity of each move
operands.constraints: the threshold the forecast is compared against

operands.name: forecast expected date of each move
operands.constraints: the greatest is taken

operands.name: scheduled date of the Transfer
operands.constraints: compared against the greatest expected date

preconditions.condition: The Transfer's status is waiting another operation, waiting or ready, and its Operation Type is a delivery or an internal transfer.
preconditions.otherwise: The Transfer has no availability text and no state at all.

procedure: Start with the text "Available" and the state whose stored value marks availability.

When any move has a product and its forecast availability is strictly less than its real quantity, or, for a draft move, strictly less than zero, set the text to "Not Available" and the state to the one that marks lateness.
Otherwise take the greatest forecast expected date among the moves that have one.

When there is one, set the text to "Exp " followed by that date formatted for the reader, and set the state to the one that marks lateness when the Transfer's scheduled date is earlier than that date, and otherwise to the one that marks an expected date.
records.formula: text = "Not Available" when any move's forecast availability < its real quantity , or < 0 for a draft move ; = "Exp " followed by the greatest forecast expected date , when one exists ; = "Available" otherwise ; the state is late when the text is "Not Available" or when the scheduled date is earlier than that expected date , expected when it is not , and available otherwise

rounding.what: The comparison of the forecast availability against the real quantity.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per move.

result.name: the availability text and its state
result.unit_or_currency: a text and a stored state value
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the Transfer list and form.

edge_cases.case: The Transfer is a receipt.
edge_cases.outcome: It has no availability text and no state, because only deliveries and internal transfers are evaluated.

edge_cases.case: The Transfer is done or cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: It has no availability text either, because only the three open statuses are evaluated.

edge_cases.case: A draft move has a negative forecast availability.
edge_cases.outcome: The text becomes "Not Available", the threshold for a draft move being zero rather than its real quantity.

edge_cases.case: The greatest expected date is not later than the scheduled date.
edge_cases.outcome: The state marks an expected date rather than lateness.

worked_examples.description: A delivery every move of which is covered
worked_examples.narrative: The forecast covers the demand and no expected date exists, so the Transfer shows as available.

worked_examples.description: A delivery whose goods are expected after the plan
worked_examples.narrative: The forecast covers the demand but only by the twentieth, which is after the planned eighteenth, so the expected date is shown and the state marks lateness.

records.name: The forecast information of a move
records.purpose: Gives, per move, the quantity that will be available for it and the date it is expected, which is what the availability text of a Transfer is built from.

operands.name: storability of the product
operands.constraints: a move of a product that holds no stock takes its real quantity at once

operands.name: key of Warehouse and date
operands.source: the later of the move's date and the current instant, with the source Location's Warehouse for a consuming or internal move and the destination Location's for an incoming move
operands.constraints: the figures are pre-read per key

operands.name: free quantity and forecast quantity at that key
operands.constraints: read once per key

operands.name: status of the move
operands.constraints: decides which of the six branches applies

operands.name: report lines of the forecast report
operands.source: the forecast report of the replenishment and procurement domain
operands.constraints: consulted for the deferred consuming moves

preconditions.condition: The move has a product.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to forecast.

procedure: Give every move of a product that holds no stock its own real quantity as its forecast availability.

For the storable ones, pre-read the free quantity and the forecast quantity per pair of Warehouse and date, where the date is the later of the move's date and the current instant and the Warehouse is the source Location's for a consuming or internal move and the destination Location's for an incoming move.
Give a move whose status is assigned its processed quantity converted into the product unit, rounding half away from zero.
Give a draft move whose free quantity at that key is greater than or equal to its real quantity that free quantity.
Give a consuming move in draft the forecast quantity when that covers its real quantity, and otherwise the forecast quantity less its real quantity.
Defer a consuming move whose status is waiting another move, waiting or partially available to the outgoing computation.
Give an internal move its free quantity when that covers its real quantity.
Give an incoming move the forecast quantity at the destination Warehouse, plus its own real quantity when it is still draft.
Group the deferred consuming moves by Warehouse and then by source Location and hand them to the forecast report, which returns per move an expected quantity and an expected date.

For each report line that names an outgoing move: accumulate the line's quantity into the expected quantity when the line is marked as filled, and otherwise take the negated line quantity; when the line also names an incoming move, take the greater of that move's date and the date accumulated so far as the expected date.
records.formula: forecast availability = the real quantity for a product that holds no stock ; = convert( processed quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) for an assigned move ; = the free quantity for a draft move whose free quantity covers its real quantity ; = the forecast quantity , or the forecast quantity − the real quantity , for a consuming move in draft ; = the free quantity for an internal move that it covers ; = the forecast quantity at the destination Warehouse , plus the real quantity when the move is draft , for an incoming move

rounding.what: The conversion of an assigned move's processed quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per assigned move.

result.name: the forecast availability and the forecast expected date of the move
result.unit_or_currency: the product unit and an instant
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the move and consumed by the availability text of its Transfer.

edge_cases.case: The product holds no stock.
edge_cases.outcome: The move is always considered covered, its forecast availability being its own real quantity.

edge_cases.case: A consuming move is waiting or partially available.
edge_cases.outcome: It is deferred to the forecast report, which returns both a quantity and a date for it.

edge_cases.case: A report line is not marked as filled.
edge_cases.outcome: Its quantity is taken negated, which is what turns an unfilled need into a shortfall.

edge_cases.case: A report line names an incoming move.
edge_cases.outcome: The expected date becomes the greater of that move's date and the date accumulated so far.

worked_examples.description: An assigned delivery move of twelve
worked_examples.narrative: An assigned move already holds its goods, so its forecast availability is simply its processed quantity converted into the product unit.

worked_examples.description: A waiting delivery move of five for which the forecast report finds three filled and two unfilled
worked_examples.narrative: The filled line contributes three and the unfilled one contributes minus two, giving one; the incoming move named on the filled line sets the expected date to the twentieth of September.

records.name: Whether the detail screen button of a move is shown
records.purpose: Decides when a person is offered the detailed operations of a move, which is the screen where lots, containers and source Locations are typed.

operands.name: product of the move
operands.constraints: the button is hidden without one

operands.name: status of the move
operands.constraints: the button is hidden in draft

operands.name: lot policy of the Operation Type
operands.constraints: both being off hides the button unless a group grants it

operands.name: groups of the reading user
operands.constraints: the container group, the multi-location group and the consignment group each grant the button

operands.name: number of detail lines of the move
operands.constraints: more than one always shows the button

operands.name: tracking mode of the product
operands.constraints: a tracked product shows the button

preconditions.condition: The move has a product and is not in draft.
preconditions.otherwise: The button is hidden.

procedure: Hide the button when the move has no product.
Hide it when the move is in draft.
Hide it when the Operation Type allows neither creating nor using lots while the user is in neither the container group nor the multi-location group.
Show it always when the move has more than one detail line.
Otherwise show it when the user is in the multi-location group, the container group or the consignment group, or when the product is tracked.
Hide it in every other case.
records.formula: shown = ( the move has a product ) and ( the move is not draft ) and not ( the Operation Type allows neither creating nor using lots and the user is in neither the container group nor the multi-location group ) and ( the move has more than one detail line or the user is in the multi-location group, the container group or the consignment group , or the product is tracked )

rounding.what: Nothing; the decision counts lines and tests memberships.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the visibility of the detail screen button
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the move line of the Transfer form.

edge_cases.case: The move has exactly one detail line, the product is untracked and the user is in none of the three groups.
edge_cases.outcome: The button is hidden, because there is nothing to detail.

edge_cases.case: The move has two detail lines.
edge_cases.outcome: The button is always shown, whatever the groups and the tracking.

edge_cases.case: The Operation Type allows neither creating nor using lots.
edge_cases.outcome: The button is hidden unless the user is in the container group or the multi-location group.

worked_examples.description: The Bolt move of the first worked trace of the document, after its reservation
worked_examples.narrative: The move has a product, is not in draft and has more than one detail line, so the button is shown whatever the groups.

worked_examples.description: A single-line move of an untracked product for a plain user
worked_examples.narrative: There is one line, the product is untracked and the user is in none of the three groups, so nothing would be gained by opening the detail screen and the button is hidden.

related_rules: business-rules.md permission checks on the multi-location, container and consignment groups

records.name: Whether the reception report button is shown
records.purpose: Decides when a Transfer or a batch offers the allocation screen, which requires both the right group and at least one open demand that the arrival could serve.

operands.name: membership of the reception-report group
operands.constraints: required

operands.name: kind of the Operation Type
operands.unit_or_currency: receipt, delivery, internal transfer or another kind
operands.constraints: must exist and must not be a delivery

operands.name: moves of the Transfer with a storable product
operands.constraints: at least one must be not cancelled

operands.name: candidate demands elsewhere
operands.source: the moves of the same Warehouse
operands.constraints: must satisfy the six conditions of the search

operands.name: view Location of the Operation Type's Warehouse
operands.constraints: the candidate's source Location must be inside it

preconditions.condition: The user is in the reception-report group.
preconditions.otherwise: The button is hidden.

preconditions.condition: The Operation Type exists and is not a delivery.
preconditions.otherwise: The button is hidden.

procedure: Require that the user is in the reception-report group.
Require that the Operation Type exists and is not a delivery.
Require that the Transfer has at least one move with a storable product that is not cancelled.
Require that at least one other move exists with a status of confirmed, partially available or waiting another move, plus assigned when the Transfer is already done.

Require of that other move a strictly positive real quantity, a source Location inside the Operation Type's Warehouse view Location but not of vendor usage, a Transfer outside the set being evaluated, a product among the Transfer's products, and either no originating move at all or an originating move among the Transfer's own moves.
Show the button when every requirement holds and hide it otherwise.
records.formula: shown = ( the user is in the reception-report group ) and ( the Operation Type exists and is not a delivery ) and ( at least one non-cancelled move has a storable product ) and ( at least one other move satisfies the six conditions of the search )

rounding.what: The test of the candidate's real quantity against zero.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per candidate.

result.name: the visibility of the allocation button
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the Transfer or the batch.

edge_cases.case: The Transfer is already done.
edge_cases.outcome: Assigned moves are accepted as candidates as well, so the report can still be used to allocate goods that have arrived.

edge_cases.case: A candidate already has an originating move outside the Transfer.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded, because it is already promised elsewhere.

edge_cases.case: A candidate's source Location has vendor usage.
edge_cases.outcome: It is excluded, because it is itself an arrival rather than a demand.

edge_cases.case: No other document demands the products.
edge_cases.outcome: The button is hidden, because there would be nothing to allocate to.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of a product two open deliveries are waiting for
worked_examples.narrative: Every requirement holds, so the allocation button is offered on the receipt.

worked_examples.description: The same receipt for a user outside the group
worked_examples.narrative: The first requirement fails, so the button is hidden whatever the demands elsewhere.

related_rules: business-rules.md permission check on the reception-report group

records.name: The operation overview graph
records.purpose: Counts the open Transfers of an Operation Type into six named day buckets, and turns the whole series into sample data when there is nothing to show.

operands.name: scheduled dates of the Operation Type's Transfers
operands.source: the Transfers whose status is ready, waiting another operation or waiting
operands.constraints: only those three statuses are read

operands.name: date categories
operands.unit_or_currency: the six named ranges around today
operands.constraints: an empty date belongs to none

operands.name: bucket labels
operands.source: the fixed order of the six buckets
operands.constraints: reproduced as they are shown

operands.name: identifier of the Operation Type
operands.constraints: omitted from a sample series so that clicking it does nothing

preconditions.condition: The reading user's time zone is known, so that the day boundaries can be anchored.
preconditions.otherwise: The buckets would differ between readers.

procedure: Read the scheduled dates of the Operation Type's Transfers whose status is ready, waiting another operation or waiting.
Bucket each date by the six date categories and count the Transfers of each bucket.

Emit six buckets in a fixed order with the labels "Before", "Yesterday", "Today", "Tomorrow", "The day after tomorrow" and "After", the first two marked as past, the third as present and the last three as future.
Name the series "Transfers".
When all six counts are zero, rename the series "Sample data", mark every bucket's kind as sample and omit the Operation Type identifier, so that clicking the series does nothing.
records.formula: count(bucket) = the number of Transfers of the Operation Type whose status is ready, waiting another operation or waiting and whose scheduled date falls in that bucket's category ; the series is renamed and marked as sample when every count is zero

rounding.what: The truncation of the current instant to midnight in the reader's time zone, inherited from the date categories.
rounding.precision: Whole days in the reader's time zone.
rounding.method: Truncation to the start of the day.
rounding.step: Once, before the boundaries are derived.

result.name: the six counted buckets and the series name
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the operation overview of each Operation Type.

edge_cases.case: No open Transfer exists for the Operation Type.
edge_cases.outcome: Every count is zero, so the series is renamed sample data and carries no Operation Type identifier.

edge_cases.case: A Transfer has no scheduled date.
edge_cases.outcome: It belongs to no category and is counted in no bucket.

edge_cases.case: A Transfer is done or cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not read at all, only the three open statuses being counted.

worked_examples.description: An Operation Type with four open Transfers when today is the eleventh of September 2026
worked_examples.narrative: One Transfer falls in the earlier bucket, one in yesterday and two in today, so the series carries real counts and stays named for Transfers.

worked_examples.description: An Operation Type with no open Transfer
worked_examples.narrative: Every count is zero, so the series is renamed and marked as sample and clicking it does nothing.

records.name: The on-hand quantity of a lot
records.purpose: Gives the quantity of one lot that is currently held within the Locations the reading context selects, which is the figure the lot screens show.

operands.name: Location filter
operands.unit_or_currency: a set of conditions on Stock Quantity records
operands.source: the product-quantity computation of the replenishment and procurement domain, which honours the Location, Warehouse, company and date context
operands.constraints: always applied

operands.name: lot condition
operands.constraints: always added

operands.name: owner and container conditions
operands.constraints: added only when they are in the context

operands.name: on-hand quantities of the matching records
operands.constraints: summed per lot

preconditions.condition: The reading context does not ask for a date in the past.
preconditions.otherwise: The figure is corrected by replaying the movements that happened after the cut-off.

procedure: Take the Location filter from the product-quantity computation, which honours the Location, the Warehouse, the company and the date of the reading context.
Add the lot condition, and the owner and container conditions when those are in the context.
Sum the on-hand quantities of the matching records per lot.
records.formula: on-hand quantity(lot) = sum of the on-hand quantities of the Stock Quantity records matching the Location filter , the lot , and the owner and container conditions when they are in the context

rounding.what: Nothing; the sum is exact.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: on-hand quantity of the lot
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the Lot record and in the traceability screens.

edge_cases.case: The reading context names no Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The Location resolution falls back to the view Locations of every Warehouse of the reader's enabled companies.

edge_cases.case: The context carries an owner.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the records of that owner are summed.

edge_cases.case: The lot sits in more than one Location.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is the total across the selected Locations, and the single-Location field of the lot may not be written while that is so.

worked_examples.description: A lot held on two shelves of one warehouse
worked_examples.narrative: Both shelves are inside the warehouse's view Location, so the two records are summed to ten.

records.name: The on-hand quantity of a lot at a past date
records.purpose: Corrects the current quantity of a lot backwards to a chosen instant, by undoing the completed movements of that lot that happened after it.

operands.name: current quantity of the lot
operands.source: the on-hand quantity of the lot within the selected Locations
operands.constraints: the starting figure

operands.name: completed incoming detail lines of the lot dated after the cut-off
operands.source: the detail lines of that lot
operands.constraints: subtracted

operands.name: completed outgoing detail lines of the lot dated after the cut-off
operands.source: the detail lines of that lot
operands.constraints: added back

operands.name: cut-off instant
operands.constraints: must be earlier than now for the correction to run

preconditions.condition: The reading context asks for a date in the past.
preconditions.otherwise: The current figure is returned as it stands.

procedure: Compute the current quantity of the lot within the selected Locations.
Subtract, for every completed incoming detail line of that lot dated after the cut-off, its quantity in the product unit.
Add, for every completed outgoing detail line of that lot dated after the cut-off, its quantity in the product unit.
Return the corrected figure.
records.formula: quantity at a date(lot) = current quantity(lot) − sum over the completed incoming detail lines of that lot dated after the cut-off of ( quantity in the product unit ) + sum over the completed outgoing detail lines of that lot dated after the cut-off of ( quantity in the product unit )

rounding.what: The conversion of each line's quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per line, as each sum is accumulated.

result.name: on-hand quantity of the lot at the cut-off instant
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed when the reading context carries a past date.

edge_cases.case: No movement happened after the cut-off.
edge_cases.outcome: The corrected figure equals the current one.

edge_cases.case: The lot arrived entirely after the cut-off.
edge_cases.outcome: The incoming sum equals the current quantity and the figure is zero.

edge_cases.case: A movement is not completed.
edge_cases.outcome: It is ignored, because only completed lines are replayed.

worked_examples.description: A lot holding ten now, having received six and shipped two since the cut-off
worked_examples.narrative: Ten less the six that arrived plus the two that left gives six, which is what the lot held at the cut-off.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that evaluates the quantity figures at an instant

records.name: The quantity proposed when a quantity record is picked
records.purpose: Fills in the quantity of a detail line when a person picks a Stock Quantity record in the detail screen, offering what the record can give without exceeding what the move still needs.

operands.name: demand of the move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: converted into the line's own unit

operands.name: processed quantity of the move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: converted into the line's own unit

operands.name: available quantity of the picked record
operands.constraints: converted into the line's own unit

operands.name: line unit
operands.constraints: every figure is expressed in it before the comparison

preconditions.condition: The line has no quantity yet.
preconditions.otherwise: The proposal does not run and the typed quantity stands.

procedure: Convert the move's demand from the move's line unit into the line's unit, rounding half away from zero.
Convert the move's processed quantity the same way.
Convert the record's available quantity from the product unit into the line's unit, rounding half away from zero.
When the converted demand exceeds the converted processed quantity, propose the greater of zero and the smaller of the record's converted available quantity and the difference between the two.
Otherwise propose the greater of zero and the record's converted available quantity.
records.formula: demand in the line unit = convert( move demand , move line unit , line unit , half away from zero ) ; processed in the line unit = convert( move processed quantity , move line unit , line unit , half away from zero ) ; record available in the line unit = convert( record available quantity , product unit , line unit , half away from zero ) ; line quantity = maximum( 0 , minimum( record available in the line unit , demand in the line unit − processed in the line unit ) ) when demand in the line unit > processed in the line unit ; = maximum( 0 , record available in the line unit ) otherwise

rounding.what: The three conversions into the line's unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the line unit.
rounding.step: Once per figure, before the comparison and the clamps.

result.name: the proposed quantity of the detail line
result.stored_or_displayed: Written onto the detail line in the detail screen.

edge_cases.case: The record's available quantity is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The clamp at zero applies and nothing is proposed.

edge_cases.case: The move is already fully processed.
edge_cases.outcome: The second branch applies and the whole available quantity of the record is proposed, which is how an over-processing is entered.

edge_cases.case: The record offers more than the move still needs.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the shortfall is proposed.

edge_cases.case: The line already carries a quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing is proposed.

worked_examples.description: Picking a record offering nine for a move that demands twelve and has already processed four
worked_examples.narrative: The move still needs eight, which is less than the nine the record can give, so eight is proposed.

worked_examples.description: Picking the same record for a move that is already fully processed
worked_examples.narrative: The demand does not exceed the processed quantity, so the second branch applies and the whole nine is proposed.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that creates a detail line from a chosen quantity record

records.name: Assigning lots on a move: the free quantity and the surplus
records.purpose: Computes how much quantity is available to spread over the lots a person has named, reserving at least one product unit per lot because every lot needs its own line.

operands.name: processed quantity and demand of the move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: the greater of the two is taken

operands.name: existing detail lines
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: a line whose lot is in the list keeps it and its quantity is subtracted from the free figure

operands.name: requested lots
operands.source: the lot list being written on the move
operands.constraints: each needs its own line

operands.name: working unit
operands.source: the product unit for a serial-tracked product and the move's line unit otherwise
operands.constraints: fixed before the lines are rebuilt

preconditions.condition: The product is tracked.
preconditions.otherwise: The whole lot assignment is skipped.

preconditions.condition: The move is not already assigned with every line carrying a lot of the list and with its set of line lots exactly equal to the list.
preconditions.otherwise: The assignment is skipped, there being nothing to change.

procedure: Skip an untracked product, and skip a move that is already assigned, all of whose lines carry a lot from the list, and whose set of line lots is exactly the list.
Take the product unit as the working unit for a serial-tracked product and the move's line unit otherwise.
Compute the free quantity as the greater of the processed quantity and the demand, converted from the line unit into the product unit rounding half away from zero.

Walk the existing lines: skip a line whose quantity is zero; remember a line with neither a Lot nor a typed name as available; let a line whose lot name is in the list keep that lot, remember it as assigned and subtract its quantity in the product unit from the free quantity; delete any other line.
Compute the surplus as the free quantity less the number of requested lots that are not yet assigned, which reserves at least one product unit per lot.
records.formula: free = convert( maximum( processed quantity , demand ) , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) , reduced by the quantity in the product unit of every existing line whose lot is in the list ; surplus = free − ( the number of requested lots not yet assigned )

rounding.what: The conversion of the greater of the processed quantity and the demand into the product unit, and the conversion of each kept line's quantity.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once for the free figure and once per kept line.

result.name: the free quantity and the surplus
result.stored_or_displayed: Held while the lines are rebuilt; never stored.

edge_cases.case: The surplus is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: More lots were requested than there are product units, and each lot still gets a line of one unit, which the move's processed quantity then exceeds.

edge_cases.case: A line already carries a lot of the list.
edge_cases.outcome: It is kept and its quantity is taken out of the free figure, so it is not offered twice.

edge_cases.case: A line carries a lot that is not in the list.
edge_cases.outcome: It is deleted.

edge_cases.case: A line carries neither a Lot nor a typed name.
edge_cases.outcome: It is remembered as available and may be reused for one of the requested lots.

worked_examples.description: Writing three lots on a move demanding ten with no existing line
worked_examples.narrative: Ten is free and three lots each need one unit, so seven remain as surplus to spread over the lots that can take more.

worked_examples.description: The same move where one line already carries lot A with four units
worked_examples.narrative: The line carrying lot A is kept and its four units leave the free figure, so six remain; two lots still need one unit each and the surplus is four.

records.name: Assigning lots on a move that bypasses reservation
records.purpose: Builds one detail line per requested lot when the goods come from outside the reserved world, where nothing has to be found in stock first.

operands.name: unassigned requested lots
operands.constraints: each produces one line

operands.name: available lines
operands.unit_or_currency: detail lines with neither a Lot nor a typed name
operands.source: the walk of the existing lines
operands.constraints: reused in order

operands.name: surplus
operands.source: the free quantity less the number of unassigned lots
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: tracking mode of the product
operands.constraints: decides whether a line is forced to one unit

operands.name: working unit
operands.source: the product unit for a serial-tracked product and the move's line unit otherwise
operands.constraints: written on the reused line

preconditions.condition: The move bypasses reservation.
preconditions.otherwise: The reserving variant applies and the records at the source Location are gathered.

procedure: For each unassigned requested lot, reuse an available line when there is one, writing the lot, its name, the working unit and a quantity of one for a serial-tracked product or the line's own quantity otherwise.
Reduce the surplus by that quantity in the product unit less one, because one unit was already reserved for the lot.
When no available line remains, create a line of one unit.
Enlarge that new line by the whole surplus when the product is lot-tracked and the surplus is positive, and set the surplus to zero.
Force a recomputation of the move's processed quantity when every lot has been handled.
records.formula: a reused line takes a quantity of one for a serial-tracked product and its own quantity otherwise , and the surplus falls by that quantity in the product unit minus one ; a created line takes one unit , enlarged by the whole surplus when the product is lot-tracked and the surplus is positive , after which the surplus is zero

rounding.what: The conversion of a reused line's quantity into the product unit before the surplus is reduced.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per reused line.

result.name: the rebuilt detail lines of the move
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored; the move's processed quantity is recomputed from them.

edge_cases.case: The product is serial-tracked.
edge_cases.outcome: Every line carries exactly one unit and the surplus is never spread, because a serial number identifies a single unit.

edge_cases.case: The product is lot-tracked and the surplus is positive.
edge_cases.outcome: The first created line takes the whole surplus, so the quantity is not spread evenly over the lots.

edge_cases.case: The surplus is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: No line is enlarged and every lot still gets one unit.

edge_cases.case: An available line exists.
edge_cases.outcome: It is reused rather than deleted and re-created, which keeps its position in the line list.

worked_examples.description: Three lots written on a receipt of ten of a lot-tracked product with no existing line
worked_examples.narrative: The first created line takes one unit plus the whole surplus of seven, giving eight, and the two remaining lots take one unit each, so the ten units are spread as eight, one and one.

worked_examples.description: The same three lots on a serial-tracked product
worked_examples.narrative: Each serial number identifies one unit, so three lines of exactly one unit are created and the surplus is not spread.

records.name: Assigning lots on a move that reserves
records.purpose: Builds the detail lines of the requested lots from the stock actually at the source Location, taking at least one unit per lot and spreading the surplus over the records it finds.

operands.name: unassigned requested lots
operands.constraints: each is walked in turn

operands.name: quantity records at the source Location grouped by lot
operands.constraints: records with no lot or no available quantity are skipped

operands.name: surplus
operands.source: the free quantity less the number of unassigned lots
operands.constraints: reduced as each line is created

operands.name: tracking mode of the product
operands.constraints: a serial-tracked line is forced to exactly one unit

operands.name: available lines left over
operands.unit_or_currency: detail lines with neither a Lot nor a typed name
operands.source: the walk of the existing lines
operands.constraints: deleted and re-created while the surplus lasts

preconditions.condition: The move does not bypass reservation.
preconditions.otherwise: The bypassing variant applies and no record is gathered.

procedure: Gather the quantity records at the source Location, grouped by lot.
For each unassigned lot, walk its records, skipping those with no lot or no available quantity.
Take the smaller of the record's available quantity and the greater of one and the surplus increased by one when nothing has yet been reserved for this lot.
Create a line for that quantity, forced to exactly one unit in the product unit for a serial-tracked product.
Reduce the surplus by the taken quantity, or by the taken quantity less one when this was the first line for the lot.
Stop walking that lot's records once something has been reserved for it and the surplus is exhausted.
Create a line of one unit anyway when nothing at all could be reserved for a lot.

When available lines remain at the end, delete them all and re-create them in order while the surplus lasts, each for the smaller of its own quantity and the remaining surplus, which moves them to the end of the line list so that the reduction of a processed quantity gives them back before the lot-bearing lines.
Force a recomputation of the move's processed quantity.
records.formula: take = minimum( the record's available quantity , maximum( surplus + ( 0 when something was already reserved for this lot , 1 otherwise ) , 1 ) ) ; the surplus falls by the taken quantity , or by the taken quantity − 1 when this was the first line for the lot

rounding.what: The comparison of the taken quantity and of the surplus against zero, and the conversions into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for the conversions; comparison at the step for the tests.
rounding.step: Once per line created.

result.name: the rebuilt detail lines of the move and the raised reserved counters
result.unit_or_currency: quantities in the working unit and in the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored; the move's processed quantity is recomputed from the lines.

edge_cases.case: Nothing at all can be reserved for a lot.
edge_cases.outcome: A line of one unit is created anyway, so the person sees the lot and the shortage.

edge_cases.case: The product is serial-tracked.
edge_cases.outcome: Every created line is forced to exactly one unit in the product unit.

edge_cases.case: The surplus runs out while a lot still has records.
edge_cases.outcome: The walk of that lot stops once something has been reserved for it.

edge_cases.case: Available lines remain at the end.
edge_cases.outcome: They are deleted and re-created at the end of the list, which changes the order in which a later reduction gives them back.

worked_examples.description: Two lots written on a move of ten where lot A offers eight and lot B offers three
worked_examples.narrative: For the first lot the take is the smaller of eight and the surplus of eight raised by one, that is eight; the surplus falls by eight less one, leaving one. For the second lot the take is the smaller of three and one raised by one, that is two; the surplus falls by two less one, reaching zero.

worked_examples.description: A lot that is not in stock at all
worked_examples.narrative: No record offers the lot, so a line of one unit is created anyway and nothing is reserved for it.

records.name: The grouping key of a printed document
records.purpose: Defines which detail lines are shown as one line on a printed document, so that the same goods described the same way are not repeated.

operands.name: product identifier and product display name
operands.constraints: the first two members of the key

operands.name: description
operands.source: the move's transfer description with the product display name, or failing that the product name, stripped from its front
operands.constraints: the third member

operands.name: line unit identifier
operands.constraints: the fourth member

operands.name: packaging unit identifier
operands.constraints: the fifth member

operands.name: container identifier
operands.constraints: appended when the line has one

preconditions.condition: The description has had the product's display name, or failing that its name, stripped from its front.
preconditions.otherwise: Two lines whose descriptions differ only by that prefix would not group.

procedure: Take the product identifier, the product display name, the description, the line unit identifier and the packaging unit identifier, joined in that order by an underscore.
Build the description as the move's transfer description with the product display name, or failing that the product name, stripped from its front.
Append the container identifier when the line has a destination container.
Group the lines of the document by the resulting key.
records.formula: line key = product identifier ‖ "_" ‖ product display name ‖ "_" ‖ description ‖ "_" ‖ line unit identifier ‖ "_" ‖ packaging unit identifier , with the container identifier appended when the line has a destination container

rounding.what: Nothing; the key is built from identifiers and texts.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the printing group key of a detail line
result.stored_or_displayed: Used to group the lines of the printed document; never stored.

edge_cases.case: Two lines of the same product sit in different containers.
edge_cases.outcome: Their keys differ by the appended container identifier, so they are shown separately.

edge_cases.case: Two lines carry different units.
edge_cases.outcome: Their keys differ and they are shown separately.

edge_cases.case: The transfer description begins with the product's display name.
edge_cases.outcome: That prefix is stripped, so the key is built from the remaining description alone.

worked_examples.description: Two lines of one product in the same unit, one of them packed
worked_examples.narrative: The two keys differ only by the appended container identifier, so the packed line and the loose line are printed as two separate lines.

records.name: The printed quantities of a group
records.purpose: Gives the quantity shown for a printed group, in the move's own unit and in the packaging unit, so that a document shows both the loose figure and the number of packagings.

operands.name: quantities of the group's detail lines
operands.constraints: converted into the move's line unit

operands.name: move line unit
operands.constraints: the unit of the printed quantity

operands.name: packaging unit
operands.constraints: the unit of the second figure

preconditions.condition: The lines of the group share the key, which includes the line unit identifier and the packaging unit identifier.
preconditions.otherwise: They would not be one group.

procedure: Convert each line's quantity into the move's line unit and sum the results, giving the group quantity.
Convert the group quantity from the move's line unit into the packaging unit, giving the group packaging quantity.
records.formula: group quantity = sum over the group's lines of convert( line quantity , line unit , move line unit ) ; group packaging quantity = convert( group quantity , move line unit , packaging unit )

rounding.what: The rounding of the printed figures at the move's line unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the move's line unit.
rounding.step: At the aggregation, once per group.

result.name: the group quantity and the group packaging quantity
result.unit_or_currency: the move's line unit and the packaging unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the printed document.

edge_cases.case: The move has no packaging unit.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the group quantity is shown.

edge_cases.case: The lines of the group carry the same unit as the move.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion changes nothing and the sum is exact.

edge_cases.case: The group holds one line.
edge_cases.outcome: Its own quantity is the group quantity.

worked_examples.description: A group of two lines of four and eight in the move's own unit, with a packaging unit of six
worked_examples.narrative: The two lines sum to twelve in the move's unit, which is two whole packagings of six.

records.name: The ordered quantity shown on a printed document
records.purpose: Gives the figure that tells a reader how much was originally ordered for a printed group, by walking the chain of backorders and subtracting what the other lines of the same move already show.

operands.name: demand of the move
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the move
operands.constraints: the starting figure

operands.name: demands of the moves of the backorder chain
operands.source: the backorders of the Transfer, their backorders and so on down the chain
operands.constraints: only the moves whose key is a prefix of this key are added

operands.name: quantities of the other detail lines of the same move
operands.constraints: only the lines whose key is a prefix of this key are subtracted

operands.name: move line unit
operands.constraints: the figure is rounded at it

preconditions.condition: The strict mode is not requested.
preconditions.otherwise: No ordered quantity is computed at all.

procedure: Start from the move's demand.
Walk the chain of backorders of the Transfer, meaning its backorders, their backorders and so on, and add the demands of the moves whose own key is a prefix of this key.
Subtract the quantities of the other detail lines of the same move whose key is a prefix of this key.
Round the result at the move's line unit.

Add, for every move of the Transfer and of its backorders that has a demand but a zero processed quantity, a line with no processed quantity when the move is cancelled, or when it is confirmed with no detail line at all, or add its demand to an existing group whose key it prefixes.
records.formula: ordered quantity = the move's demand + sum over the moves of the backorder chain whose key is a prefix of this key of ( their demand ) − sum over the other detail lines of the same move whose key is a prefix of this key of ( their quantity ) , rounded at the move's line unit

rounding.what: The final ordered figure.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the move's line unit.
rounding.step: Once, at the end of the three-step arithmetic.

result.name: the ordered quantity of the printed group
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the printed document beside the processed quantity.

edge_cases.case: The strict mode is requested.
edge_cases.outcome: No ordered quantity is computed at all.

edge_cases.case: A move of the chain has a key that is not a prefix of this key.
edge_cases.outcome: Its demand is not added, so a differently described line does not inflate the figure.

edge_cases.case: A move has a demand but no detail line and is confirmed.
edge_cases.outcome: A line with no processed quantity is added for it, or its demand joins an existing group whose key it prefixes.

edge_cases.case: A move is cancelled with a demand and no processed quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: It is treated the same way, so the document still shows what was ordered.

worked_examples.description: A delivery of ten shipped as seven with a backorder of three
worked_examples.narrative: The move that is being printed demands seven and the backorder demands the remaining three, so the document shows an ordered quantity of ten beside the seven that are leaving.

records.name: Building the reception report
records.purpose: Shows, for a set of arrivals, which open demands each incoming move could be allocated to, and how much of it is already claimed by the moves that follow it.

operands.name: incoming moves
operands.source: the moves of the documents whose product is storable and which are not cancelled
operands.constraints: the arrivals being offered

operands.name: move quantity of each incoming move
operands.source: the move's real quantity, or its processed quantity converted into the product unit when the real quantity is zero
operands.constraints: the figure that is offered

operands.name: quantity already claimed per product
operands.source: the destination moves of the incoming moves
operands.constraints: deducted before anything is offered

operands.name: candidate demands
operands.source: the search for open moves of the same products in the same Warehouse
operands.constraints: ordered by reservation date, then priority descending, then date, then identifier

operands.name: quantity still to cover of each demand
operands.source: the demand's real quantity, reduced by its already-processed quantity when the documents are not done and the demand is partially available
operands.constraints: the figure the assignable list is consumed against

preconditions.condition: The documents are Transfers that are not deliveries and not cancelled.
preconditions.otherwise: The report refuses with the message that no transfer is selected or a delivery order is selected.

preconditions.condition: The set does not mix done and not-done documents.
preconditions.otherwise: The report refuses with the message that it cannot be used for done and not done transfers at the same time.

procedure: Take the moves of the documents whose product is storable and which are not cancelled, and call them the incoming moves.
Compute, per product, the total quantity already claimed by the destination moves of those incoming moves.

Walk the incoming moves; for each one take its real quantity as the move quantity, or, when that is zero, its processed quantity converted from the line unit into the product unit rounding half away from zero.

When the move has destination moves, deduct from the product's claimed total the smaller of that total and the move quantity, record that amount as already assigned for the product together with the move, and treat only the rest of the move quantity as offerable.
Record the rest as a draft expected quantity for the product when the move is still draft, and as an assignable pair of quantity and move otherwise.

Search the demands to offer: moves whose status is confirmed, partially available or waiting another move, plus assigned when the documents are already done, with a strictly positive real quantity, a source Location inside the Warehouse view Location but not of vendor usage, no originating move, a product among those collected, and a Transfer outside the document set.
Order those demands by reservation date, then priority descending, then date, then identifier.
Group the demands by product and walk them; determine each demand's source document, and skip the demand when it has none.

Compute the quantity still to cover as the demand's real quantity, reduced by its already-processed quantity converted into the product unit when the documents are not done and the demand is partially available.
Consume the product's assignable list from the front, accumulating until the quantity to cover is reached, and write partially consumed entries back with their remainder.
Emit a report line for a non-zero accumulated quantity under the demand's source, naming the incoming moves consumed.

When the demand is still not covered and the product has a draft expected quantity, emit a second, non-assignable line for the smaller of that expected quantity and the shortfall, and reduce the expected quantity.

For each product with an already-assigned total, walk the destination moves of the recorded incoming moves, skipping once the total is exhausted, and emit for each one a line marked as assigned for the smaller of the remaining total and that move's real quantity.
Group the emitted lines by source document for printing and format each source's scheduled date.
records.formula: move quantity = the move's real quantity , or convert( processed quantity , line unit , product unit , half away from zero ) when the real quantity is zero ; already assigned = minimum( the product's claimed total , move quantity ) ; the quantity offered to a demand = as much of the product's assignable list as its quantity still to cover takes

rounding.what: The conversion of a processed quantity into the product unit when the real quantity is zero, and the conversion of a partially available demand's processed quantity.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per move and once per partially available demand.

result.name: the report lines, grouped by source document
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed and printed; nothing is stored until the person assigns.

edge_cases.case: The set mixes done and not-done documents.
edge_cases.outcome: The report refuses with the message about done and not done transfers at the same time.

edge_cases.case: The set is empty or holds a delivery.
edge_cases.outcome: The report refuses with the message about no transfers selected or a delivery order selected.

edge_cases.case: An incoming move already has destination moves.
edge_cases.outcome: That part of its quantity is shown as already assigned rather than offered again.

edge_cases.case: An incoming move is still draft.
edge_cases.outcome: Its quantity is a draft expected quantity, which may only be shown as a non-assignable line.

edge_cases.case: A demand has no source document.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped.

worked_examples.description: A receipt of ten offered to two demands of six and five
worked_examples.narrative: The first demand consumes six of the ten, leaving four; the second demand can only be offered those four, so its report line shows four and one remains uncovered.

related_rules: business-rules.md permission check on the reception-report group

records.name: Assigning an arrival to a demand in the reception report
records.purpose: Links an incoming move to an open demand for a chosen quantity, splitting the demand first when only part of it is being linked and moving the detail lines so that only the unreserved part is assigned.

operands.name: demands to link
operands.source: the person's choice in the report
operands.constraints: each with a quantity to link

operands.name: quantity to link to each demand
operands.constraints: may be smaller than the demand's real quantity

operands.name: incoming moves offered for each demand
operands.constraints: walked from the last to the first

operands.name: remaining quantity of an incoming move
operands.source: its move quantity less the sum of the real quantities of its destination moves
operands.constraints: must be strictly positive for the move to be linked

operands.name: processed quantity of each demand
operands.unit_or_currency: the line unit of the demand
operands.constraints: decides how the detail lines are moved after a split

preconditions.condition: The split moves are written directly to the confirmed status rather than confirmed through the normal path.
preconditions.otherwise: The confirmation would create an unintended reservation on the split part.

procedure: For every demand whose real quantity is strictly greater than the quantity being linked, split off the excess and remember the pairing.
Create all the split moves at once, write them directly to the confirmed status so that no unintended reservation is created, and copy each parent's reservation date onto them.

For a demand that was split and whose first offered incoming move is not done while the demand already had a processed quantity, move all of the demand's detail lines onto the split move, so that only the unreserved part is being assigned.

For a demand that was split and whose first offered incoming move is done while the demand's processed quantity exceeds the quantity being linked, move all the detail lines onto the split move, then pull lines back onto the original demand, preferring the lines whose source Location is one of the incoming moves' destination Locations, accumulating their quantities until the linked quantity is reached and splitting the last line in two when it would overshoot.
Walk the offered incoming moves from the last to the first; skip a move whose product differs, or whose remaining quantity is not strictly positive.

Otherwise link it as an originating move of the demand, share the document references both ways, switch the demand's supply method to advanced, and reduce the quantity still to link by the smaller of the move quantity and that quantity.
Stop when nothing is left to link.
Recompute the statuses of the demands and of the split moves.
Run the reservation on the demands, so that a done incoming move immediately reserves its goods instead of letting another document take them.
records.formula: remaining quantity of an incoming move = its move quantity − sum of the real quantities of its destination moves ; the quantity still to link falls by minimum( the move quantity , the quantity still to link ) at each linked move ; a demand is split when its real quantity > the quantity being linked

rounding.what: The conversions inside the split and inside the reservation that follows.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit` decimal precision inside the split; the rounding step of the product unit inside the reservation.
rounding.step: Once per split and once per reservation.

result.name: the linked chain, the split moves and the reservations they obtain
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the moves, on their links and on the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: The demand's real quantity equals the quantity being linked.
edge_cases.outcome: No split occurs and the whole demand is linked.

edge_cases.case: The first offered incoming move is done and the demand is over-reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The detail lines are moved onto the split move and then pulled back preferring the lines whose source is a destination Location of the incoming moves, with the last line split when it would overshoot.

edge_cases.case: An offered incoming move has nothing left.
edge_cases.outcome: It is skipped, because its remaining quantity is not strictly positive.

edge_cases.case: The offered moves are walked from the last to the first.
edge_cases.outcome: The most recently offered arrivals are consumed first.

worked_examples.description: Linking four of a demand of six to one incoming move of ten
worked_examples.narrative: Two are split off so that the original demand carries exactly the four being linked; the incoming move is linked as its originating move, the supply method becomes advanced and the reservation is run so that the goods are claimed at once.

records.name: Unassigning an arrival from a demand in the reception report
records.purpose: Breaks the link between an incoming move and a demand, splitting off whatever remains linked so that the freed part goes back to taking from stock.

operands.name: offered incoming moves
operands.constraints: only those that really are originating moves of the demand are unlinked

operands.name: requested quantity
operands.constraints: the walk stops once it is reached

operands.name: move quantity of each unlinked move
operands.constraints: accumulated against the requested quantity

operands.name: remaining originating moves of the demand
operands.constraints: the sum of their real quantities is the quantity still linked

operands.name: detail lines of the demand
operands.unit_or_currency: quantities in each line's own unit
operands.constraints: moved onto the split move and partly handed back

preconditions.condition: The offered move really is an originating move of the demand.
preconditions.otherwise: It is skipped, because there is no link to break.

procedure: For each offered incoming move that really is an originating move of the demand, unlink it, un-share the document references, and accumulate the smaller of the requested quantity and that move's move quantity.
Stop once the requested quantity is reached.
When the demand still has originating moves and is not done, split off the quantity that is still linked, meaning the sum of the real quantities of the remaining originating moves.
Create the split move with the advanced supply method, the parent's reservation date and the confirmed status.
Move all the demand's detail lines onto the split move and recompute both processed quantities.
When the split move is now over-reserved, hand the excess back to the original demand line by line, splitting the last line when needed.
Clear the original demand's originating links and recompute the split move's status.
Set the demand's supply method back to take from stock and unreserve it.
records.formula: accumulated = sum over the unlinked incoming moves of minimum( the requested quantity still to reach , that move's move quantity ) ; the quantity split off = the sum of the real quantities of the originating moves that remain

rounding.what: The conversions inside the split and inside the unreservation that follows.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit` decimal precision inside the split; the rounding step of the product unit inside the unreservation.
rounding.step: Once per split and once per unreservation.

result.name: the unlinked demand, the split move that keeps the remaining link and the released reservations
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the moves, on their links and on the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: The demand had only one originating move and it is unlinked.
edge_cases.outcome: No split is needed, the demand's supply method goes back to take from stock and it is unreserved.

edge_cases.case: The demand keeps other originating moves.
edge_cases.outcome: The still-linked quantity is split off into its own move so that the two parts can be handled separately.

edge_cases.case: The split move ends up over-reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The excess is handed back to the original demand line by line, splitting the last line when it would overshoot.

edge_cases.case: The demand is done.
edge_cases.outcome: No split occurs, because a completed demand keeps whatever it received.

worked_examples.description: Unassigning one of two arrivals from a demand of ten
worked_examples.narrative: The first arrival is unlinked, leaving four still linked through the second; those four are split into their own move with the advanced supply method, and the original demand goes back to taking from stock and is unreserved.

records.name: The root set of the traceability tree
records.purpose: Fixes which completed detail lines the traceability report starts from, according to the record it was opened from.

operands.name: record the report was opened from
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot, a detail line, a Transfer or a manufacturing order
operands.constraints: decides the root set

operands.name: lot name in the calling context
operands.source: the calling context when the report is opened from one detail line
operands.constraints: selects the produced lines of the production genealogy

operands.name: completed detail lines of the record
operands.source: the record's lot, moves or finished moves
operands.constraints: only completed lines are taken

preconditions.condition: The record the report was opened from is one of the four kinds.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no defined root set.

procedure: When the report is opened from a Lot, take every completed detail line of that lot.
When it is opened from one detail line with a lot name in the calling context, take the lines recorded as produced from that line by the production genealogy, when there are any.
When it is opened from a Transfer, take the completed detail lines of its moves that carry a lot.
When it is opened from a manufacturing order, take the completed detail lines of its finished moves.
records.formula: root set = every completed detail line of the Lot , for a Lot ; = the lines produced from the line by the production genealogy , for one detail line with a lot name in the context ; = the completed detail lines of the Transfer's moves that carry a lot , for a Transfer ; = the completed detail lines of the finished moves , for a manufacturing order

rounding.what: Nothing; the root set is a selection of records.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the root set of detail lines
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the first level of the tree.

edge_cases.case: The Transfer has moves of untracked products.
edge_cases.outcome: Their lines are not roots, because only the lines carrying a lot are taken.

edge_cases.case: The production genealogy records nothing for the line.
edge_cases.outcome: The root set is empty for that entry point.

edge_cases.case: The report is opened from a Lot.
edge_cases.outcome: Every completed line of that lot is a root, whatever the document.

worked_examples.description: Opening the report from a delivery of two tracked products and one untracked one
worked_examples.narrative: Only the two lines carrying a lot become roots; the untracked line is not shown at the first level.
