When Warehouses are given and Locations are also given, take the view Locations of the Warehouses and keep only the given Locations whose materialised path starts with one of those view Locations' paths.
When Warehouses are given and no Location is, take the view Locations of the Warehouses.
When no Warehouse is given and Locations are, take the given Locations.
When neither is given, take the view Locations of every Warehouse of the reader's enabled companies.
When the resulting set is empty, make all three filters the always-false filter, so that every figure is zero.
records.formula: the chosen Locations = the given Locations whose path starts with a view Location's path , when both are given ; = the view Locations of the given Warehouses , when only Warehouses are ; = the given Locations , when only Locations are ; = the view Locations of every Warehouse of the reader's enabled companies , when neither is

rounding.what: Nothing; the resolution selects Locations.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the chosen Location set
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the three filters of the quantity figures; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A Location is given that lies outside the given Warehouses.
edge_cases.outcome: It is dropped, because its path does not start with any of the view Locations' paths.

edge_cases.case: A value is given as text.
edge_cases.outcome: It is resolved by a case-insensitive containment search over the searchable name fields, and the union of the matches is taken.

edge_cases.case: The resulting set is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: All three filters become the always-false filter and every figure is zero.

edge_cases.case: The context asks for the strict mode.
edge_cases.outcome: The chosen Locations are not expanded to their descendants when the filters are built.

worked_examples.description: A reader naming one warehouse and one shelf inside it
worked_examples.narrative: The shelf's path starts with the warehouse's view Location path, so it survives the intersection and is the only chosen Location.

worked_examples.description: A reader naming one warehouse and a shelf of another
worked_examples.narrative: The shelf lies outside the named warehouse, so the set is empty and the three filters become the always-false filter.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch for the location scope of the quantity figures

records.name: Building the three Location filters
records.purpose: Turns the chosen Locations into the three filters the quantity figures use, treating a planned arrival differently from a completed one so that a multi-step receipt counts as incoming from the moment it is planned.

operands.name: chosen Locations
operands.constraints: expanded to their descendants unless the strict mode is asked for

operands.name: source Location of a move
operands.constraints: decides whether the move leaves the set

operands.name: intermediate destination Location of a move
operands.constraints: decides arrival for a done move

operands.name: final Location of a move
operands.constraints: decides arrival for an open move when it is set

operands.name: mode asked for by the calling context
operands.unit_or_currency: ordinary, strict, or the mode that wants only what has physically happened
operands.constraints: changes the expansion and the arrival treatment

preconditions.condition: The chosen Location set is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: All three filters become the always-false filter and every figure is zero.

procedure: Let the set be the chosen Locations together with all of their descendants, computed recursively.
When the calling context asks for the strict mode, let the set be the chosen Locations alone, with no descendants.
Build the quantity filter as the condition that a Stock Quantity record's Location is in the set.
Build the incoming filter as the condition that a move arrives in the set and does not leave from it.
Build the outgoing filter as the condition that a move leaves from the set and does not arrive in it.
Read leaving from the set as the move's source Location being in the set.
Read arriving in the set, for a done move, as its intermediate destination Location being in the set.
Read arriving in the set, for an open move, as its final Location being set and in the set, or its final Location being empty and its intermediate destination Location being in the set.

When the calling context asks only for what has physically happened, drop the open-move treatment entirely: the incoming filter becomes the done destination being in the set and the source not, and the outgoing filter becomes the source being in the set and the done destination not.
records.formula: quantity filter = the record's Location is in the set ; incoming filter = the move arrives in the set and does not leave from it ; outgoing filter = the move leaves from the set and does not arrive in it ; arrival for an open move uses its final Location when that is set and its intermediate destination Location otherwise ; arrival for a done move always uses its intermediate destination Location

rounding.what: Nothing; the filters compare Locations.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the quantity filter, the incoming filter and the outgoing filter
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the quantity figures; never stored.

edge_cases.case: A move both leaves from the set and arrives in it.
edge_cases.outcome: It matches neither filter, because each requires the other side to be outside; an internal displacement changes no figure.

edge_cases.case: A two-step receipt is planned but not yet done.
edge_cases.outcome: Its final Location makes the first step count as incoming for the warehouse as a whole from the moment it is planned.

edge_cases.case: The strict mode is asked for.
edge_cases.outcome: The descendants are not added, so only the named Locations count.

edge_cases.case: The mode that wants only what has physically happened is asked for.
edge_cases.outcome: The final Location is ignored entirely and only the completed destination counts.

worked_examples.description: The first step of a two-step receipt into the input Location, with the stock Location as its final Location
worked_examples.narrative: The move comes from outside and its final Location is inside the set, so the first step already counts as incoming for the warehouse as a whole.

worked_examples.description: An internal transfer between two shelves of the same warehouse
worked_examples.narrative: Both sides are inside the set, so the move matches neither filter and changes neither the incoming nor the outgoing figure.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that ignores the final-Location treatment of open moves
business-rules.md switch for the strict location scope

records.name: The on-hand and reserved quantity figures of a product
records.purpose: Gives the two figures read straight from the Stock Quantity records within the chosen Locations, which every other product quantity figure is built on.

operands.name: quantity filter
operands.source: the three filters built from the chosen Locations
operands.constraints: always applied

operands.name: on-hand quantity of each matching record
operands.constraints: summed as they stand

operands.name: reserved quantity of each matching record
operands.constraints: summed as they stand

operands.name: restrictions on lot, owner and container
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot, a Contact and a container
operands.constraints: applied when they are in the context

preconditions.condition: The chosen Location set is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: The quantity filter is the always-false filter and both figures are zero.

procedure: Take the Stock Quantity records matching the quantity filter, together with the restrictions on lot, owner and container that the calling context carries.
Sum their on-hand quantities to obtain the on-hand figure.
Sum their reserved quantities to obtain the reserved figure.
records.formula: on-hand figure = sum of the on-hand quantities over the matching quantity records ; reserved figure = sum of the reserved quantities over the matching quantity records

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the figures that are derived from these two are rounded at the product unit's step.
rounding.precision: Not applicable to the two sums themselves.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs while the sums are taken.

result.name: the on-hand quantity and the reserved quantity of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the product and consumed by the free quantity and the forecasted quantity.

edge_cases.case: A record holds a negative quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: It lowers the on-hand figure, because the sum is taken as it stands.

edge_cases.case: The context restricts the owner.
edge_cases.outcome: Only that owner's records are summed, which is how consignment stock is separated.

edge_cases.case: The chosen Location set is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: Both figures are zero.

worked_examples.description: The three records of the first worked trace of the document, read at the warehouse level
worked_examples.narrative: Six plus nine less one is fourteen on hand, and six plus eight is fourteen reserved, which is the state the trace reaches once its two lines have been created.

records.name: The incoming and outgoing quantity figures of a product
records.purpose: Gives the quantities that are on their way into and out of the chosen Locations, which the forecasted quantity combines with the stock on hand.

operands.name: incoming filter and outgoing filter
operands.unit_or_currency: sets of conditions on Stock Moves
operands.source: the three filters built from the chosen Locations
operands.constraints: always applied

operands.name: real quantity of each matching move
operands.constraints: summed as it stands

operands.name: status of each move
operands.constraints: open means waiting another move, waiting, assigned or partially available

operands.name: restrictions on lot, owner and container
operands.unit_or_currency: a Lot, a Contact and a container
operands.constraints: applied when they are in the context

preconditions.condition: The chosen Location set is not empty.
preconditions.otherwise: Both filters are the always-false filter and both figures are zero.

procedure: Take the moves whose status is waiting another move, waiting, assigned or partially available and which match the incoming filter.
Sum their real quantities to obtain the incoming figure.
Take the open moves matching the outgoing filter in the same way.
Sum their real quantities to obtain the outgoing figure.
records.formula: incoming figure = sum of the real quantities over the open moves matching the incoming filter ; outgoing figure = sum of the real quantities over the open moves matching the outgoing filter , where open means the status is waiting another move , waiting , assigned or partially available

rounding.what: Nothing at this step; the forecasted figure that uses them is rounded at the product unit's step.
rounding.precision: Not applicable to the two sums themselves.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs while the sums are taken.

result.name: the incoming quantity and the outgoing quantity of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the product and consumed by the forecasted quantity.

edge_cases.case: A move is confirmed but has nothing reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: Its status is confirmed, which is not one of the four open statuses, so it does not count.

edge_cases.case: A move both leaves the set and arrives in it.
edge_cases.outcome: It matches neither filter and counts in neither figure.

edge_cases.case: The calling context restricts the date.
edge_cases.outcome: The incoming and outgoing figures keep their own date restrictions applied to the move date.

worked_examples.description: A warehouse with one open receipt of ten and one open delivery of four
worked_examples.narrative: Ten are on their way in and four are on their way out, which the forecasted figure then combines with the stock on hand.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that restricts the quantity figures to a window

records.name: The free quantity of a product
records.purpose: Gives the quantity that is present and not yet promised, which is what a reservation may still take without waiting for anything to arrive.

operands.name: on-hand figure
operands.source: the sum over the matching quantity records
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: reserved figure
operands.source: the sum over the matching quantity records
operands.constraints: never negative

operands.name: expired unreserved quantity
operands.source: the available quantity of the records whose removal date is on or before the cut-off
operands.constraints: zero unless the expiration behaviour is active

operands.name: product unit rounding step
operands.constraints: the figure is rounded at it

preconditions.condition: The on-hand and reserved figures have been summed over the same filtered set.
preconditions.otherwise: The subtraction would mix two different perimeters.

procedure: Subtract the reserved figure from the on-hand figure.
Subtract the expired unreserved quantity, which is zero unless the expiration behaviour is active.
Round the result at the product unit's rounding step.
records.formula: free quantity = round( on-hand figure − reserved figure − expired unreserved quantity ) at the product unit's rounding step

rounding.what: The final figure.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once, after the two subtractions.

result.name: free quantity of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the product and consumed by the forecast information of a move.

edge_cases.case: Everything present is reserved.
edge_cases.outcome: The free quantity is zero.

edge_cases.case: The expiration behaviour is active and some records have expired.
edge_cases.outcome: Their available quantity is subtracted as well, so expired goods are not offered.

edge_cases.case: The on-hand figure is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The free quantity is negative, the figure being rounded but not clamped.

worked_examples.description: The end state of the first worked trace of the document, read at the warehouse level
worked_examples.narrative: Fourteen on hand less fourteen reserved leaves nothing free, which is exactly the availability the trace reports at the end.

worked_examples.description: A warehouse holding twenty of which five are reserved and two have expired
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty less five reserved less two expired leaves thirteen that a reservation may still take.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch for the expiration behaviour

records.name: The forecasted quantity of a product
records.purpose: Gives the quantity the chosen Locations will hold once every open movement has run, which is the figure a replenishment decision is taken on.

operands.name: on-hand figure
operands.source: the sum over the matching quantity records
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: incoming figure
operands.source: the sum over the open moves matching the incoming filter
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: outgoing figure
operands.source: the sum over the open moves matching the outgoing filter
operands.constraints: zero or more

operands.name: expired unreserved quantity
operands.source: the available quantity of the records whose removal date is on or before the cut-off
operands.constraints: zero unless the expiration behaviour is active

operands.name: product unit rounding step
operands.constraints: the figure is rounded at it

preconditions.condition: The four inputs have been computed over the same chosen Location set.
preconditions.otherwise: The arithmetic would mix two different perimeters.

procedure: Add the incoming figure to the on-hand figure.
Subtract the outgoing figure.
Subtract the expired unreserved quantity, which is zero unless the expiration behaviour is active.
Round the result at the product unit's rounding step.
records.formula: forecasted quantity = round( on-hand figure + incoming figure − outgoing figure − expired unreserved quantity ) at the product unit's rounding step

rounding.what: The final figure.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once, after the three additions and subtractions.

result.name: forecasted quantity of the product
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the product and consumed by the forecast information of a move and by the replenishment rules.

edge_cases.case: More is going out than is present and coming in.
edge_cases.outcome: The forecasted quantity is negative, which is what a reordering rule reacts to.

edge_cases.case: A two-step receipt is planned.
edge_cases.outcome: It counts as incoming for the warehouse as a whole from the moment its first step is planned, because the incoming filter reads the final Location of an open move.

edge_cases.case: The expiration behaviour is active.
edge_cases.outcome: The expired unreserved quantity is subtracted as well.

worked_examples.description: A warehouse holding fourteen with ten on their way in and four on their way out
worked_examples.narrative: Fourteen plus ten less four gives twenty, which is what the warehouse will hold once both movements have run.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch for the expiration behaviour

records.name: The on-hand quantity of a product at a past instant
records.purpose: Corrects the on-hand figure backwards to a chosen instant, by replaying the completed movements that happened after it.

operands.name: current on-hand figure
operands.source: the sum over the matching quantity records
operands.constraints: the starting figure

operands.name: completed moves matching the incoming filter dated after the instant
operands.constraints: their processed quantities are subtracted

operands.name: completed moves matching the outgoing filter dated after the instant
operands.constraints: their processed quantities are added back

operands.name: as-of instant
operands.constraints: a value with no time part is pushed to the very end of that day

preconditions.condition: The as-of instant is earlier than now.
preconditions.otherwise: The current figure is returned as it stands.

procedure: Push a date value with no time part to the very end of that day, so that the whole day counts as past.
Take the current on-hand figure.
Subtract, for every completed move matching the incoming filter and dated after the instant, its processed quantity in the product unit.
Add, for every completed move matching the outgoing filter and dated after the instant, its processed quantity in the product unit.
Leave the incoming and outgoing figures with their own date restrictions applied to the move date.
records.formula: on-hand figure at an instant = current on-hand figure − sum over the completed moves matching the incoming filter dated after the instant of ( processed quantity in the product unit ) + sum over the completed moves matching the outgoing filter dated after the instant of ( processed quantity in the product unit )

rounding.what: The conversion of each move's processed quantity into the product unit.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.step: Once per move, as each sum is accumulated.

result.name: the on-hand quantity at the instant
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed when the reading context carries a past instant.

edge_cases.case: The instant is given as a date with no time.
edge_cases.outcome: It is pushed to the very end of that day, so a movement made during that day counts as having happened before the instant.

edge_cases.case: No completed move happened after the instant.
edge_cases.outcome: The corrected figure equals the current one.

edge_cases.case: A move is completed but matches neither filter.
edge_cases.outcome: It is an internal displacement and changes nothing.

worked_examples.description: A warehouse holding fourteen now, having received ten and shipped four since the instant
worked_examples.narrative: Fourteen less the ten that arrived plus the four that left gives eight, which is what the warehouse held at the instant.

related_rules: business-rules.md switch that evaluates the quantity figures at an instant

records.name: Setting the on-hand quantity directly on a product
records.purpose: Turns a figure typed on the product into a count of the stock Location of the company's first Warehouse, which is the shortest way to record an opening stock.

operands.name: written on-hand figure
operands.source: the person typing it on the product
operands.constraints: a negative value is ignored

operands.name: stock Location of the company's first Warehouse
operands.constraints: the Location the record is created in

operands.name: storability of the product
operands.constraints: only a storable product may hold stock

operands.name: origin of the write
operands.unit_or_currency: a person or the recomputation itself
operands.constraints: a write triggered by the recomputation is ignored

records.name: Trace: a reservation that partially succeeds
records.purpose: Follows one reservation from the first read to the last write, naming every intermediate figure, so that an implementation can be checked step by step rather than only by its end state.

operands.name: the three quantity records
operands.source: the starting state of the trace
operands.constraints: two positive and one negative, across two shelves

operands.name: the move
operands.unit_or_currency: twelve units in the product unit
operands.source: the starting state of the trace
operands.constraints: confirmed, not picked, no detail line, no originating move

operands.name: product unit rounding step
operands.source: the unit of measure named in the trace
operands.constraints: one hundredth

operands.name: Product Unit precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: two

preconditions.condition: No removal strategy is set anywhere, so first in first out applies.
preconditions.otherwise: The gathering order and therefore the records taken would differ.

procedure: Take the snapshot: the move's processed quantity is zero, so its already-reserved figure is zero.
Select the move: it is not picked and its status is confirmed, so it is selected.
Compute the missing quantity: twelve less nothing is twelve, which is positive at the product unit's rounding, and the line unit equals the product unit so the converted figure is also twelve.
Choose the branch: the source Location's usage is internal and the move has no originating move, so the branch that takes from stock applies.

Gather: the strategy is first in first out and the loose filter matches all three records, ordered by incoming date and then identifier, giving the record of the second of March first and then the two records of the fifth of March.
Compute the available quantity: the product is untracked, so six plus nine less one, less two reserved, gives twelve.
Clamp the wanted quantity to twelve; skip the full-packaging reduction and the unit re-expression, and skip the serial check.
Recompute the taking figure from the positive records alone: six plus nine less two gives thirteen.

Build the negative pockets: the record holding minus one gives a pocket of minus one for the container-less key of the second shelf; the record inside the container has a different key and carries none.
Walk the records: the first offers four, which is taken in full, leaving eight wanted and nine available; the second offers nine, of which eight is taken, leaving nothing wanted, so the walk stops.
Create the lines: there is no existing line and the two pairs have different keys, so two lines are created and the counters rise to six and eight.
Set the status: the missing quantity and the taken quantity are both twelve, so the move is marked fully assigned.
Run put-away: neither line carries a destination container and the customer Location has no rule, so both keep it.
Run the whole-container detection: the group of the container holds one line claiming eight while the container holds nine, so the test fails and nothing is flagged.
records.formula: available = ( 6 + 9 − 1 ) − ( 2 + 0 + 0 ) = 12.00 ; available for taking = ( 6 + 9 ) − ( 2 + 0 + 0 ) = 13.00 ; taken from the first record = 6 − 2 = 4.00 ; taken from the second = minimum( 9 − 0 , 12 − 4 ) = 8.00 ; final availability = ( 6 + 9 − 1 ) − ( 6 + 8 ) = 0.00

rounding.what: Every comparison of a quantity against zero or against another quantity.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, which is one hundredth in this trace, and the `Product Unit` decimal precision of two digits where a digit count is named.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; half away from zero for the conversions, which change nothing here because the two units are the same.
rounding.step: At the missing-quantity test, at the clamping, at each stop test of the walk and at the status test.

result.name: the assigned move, its two detail lines and the raised counters
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the move, the lines and the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: The negative record shares its shelf with the record inside the container.
edge_cases.outcome: Their keys differ because one carries a container, so the pocket does not reduce what the container offers.

edge_cases.case: The final lot-first sort is applied.
edge_cases.outcome: It changes nothing, no record carrying a lot.

edge_cases.case: The container holds more than the line claims.
edge_cases.outcome: The whole-container test fails and the container is not taken over as an entire package.

records.name: Trace: a validation that creates a backorder
records.purpose: Follows a validation from the person's input to the end state, naming every decision, so that the interaction of the sanity check, the picked marking, the backorder question and the completion can be checked step by step.

operands.name: the Transfer of the previous trace
operands.constraints: assigned, with a shipping policy of as soon as possible

operands.name: the second move
operands.unit_or_currency: five units of a lot-tracked product
operands.constraints: could not be reserved at all

operands.name: backorder policy of the Operation Type
operands.constraints: the policy that opens the question

operands.name: reservation policy of the Operation Type
operands.constraints: makes the backorder check its availability at once

preconditions.condition: The Transfer is not in draft.
preconditions.otherwise: The immediate-transfer step would copy the demands into the processed quantities.

procedure: Run the immediate-transfer step: the Transfer is not in draft, so nothing is copied.

Run the sanity check: at least one move that is neither done nor cancelled is picked, so only the picked moves are tested for a zero quantity, and the first move carries twelve; the Transfer has two moves; the second product is tracked but has no line at all and the first is untracked, so no lot is missing; the Transfer passes.
Run the picked marking: at least one move is already picked, so the marking does not run and the second move stays unpicked.

Run the backorder decision: the policy is to ask; the first move is picked and its picked quantity of twelve is not below its demand of twelve, so it triggers nothing; the second move has a demand of five and is not picked, which triggers the question; the backorder screen opens.
Resume after the person chooses to create the backorder, with the backorder step suppressed and nothing declared as not to be backordered.

Prune: the first move is picked and both its lines are picked, so nothing is deleted; the second move has a processed quantity of zero and is not picked, but backorders are allowed and its demand is not zero, so it is not cancelled.
Select: the set to complete is the first move alone, the second being unpicked.
Split the backorder moves: the first move's processed quantity of twelve is not below its demand of twelve at the digit count, so no backorder move is split off it.
Move the goods: complete the two lines in order and update the records and the destination.
Write the status: the first move becomes done with the current instant as its date.
Push: the customer Location has no push rule.
Propagate: the first move has no destination move.

Create the Transfer backorder: the moves that are neither done nor cancelled are the second move alone, which is carried into a copy of the Transfer with an empty reference, the original as its back-order link, its picked flag cleared and its responsible cleared, and a note is posted on the original.
Check the backorder's availability, the Operation Type reserving at confirmation: the second product is still unavailable, so its move stays confirmed and the backorder is confirmed.

Stamp the completion instant on the original Transfer and reset its priority; the Operation Type kind is a delivery, so the re-reservation search does not run; the confirmation message and the confirmation text message are sent when the company asks for them.
records.formula: first line: reserved(Q1) 6.00 → 2.00 , on-hand(Q1) 6.00 → 2.00 , the destination rises by 4.00 stamped 2 March ; second line: reserved(Q2) 8.00 → 0.00 , on-hand(Q2) 9.00 → 1.00 , the destination rises by 8.00 stamped 5 March ; the stock Location then holds 2.00 + 1.00 − 1.00 = 2.00 net

rounding.what: The zero-quantity test of the sanity check, the backorder test and the backorder question.
rounding.precision: The `Product Unit` decimal precision of two digits for all three.
rounding.step: Once per move at each of the three tests.

result.name: the completed Transfer, its backorder and the moved quantities
result.stored_or_displayed: Stored on the Transfers, the moves, the lines and the Stock Quantity records.

edge_cases.case: One move is picked and another is not.
edge_cases.outcome: The sanity check tests only the picked ones and the picked marking does not run at all.

edge_cases.case: The completed move is exactly fully processed.
edge_cases.outcome: No backorder move is split off it, although the Transfer as a whole still produces a backorder for its other move.

edge_cases.case: The Operation Type kind is a delivery.
edge_cases.outcome: The re-reservation search does not run after the validation.

records.name: Trace: a put-away that walks two rules
records.purpose: Follows one put-away from the arrival Location to the chosen bin, naming every occupancy figure and every capacity test, so that the rule selection, the specificity sort and the two passes of the walk can be checked step by step.

operands.name: arrival Location and its three internal descendants
operands.constraints: all three bins carry the same storage category

operands.name: storage category
operands.unit_or_currency: a maximum weight of forty, a product capacity of twenty and the same-product mixing policy
operands.constraints: shared by the three bins

operands.name: the two rules of the arrival Location
operands.constraints: one naming a category and one naming the product

operands.name: the request
operands.unit_or_currency: six units of the product, no container, no packaging unit, no additional quantities
operands.constraints: the quantity being placed

operands.name: product weight
operands.constraints: used in the weight test

preconditions.condition: At least one candidate Location carries a storage category.
preconditions.otherwise: No occupancy map would be built.

procedure: Determine the container type: none, no container and no packaging unit being given.
Build the product set: the single product being placed.
Build the category chain: the product's own category and its ancestors.

Select the rules: the rule naming no product passes because its category is in the chain and it names no container type; the rule naming the product passes because its product is in the set; both are selected.

Sort by specificity: the key of the product rule is false for the container type, true for the product and false for the two category members, while the key of the category rule is false, false, false and true; comparing element by element, the product rule wins on the second element and sorts first.
Determine the candidate Locations: no Location is named in the calling context, so the internal descendants of the arrival Location, the arrival Location itself included because it is internal.

Build the occupancy map as a quantity map, since at least one candidate carries a storage category and no typed container is involved: eighteen for the first bin from its records, nothing for the second, five for the third from the open line, and nothing for the arrival Location.
Walk the first rule: its mode is the closest Location, so the target stays the arrival Location and its children are narrowed to those carrying the category, which is all three bins.

Run the first pass, which prefers a Location that already holds the goods: the first bin qualifies with an occupancy of eighteen but fails the second quantity test, so it is rejected; the second bin has an occupancy of zero and is skipped by this pass; the third bin qualifies with an occupancy of five and passes every test, so it is returned.
Return the third bin as the answer; the second rule is never reached.
records.formula: occupancy(first bin) = 18.00 + 0 = 18.00 ; occupancy(second bin) = 0 + 0 = 0 ; occupancy(third bin) = 0 + 5.00 = 5.00 ; first bin: weight test 40 < 9 + 0.5 × 6 = 12 is false , first quantity test 18 ≥ 20 is false , second quantity test 6 + 18 = 24 > 20 is true , so it fails ; third bin: weight test 40 < 2.5 + 3 = 5.5 is false , 5 ≥ 20 is false , 6 + 5 = 11 > 20 is false , so it passes

rounding.what: The comparisons of the occupancy figures and of the capacity tests.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step; the weights are multiplied and compared exactly.
rounding.step: Once per candidate, inside the capacity check.

result.name: the chosen destination Location
result.stored_or_displayed: Written onto the destination Location of the line being placed.

edge_cases.case: The first bin already holds the goods but would be pushed over its capacity.
edge_cases.outcome: It is rejected by the second quantity test and added to the rejected set, so the second pass will not try it again.

edge_cases.case: The second bin holds another product.
edge_cases.outcome: Had the walk reached it in the second pass, the same-product mixing policy would have rejected it.

edge_cases.case: Every bin fails.
edge_cases.outcome: The first rule returns nothing and the walk moves to the second rule, whose target carries no storage category, so its capacity check passes trivially and the arrival Location is returned.

records.name: The complete table of rounding decisions of the domain
records.purpose: Collects every place where the domain rounds, with the precision and the method of each, so that an implementation can check that it rounds in exactly those places and nowhere else.

operands.name: unit rounding steps
operands.source: the product unit, the line unit and the packaging unit
operands.constraints: each has its own step

operands.name: the `Product Unit` decimal precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product quantities
operands.constraints: a digit count, not a unit step

operands.name: the `Product Price` decimal precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record for product prices
operands.constraints: used only for the unit price after a negative absorption

operands.name: the `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision
operands.source: the decimal precision record used for the whole-container comparison
operands.constraints: used only there

operands.name: the shipped product-unit precision record
operands.source: the precision record shipped with the system
operands.constraints: twice its digits, floored at six, is the digit count of the empty-record deletion

preconditions.condition: Every other arithmetic of the domain is exact.
preconditions.otherwise: An implementation would round where the domain does not and diverge.

procedure: Round the conversion of a demand into a real quantity, and the conversion of a detail line's quantity into the product unit, at the product unit's rounding step, half away from zero.
Do not round the summation of the detail lines into a move's processed quantity.
Compare a processed quantity against a demand at the line unit's rounding step for the status, and at the `Product Unit` decimal precision for the backorder test and for the backorder question.
Check that a written processed quantity is representable at the `Product Unit` decimal precision, half away from zero.
Check a detail line at completion at both the line unit's rounding step and the `Product Unit` decimal precision, compared against each other, half away from zero.
Re-express a reservation in the line unit by rounding down at the line unit's step and then half away from zero back at the product unit's.
Decide whether a reserved quantity fits an existing line at the `Product Unit` decimal precision, half away from zero.
Apply the full-packaging reservation by rounding down at the packaging unit's step and then half away from zero back.

Choose the unit of a split move at the `Product Unit` decimal precision, half away from zero, and compute the surviving demand at that same precision, half away from zero after an unrounded conversion.
Round the unit price after absorbing a negative move at the `Product Price` decimal precision, half away from zero.
Format each floating member of the merge key at its own precision, as text, half away from zero.
Compare the whole-container test at the `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision as a zero test.
Delete an empty quantity record using the greater of six digits and twice the digits of the shipped product-unit precision record.
Do not round during the walk that distributes a processed quantity over the lines, nor during the walk that reduces one.
Aggregate a printed document at the move's line unit.
Round the traceability quantity at the `Product Unit` decimal precision, half away from zero.
Take the whole part of a line quantity, truncated, for the count of labels per unit.
Round up to a whole number at or above the demand for the reception report labels.
Round the product quantity figures at the product unit's rounding step.
Treat everything not listed as exact arithmetic.
records.formula: each place listed rounds at the precision and by the method stated , and nothing outside the list rounds at all

rounding.what: Every rounded figure of the domain, collected in one place.
rounding.precision: The product unit's rounding step, the line unit's rounding step, the packaging unit's rounding step, the `Product Unit` decimal precision, the `Product Price` decimal precision, the `Product Unit of Measure` decimal precision, the move's line unit, and the greater of six digits and twice the shipped product-unit precision.
rounding.method: Half away from zero for most; truncation towards zero for the re-expressions, the full-packaging reduction and the label count; up for the reception report labels; a zero test for the whole-container comparison.
rounding.step: Each at the step its own calculation names.

result.name: the rounding contract of the domain
result.unit_or_currency: a table of precisions and methods
result.stored_or_displayed: A reference; each entry is applied by its own calculation.

edge_cases.case: A figure is rounded that the table does not list.
edge_cases.outcome: The implementation diverges, because everything not listed is exact arithmetic.

edge_cases.case: A digit count is used where a unit rounding step is named, or the reverse.
edge_cases.outcome: The two are deliberately different and substituting one for the other changes the result.

edge_cases.case: The shipped product-unit precision record has four decimal digits.
edge_cases.outcome: Twice four is eight, which is above the floor of six, so the empty-record deletion uses eight digits.

worked_examples.description: Three of the entries applied to one figure of two and a half in a unit whose rounding step is a whole unit
worked_examples.narrative: The same figure rounds to three at the unit's step and stays at two and a half at the digit count, which is what makes the completion check fail; the label count takes the truncated whole part, which is two.

worked_examples.description: The empty-record digit count for two different shipped precisions
worked_examples.narrative: Twice two is four, which the floor of six raises to six; twice four is eight, which stands.

records.name: The layered call graph of the domain's algorithms
records.purpose: States which algorithm calls which, so that an implementation can be built from the bottom up and tested at each level rather than all at once.

operands.name: the arithmetic layer
operands.source: the units of measure and packaging domain
operands.constraints: nothing in this domain re-implements it

operands.name: the quantity-record layer
operands.source: the available quantity of one record, the available quantity of a set and the writing routine
operands.constraints: the second and the third call the gathering

operands.name: the goods-choosing layer
operands.source: the strategy selection, the container pre-selection, the gathering and the reservation-quantity computation
operands.constraints: built on the layer below

operands.name: the goods-placing layer
operands.source: the capacity check, the rule walk, the put-away selection and the application to a set of lines
operands.constraints: built on the Location weight

operands.name: the move, completion and document layers
operands.source: the move operations, the completion and the document operations
operands.constraints: each calls only the layers below it and its own siblings as stated

preconditions.condition: The layer below is complete before the layer above is built.
preconditions.otherwise: The upper layer cannot be tested in isolation.

procedure: Treat unit conversion, rounding and comparison as the arithmetic layer, owned by the units of measure and packaging domain and never re-implemented here.

Build the quantity-record layer: the available quantity of one record calls nothing; the available quantity of a set calls the gathering; the writing routine calls the gathering and the available quantity of a set.

Build the goods-choosing layer: the strategy selection calls nothing; the container pre-selection calls nothing but the database; the gathering calls the strategy selection and the pre-selection; the reservation-quantity computation calls the gathering and the available quantity of a set.

Build the goods-placing layer: the capacity check calls the Location weight; the rule walk calls the capacity check; the put-away selection calls the occupancy map and the rule walk; the application to a set of lines calls the put-away selection once per group or once per line.

Build the move layer: creating a detail line calls the writing routine; creating or extending the lines of a reservation calls the line creation; the distribution map calls nothing but the chain; the reservation algorithm calls its own per-move processing, the distribution map, the line creation, the reservation-quantity computation, the application of put-away and the whole-container detection; unreserving calls the deletion of detail lines, which calls the writing routine; changing a line calls the writing routine and, on a completed line, the freeing of reservations; the freeing of reservations calls the reservation algorithm on the victims; the distribution of a processed quantity calls the reservation-quantity computation and the application of put-away; the reduction of a processed quantity calls the deletion of detail lines; the split calls nothing but the status recomputation; the merge calls the relevant-status subroutine.

Build the completion layer: completing the detail lines calls the container snapshots, the writing routine, the freeing of reservations and the application of destination containers; the backorder moves call the split; the completion algorithm calls the confirmation, the pruning, the backorder moves, the line completion, the push rules and the reservation algorithm; the push rules call the rule engine of the replenishment and procurement domain and then the completion's own confirmation.

Build the document layer: the Transfer backorder calls the status recomputation and the reservation algorithm; the validation algorithm calls the confirmation, the sanity check, the backorder decision, the completion algorithm, the Transfer backorder, the re-reservation search and the automatic printing; the counting application calls the completion algorithm and the next-count-date computation; the reception report assignment calls the split and the reservation algorithm.
records.formula: each algorithm calls only the algorithms named for it ; the layers are the arithmetic , the quantity records , choosing goods , placing goods , the move operations , the completion and the document operations

rounding.what: Nothing; the call graph carries no arithmetic of its own.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the call graph of the domain
result.stored_or_displayed: A reference for building and testing an implementation.

edge_cases.case: An algorithm calls one that is above it in the layering.
edge_cases.outcome: Only two such calls exist and both are stated: the freeing of reservations calls the reservation algorithm, and the push rules call the completion's own confirmation.

edge_cases.case: An implementation re-implements the unit arithmetic.
edge_cases.outcome: It leaves the contract, because the arithmetic layer is owned by another domain.

worked_examples.description: Building the domain from the bottom up

testable_after_layer_two: the available quantity of one record
the available quantity of a set

worked_examples.narrative: Each layer can be tested on its own once the layer below it is complete, which is what the call graph is for.

records.name: The self-calling algorithms and their termination
records.purpose: Names the four algorithms of the domain that call themselves and states what makes each of them stop, so that an implementation does not loop.

operands.name: the push rules in transparent mode
operands.source: the running of a push rule
operands.constraints: re-runs the push step on the same move

operands.name: the application of destination containers
operands.constraints: recurses onto the parents of the processed containers

operands.name: the container promotion
operands.constraints: recurses onto the destination containers just set

operands.name: the freeing of reservations
operands.source: a movement that drives a Location negative
operands.constraints: re-reserves the victims, which may free further reservations

preconditions.condition: Each termination condition is implemented as stated.
preconditions.otherwise: The algorithm may loop.

procedure: Let the push rules in transparent mode re-run the push step on the same move after rewriting its destination, and stop when the destination Location did not change.
Let the application of destination containers recurse onto the parents of the processed containers, and carry a processed set along so that no container is ever revisited.
Let the container promotion recurse onto the destination containers it has just set, and stop when no container of the set gained one.
Let the freeing of reservations re-reserve the victims, which may itself free further reservations, and carry into the recursion an untouchable set that every visited line is added to.
records.formula: the transparent push stops when the destination Location did not change ; the application of destination containers never revisits a processed container ; the container promotion stops when no container gained a destination container ; the freeing of reservations carries an untouchable set that grows with every visited line

rounding.what: Nothing; the terminations compare Locations and sets.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the termination guarantees of the four recursions
result.stored_or_displayed: A reference for building an implementation that halts.

edge_cases.case: A chain of transparent push rules ends where it began.
edge_cases.outcome: The destination Location does not change on that round and the recursion stops.

edge_cases.case: A container's parent is itself a child of a container already processed.
edge_cases.outcome: The processed set stops the recursion from revisiting it.

edge_cases.case: The victims of a freeing free further reservations.
edge_cases.outcome: Every line already visited is in the untouchable set, so the recursion cannot rob the same line twice.

worked_examples.description: A chain of two transparent push rules

expected_outputs.recursion_stops_at: the third round, the destination not having changed

worked_examples.narrative: Two rules move the destination forward and the third round finds no change, which is what stops the walk.

records.name: The step orders a caller must not change
records.purpose: Collects the ten places where changing the order of two steps produces different records, so that an implementation that reorganises the code keeps the observable behaviour.

operands.name: the reservation algorithm
operands.source: the snapshot and the reduction of the distribution map
operands.constraints: both must precede what they guard

operands.name: the completion algorithm
operands.source: the pruning before the backorder split, and the split before the line completion
operands.constraints: both change which records exist

operands.name: the completion of the lines
operands.source: the container snapshots before any quantity moves, and the fixed five-step order per line
operands.constraints: any other order leaves a counter wrong

operands.name: the validation algorithm
operands.source: the immediate-transfer step before the sanity check, and the picked marking before the backorder decision
operands.constraints: both change what is refused or proposed

operands.name: the merging, the cancelling and the warehouse write
operands.source: the detachment of negative moves, the propagation decisions and the order in which a Warehouse is rebuilt
operands.constraints: each changes what is written or where

preconditions.condition: The steps are performed in the order stated.
preconditions.otherwise: The operation produces different records.

procedure: Take the already-reserved snapshot of the reservation before any line is created, because creating one invalidates the field.
Reduce the distribution map of a chained reservation by the move's existing lines before the map is walked, otherwise a second pass double-counts.
Prune before the backorder split in the completion, because pruning can cancel a move that would otherwise be split.
Split the backorder moves before the lines are completed, because completing changes the processed quantity the split measures against.
Write the container snapshots before any quantity moves.

For one line at completion, keep the order: release the reservation, take from the source, compensate lot-less negatives, put into the destination, free other reservations; any other order leaves a counter wrong.
Run the immediate-transfer step of the validation before the sanity check, otherwise a Transfer created and validated in one gesture is refused for having no quantity.
Run the picked marking before the backorder decision, otherwise every line looks unpicked and a backorder is always proposed.
Detach the negative moves from their Transfer before anything is written during a merge, so that the change notes are not posted on a document that is about to lose the move.
Take the propagation decisions of a cancellation before the chain links are cleared.
Create the Locations of a Warehouse before the Operation Types are rebuilt, and the Operation Types before the Routes, because the rules name both.
records.formula: each ordering constraint listed is binding ; reordering the two steps it names produces different records

rounding.what: Nothing; the constraints are on order.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: No rounding occurs at any step.

result.name: the ordering contract of the domain's algorithms
result.stored_or_displayed: A reference for an implementation that reorganises the steps.

edge_cases.case: The snapshot is taken per move rather than once up front.
edge_cases.outcome: Every move after the first measures against a figure the pass itself has changed and reserves too little.

edge_cases.case: The backorder split runs after the lines are completed.
edge_cases.outcome: The processed quantity has already changed, so the split carries over the wrong quantity.

edge_cases.case: The picked marking runs after the backorder decision.
edge_cases.outcome: A backorder is proposed for every validation, because every line looks unpicked.

edge_cases.case: The Routes of a Warehouse are built before its Operation Types.
edge_cases.outcome: The rules cannot name them and the Warehouse is built wrong.

worked_examples.description: The five-step order of one line at completion

correct_order: free other reservations for any negative available quantity

worked_examples.narrative: Releasing the reservation before taking the goods out is what leaves the counter at two rather than at six against an on-hand quantity of two.

records.name: The reservation pair list
records.purpose: Names once the intermediate structure the reservation-quantity computation produces, so that the calculations that consume it agree on its meaning, its order and its sign.

operands.name: Stock Quantity record of each pair
operands.constraints: the order of the list is the gathering order

operands.name: signed quantity of each pair
operands.constraints: positive to take, negative to give back

operands.name: wanted quantity
operands.constraints: the sum of the pairs is at most its absolute value

preconditions.condition: The list preserves the gathering order.
preconditions.otherwise: The first pair would not be the record the removal strategy chose first.

procedure: Read the list as a sequence of pairs, each carrying a Stock Quantity record and a signed quantity in the product unit.
Read a positive quantity as an instruction to take that much from that record.
Read a negative quantity as an instruction to give that much back to that record.
Rely on the order: the first pair is always the record the removal strategy chose first.
Expect the sum of the quantities to be at most the wanted quantity in absolute value, and possibly strictly less when availability ran out.
records.formula: the list is a sequence of pairs ( record , signed quantity in the product unit ) , in gathering order , whose absolute sum is at most the absolute wanted quantity

rounding.what: Nothing; the quantities are those the reservation-quantity computation produced.
rounding.precision: Not applicable to the structure itself.
rounding.step: No rounding is applied when the list is passed on.

result.name: the reservation pair list
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the creation of the lines of a reservation and by the distribution of a processed quantity; never stored.

edge_cases.case: The sum is strictly less than the wanted quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: Availability ran out and the calling move becomes partially available.

edge_cases.case: The list is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: Nothing at all could be taken or given back.

edge_cases.case: A pair carries a negative quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The consumer lowers the reserved counter of that record rather than raising it.

worked_examples.description: The list produced by the first worked trace of the document

expected_outputs.interpretation: take four from the first record and eight from the second

worked_examples.narrative: The first pair is the record the strategy chose first, and the two quantities sum to exactly the wanted twelve.

records.name: The distribution map
records.purpose: Names once the structure that says how much of what a move's predecessors delivered remains unclaimed at each exact set of characteristics.

operands.name: key of each entry
operands.unit_or_currency: a Location, a lot, a container and an owner
operands.source: the detail lines of the parents and the siblings
operands.constraints: the four characteristics together

operands.name: quantity of each entry
operands.source: the incoming figure less the outgoing figure for that key
operands.constraints: strictly positive; the other keys are dropped

preconditions.condition: Only strictly positive entries are kept.
preconditions.otherwise: A key that is already over-claimed would be offered to a reservation.

procedure: Read the map as a set of entries, each keyed by a Location, a lot, a container and an owner, and holding a quantity in the product unit.
Read an entry as meaning that so much of what the predecessors delivered, at exactly those characteristics, has not yet been claimed by this move or by its siblings.
Expect only strictly positive entries.
records.formula: the map is a set of entries ( Location , lot , container , owner ) → quantity in the product unit , holding only strictly positive quantities

rounding.what: Nothing when the map is passed on; the entries were rounded when they were built.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, applied when the map was built.
rounding.method: Comparison at the step for the positivity test.
rounding.step: Once per key, when the map was built.

result.name: the distribution map
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the branch of the reservation that bypasses reservation and by the branch for a chained move; never stored.

edge_cases.case: The map is empty.
edge_cases.outcome: The chained reservation reserves nothing and the move keeps its status.

edge_cases.case: A key is over-claimed by the siblings.
edge_cases.outcome: Its difference is not strictly positive and the key is dropped.

edge_cases.case: The move already holds lines at one of the keys.
edge_cases.outcome: The chained branch subtracts them from the map before walking it.

worked_examples.description: A first step that delivered ten into an output Location, three of which a sibling has already claimed
worked_examples.narrative: Seven remain unclaimed at exactly those characteristics, which is what the chained reservation may promise.

records.name: The occupancy map
records.purpose: Names once the structure the capacity check compares against, whose meaning depends on whether a typed container or a product quantity is being placed.

operands.name: key of each entry
operands.source: the candidate Locations of the put-away
operands.constraints: only the candidates appear

operands.name: figure of each entry
operands.unit_or_currency: a count of containers of one type, or a quantity of one product in the product unit
operands.constraints: may be negative when the caller supplied negative additional quantities

preconditions.condition: At least one candidate Location carries a storage category.
preconditions.otherwise: The map is not built at all.

procedure: Read the map as a set of entries keyed by Location.
Read the figure as a count of containers of one type when a typed container is being placed.
Read it as a quantity of one product in the product unit otherwise.
Accept a negative figure, which arises when the caller supplied negative additional quantities for the lines it is about to rewrite.
records.formula: the map is a set of entries Location → figure , where the figure is a count of containers of one type or a quantity of one product in the product unit , and may be negative

rounding.what: Nothing when the map is passed on; the quantity variant rounded each open line when it was built.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, applied when the map was built.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied when the map was built.
rounding.step: Once per open line, when the map was built.

result.name: the occupancy map
result.unit_or_currency: counts of containers or the product unit
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the capacity check; never stored.

edge_cases.case: The caller supplies a negative additional quantity.
edge_cases.outcome: The entry may be negative, which is how a screen stops a line from counting its own quantity twice.

edge_cases.case: No candidate carries a storage category.
edge_cases.outcome: The map is not built and every capacity check passes on the absence of a category.

edge_cases.case: The same container is named by several open lines.
edge_cases.outcome: It is counted once in the container variant.

worked_examples.description: The map of the third worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Only the entries whose figure is strictly positive are considered by the first pass of the rule walk, which is what makes the goods prefer a Location that already holds them.

records.name: The detail-line value list
records.purpose: Names once the structure that three calculations produce and the line creation consumes, so that they agree on the fields a value dictionary must carry.

operands.name: required members of each value dictionary
operands.constraints: the move, the product, the unit, the source Location, the destination Location, the Transfer, the company and the quantity

operands.name: optional members of each value dictionary
operands.constraints: the lot, the typed lot name, the source container, the destination container and the owner

operands.name: producers of the list
operands.source: the creation or extension of the lines of a reservation, the distribution of a processed quantity, and the turning of generated entries into detail-line operations
operands.constraints: all three produce the same shape

preconditions.condition: Every value dictionary carries at least the eight required members.
preconditions.otherwise: The line creation cannot build a record from it.

procedure: Read the list as a sequence of value dictionaries.
Require of each at least the move, the product, the unit, the source Location, the destination Location, the Transfer, the company and the quantity.
Allow each to carry in addition the lot, the typed lot name, the source container, the destination container and the owner.
Let the line creation turn each dictionary into a record and raise the reserved counters as it does so.
records.formula: each value dictionary carries at least ( move , product , unit , source Location , destination Location , Transfer , company , quantity ) and optionally ( lot , typed lot name , source container , destination container , owner )

rounding.what: Nothing when the list is passed on; the line creation converts each quantity into the product unit before raising a counter.
rounding.precision: The rounding step of the product unit, applied by the line creation.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, applied by the line creation.
rounding.step: Once per line, at the creation.

result.name: the detail-line value list
result.stored_or_displayed: Consumed by the line creation, which stores the records and raises the counters.

edge_cases.case: A dictionary carries a typed lot name but no lot.
edge_cases.outcome: The name is resolved into a Lot at completion, or earlier when the Operation Type allows using existing lots.

edge_cases.case: A dictionary carries a destination container.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is not a candidate for absorbing a later reservation.

edge_cases.case: A dictionary carries no move.
edge_cases.outcome: The line creation finds or creates one for it from the Transfer and the product.

worked_examples.description: The two value dictionaries of the first worked trace of the document
worked_examples.narrative: Both dictionaries carry the eight required members and the second carries a source container as well; the line creation turns them into two records and raises the two counters by the quantities converted into the product unit.
